articles.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
articles.content: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene. Here we present a model that directly co-generates the video and 3D motion for any supplied rig, along with a camera that registers this motion to the scene. Prior video-motion models either handle only human skeletons, often adding billions of parameters, or triangulate 3D motion from generated 2D pose maps. We instead keep 3D motion in a separate model that supports arbitrary skeletons, and connect it to a pretrained video model through a small set of cross-attention layers. This separation lets the motion model first learn how skeletons move from motion-only data, which is easier to obtain and augment than paired video. Additionally, our model learns to locate each joint in the video frames, which lets us recover the camera and place the 3D motion in the scene. To train across many skeletons, we use a generative video editor to place animated 3D assets in scenes suited to their actions, curating the edits so their known motion remains valid. Together with human and robot video, this yields nearly 200K training pairs. Our evaluations demonstrate that our model animates diverse rigs from text more faithfully than video-first pipelines, and its motion responds to the surrounding scene. It also turns video into rig motion, rig motion into video, and enables keyframe-based control of the 3D motion. Videos and additional results are available on our project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关节,摄像头,开始! 任意使用 3D 动作和视频
articles.content_zh: 视频生成模型现在可以描绘出非常现实的动作. 然而目前还不清楚如何使用这个运动超越像素:将特定的3D资产激活,并在3D场景中重播动画. 例如,视频模型可以显示猴子跳过交叉栏,但不能将跳跃作为可重播的3D运动放入3D场景中. 在这里,我们提出一个模型, 直接生成视频和3D运动 任何供应的钻机, 以及一个相机 登记这个运动到现场。 之前的视频运动模型要么只处理人类骨架,常常增加数十亿参数,要么从生成的2D中三角化3D运动,摆出地图. 我们反而将3D运动保留在一个支持任意骨架的单独模型中,并通过一小组交叉注意力层将其连接到一个预先训练的视频模型中. 这种分离让运动模型首先了解骨架如何从只运动数据中移动,这比配对视频更容易获得和增强. 此外,我们的模型学会定位 每一个关节在视频框, 这使得我们回收相机 并放置3D运动 在现场。 为了在很多骨架上训练,我们使用基因视频编辑器将动画3D资产放置在适合其动作的场景中,对编辑进行校正,使其已知的动作依然有效. 与人和机器人视频一起,这产生了近200K的训练配对. 我们的评价表明,我们的模型比视频第一管道更忠实地从文字中激发出各种钻机,其运动响应了周围的场景. 它还将视频转化为钻机运动,将钻机运动转化为视频,并使得基于键框的控制3D运动成为可能. 视频和额外结果见我们的项目网页:https://research.nvidia.com/labs/par/projects/jca/。

articles.title: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
articles.content: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AEON:统一视频和3D世界模式
articles.content_zh: 目前的世界显性模拟模型一般遵循两种不同的路径:(1)视频基因模型(例如Sora),它模拟现实的外观,但未能保持3D的一致性;(2)3D基因模型(例如Marble),它产生几何一致性的场景,但往往产生静止的,不太现实的观测结果. 我们提出AEON,一个连接基于视频和基于3D的世界模型并结合两者利益的统一框架. AEON的关键洞察力在于一种基因模型,在文本或图像条件的视频潜在空间内运作,同时产生可渲染的4D图形原始——特指4D高斯镀(4DGS)——作为明确的世界代表. 我们训练一个4D重建模型 来预测4DGS和相机的姿势 从单视视频, 作为我们初始化的4D解码器。 此外,我们设计了一个域适配器,通过视频VAE上的蒸馏过程,将基因视频潜伏转化为重建的4D潜伏. AEON通过在预测的相机轨迹上渲染4DGS,自然支持基于视频的世界建模,并构建具有场景动态的持久4D环境,用于现实的世界模拟. 因此,AEON赋予了各种各样的世界模型应用能力,并在标准基准上取得了最先进的业绩。 项目网页:https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

articles.title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
articles.content: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. Existing renderers are tied to the representation of one engine, need tens of denoising steps or a costly distillation of their own, and learn from conditions that are not aligned with their target videos. We present SolarRenderer, a structure-conditioned video renderer that adapts a frozen MiniMax-H3 33B backbone with two lightweight LoRAs. Structural videos enter the native reference pathway of the backbone at the positions of the frames they describe, without a type identifier and described only in plain text, so that a single control LoRA follows arbitrary structural representations. Starting from a pretrained four-step LoRA, structure-guided distribution matching renders in four steps, 12.3 times faster than 50-step sampling, while preserving the learned control. A block-causal variant extends the same design to streaming and renders 768p video in real time. To train the model, we build a frame-aligned corpus of 136K clips from game engines, simulators, and YouTube videos. Experiments on an in-distribution test set and a generalization benchmark of 16 structural representations show that SolarRenderer achieves state-of-the-art results across both, and generalizes to 11 unseen representations, including pose skeletons, drawings, and point clouds.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 太阳能渲染器: 极少数阶梯式基因参考渲染
articles.content_zh: 游戏引擎和编码代理可以指定一个场景的布局,运动,和相机,然而将这种粗糙的结构变成现实的视频需要一个遵循结构的渲染器,完成它留下的外观打开. 现有的渲染器与一种发动机的表示有关,需要数十个调试步骤或自己的昂贵的蒸馏,并学习与其目标视频不匹配的条件. 我们介绍SolarRenderer,一个结构条件化的视频渲染器,它可以改造一个冷冻的MiniMax-H3 33B主干线,有两个轻量级的LORA. 结构视频在其描述的框架位置输入主干线的原生参考路径,没有类型标识符,仅在纯文本中描述,因此一个单一的控制LORA遵循任意的结构表示. 从预先训练的四步LORA开始,结构制导的分布比对在四个步骤中,比50步的取样速度快12.3倍,同时保留了学到的控制. 区块-causal变体将同一设计延伸至流线,实时制作768p视频. 为了训练这个模型,我们从游戏引擎、模拟器和YouTube视频中构建了一套由136K片段组成的帧组合。 对分布式测试集的实验和16个结构表示式的概括化基准表明,SolarRenderer在两个方面都取得了最先进的结果,并概括到11个看不见的表示式,包括姿势骨架,图画,和点云.

articles.title: Learning Adaptable Dexterous Skills via Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
articles.content: Dexterous multi-finger hands hold promise to unlock diverse skills like functional grasps, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic handover that the human-designed world assumes, yet existing learning recipes force a trade-off. Goal-reaching reinforcement learning generalizes to arbitrary object poses but, lacking any human prior, converges to unnatural and unreliable finger strategies; motion tracking reproduces human-like behavior from a single clip but cannot deviate from it. We present AdaDex, a goal-conditioned RL framework that turns a single hand-object trajectory of a few seconds---from mocap data or HOI reconstruction from in-the-wild RGB(D) video---into an adaptable dexterous skill. At the core of AdaDex is Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking: a shared policy is trained on two populations of massively parallel environments: motion tracking environments trained with dense motion tracking objective, which instill the human prior from human motion; and generalization environments with noised initial states and goals and a sparse object-success reward, which force the skill to work far off the reference. From seconds of human motion per skill, the resulting policies can learn diverse adaptable dexterous skills, such as functional grasping, object reposing, in-hand reorientation with finger gaiting, and dynamic behaviors like throw-and-catch. Our method outperforms baselines in terms of generalization and functionality, and we demonstrate transfer across simulators and to the real world. Project page: https://yuxuank.com/AdaDex/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过混合Dexterous模仿学习可适应的Dexterous技能
articles.content_zh: Dexters的多指手可及地解锁各种技能,如功能把握,手可及的重定向,以及人类设计的世界所假设的动态交接,然而现有的学习食谱却迫使取舍. 目标深远的强化学习一般化为任意物体的姿势,但缺乏任何人类前身,会与不自然和不可靠的手指策略汇合;运动跟踪从一个片段复制出类似人类的行为,但不能偏离它. 我们提出AdaDex,一个有目标条件的RL框架,它将一个几秒钟的单手对象轨迹——从Mocap数据或HOI重建从闪烁的RGB(D)视频——变成一个可适应的dexterous技能. AdaDex的核心是Hybrid Dexterous Micking:一项共同政策是针对两个具有大规模平行环境的人群而培训的:运动跟踪环境训练有密集运动跟踪目标,它使人类先于运动;以及泛化环境,其初始状态和目标被点名,对象成功奖励很少,这迫使技能远远偏离参考。 从每个技能的人类运动秒起,由此产生的政策可以学习各种适应性强的巧妙技能,例如功能把握,物体重置,用手指步态进行手动方向调整,以及像投掷和捕获这样的动态行为. 我们的方法在概括和功能方面超过了基线,我们展示了跨模拟器和向现实世界的转移。 项目网页:https://yuxuank.com/AdaDex/.

articles.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
articles.content: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UniWALM:健美机器人控制世界统一行动语言模型
articles.content_zh: 我们以人的能力为动力,将不同语言、认知和行动的经验综合起来,引入了UniWALM,一种统一的世界行动语言模式,在单一的共同代表中学习视频、行动和语言,其中每种模式既是调节信号,又是监督目标。 我们问:共同生成语言能丰富这种共同的表述,改善操纵,支持依赖记忆的行为吗? 与以往将推理或视觉语言模型附在视频动作主干线上并作为不同阶段运行的方法不同,UniWALM统一了单一的混合转换器主干线内的所有三种模式,其通式扩散头像动作一样,在没有单独规划阶段的动作中,在同一个通道中,共同隐藏,解码子任务和文字内存;生成的语言在下一个步骤上重新消耗,关闭一个语言-as-memory循环,没有外部规划器或内存库. 为了在这一更加丰富的目标下保持行动流的可靠性,我们进一步引入了 " 流动与校正匹配 " (FMC)这一培训目标,它教人们从扰动的动作轨迹中恢复而无需花费推论时间。 UniWALM在同背骨基线(如FastWAM)上,在构件挑置和位置(英语:MolmoSpaces)上,以及整个依赖内存的子集人民币币(Mypunch)上,不断改进,在没有经过任何预先训练的语言或推理模型的情况下达到34.5%,并且仅使用单一锚架就超过了Mem-0的键框设备设置(28.5%). 在现实世界中寻找项目的任务中,生成文字内存将成功率从11.1%提高到61.1%,而最新技术的VLA则处于或低于机会(QQ33.3%)。

articles.title: PsycheMME: A Psychology-Informed Benchmark for Social Understanding and Interaction in Videos
articles.content: Understanding human needs and selecting responses require distinct judgments that aggregate accuracy can obscure. We introduce PsycheMME, a video benchmark informed by psychology, with eight capabilities spanning grounding, states, needs, interaction decisions, memory, and risk. Drawing on Social Information Processing and the Perception-Action Cycle, this organization separates human understanding from response selection. We construct 1,000 questions from 630 episodes through independent answering with proposed references withheld and expert review. Our Reasoning-Verified protocol weights answer credit by the support and logical consistency of explicit rationales against annotated cues. Across 17 models, Timing has the lowest Verified scores and credit retention, with weaker support judgments for correct Timing answers. Models with similar Need scores still differ in answer completeness on open questions. Input controls and SFT/GRPO examine context dependence and adaptation. Evaluating answers alongside rationales locates where models fail across understanding, response selection, and justification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PSYEMME:视频中社会理解和互动的心理学成形基准
articles.content_zh: 了解人类需要和选择对策需要不同的判断,而总体准确性可能模糊不清。 我们引入了PhysicleMME, 一个基于心理学的视频基准, 拥有八种能力, 包括地面、状态、需求、互动决定、记忆和风险。 本组织利用社会信息处理和观念-行动周期,将人类理解与反应选择区分开来。 通过独立回答,我们从630集中构建了1 000个问题,建议不提供参考和专家审查。 我们的理性 - 验证协议权重 通过支持和逻辑上一致 明确的理由与附加说明的提示。 在17个模型中,计时的得分和信用保留率最低,对正确计时答案的支持判断较弱。 需要分数相似的模型在回答问题的完整性方面仍有差异。 输入控制和SFT/GPRO审查上下文的依赖性和适应性. 评估答案和理由,确定模型在理解、反应选择和理由方面失败之处。

articles.title: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
articles.content: Spatial intelligence has recently been assessed through generative tasks such as spatially grounded image editing, yet language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial multi-view observations remains underexplored. We introduce MindView, a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence with 1,500 samples from 513 scenes across three indoor datasets. Its seven tasks form two families: geometry-dominant tasks specify changes in camera position and orientation, while semantics-dominant tasks require inferring target viewpoints by grounding referred objects and interpreting spatial relations and reference-frame cues. Evaluation of eleven generators reveals substantial room for improvement on MindView. A paired context analysis further shows that all eleven generators obtain lower overall scores under the expanded context setting. These findings motivate us to investigate whether task-specific supervision can improve target-view generation and whether models can use additional multi-view evidence effectively. We therefore fine-tune BAGEL on the MindView training dataset, improving its overall score by 24.3 points and yielding gains across all seven MindView tasks. Beyond these generation gains, the fine-tuned model also yields higher scores on three spatial-understanding benchmarks without training on their annotations, suggesting that learning to generate spatially grounded views may benefit spatial understanding. To improve evidence utilization under expanded context, we propose MindCue, a training-free spatial evidence selector guided by a target-view hypothesis. MindCue reverses the drop in overall score under expanded context and outperforms the standard-context baseline. Overall, MindView provides a concrete testbed for generative multi-view spatial intelligence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MindView:制定通用多维空间情报基准
articles.content_zh: 最近通过基于空间的图像编辑等基因任务对空间情报进行了评估,但从部分多视图观测中生成的以语言为指南的空间一致性观点仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们引入了MindView,这是基因多景空间智能的基准,拥有来自513场景的1500个样本,跨越三个室内数据集. 它的七项任务组成了两个家族:几何主导任务规定了相机位置和方向的变化,而语义主导任务则需要通过对被推荐对象的定位以及解释空间关系和参考框架提示来推断目标角度. 对11台发电机的评价表明,MindView有相当大的改进余地。 一种对齐的上下文分析进一步表明,所有11台发电机在扩展上下文设置下的总分较低。 这些调查结果激励我们调查具体任务的监督能否改善目标视角生成,模型是否能够有效利用更多的多视角证据. 因此,我们在MindView培训数据集上对BAGEL进行了微调,将其总分提高24.3分,并在MindView的所有7项任务中都取得了收益. 除了这些生成收益外,经过微调的模型还可以在三个空间理解基准上获得更高的分数,而无需对其说明进行培训,这表明学习生成基于空间的观点可能有利于空间理解。 为了在扩大的范围内改进证据的利用,我们提议MindCue,一个以目标-观点假设为指导的无培训空间证据选择器。 MindCue在扩展语境下逆转整体分数的下降,并超越标准语句基线. 总体而言,MindView为基因多视角空间智能提供了具体的测试床.

articles.title: KoalaGS: Complexity-Aware Continuous Level of Detail for Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Deploying a trained 3D Gaussian Splatting scene under shrinking compute budgets requires one primitive set to remain effective when rendered at smaller prefixes. In this continuous level of detail (LoD) setting, the challenge is to decide which Gaussians should retain capacity as the budget decreases. A pilot study on 3DGS-MCMC reconstructions shows that image complexity, computed from the input views before optimization, predicts where reconstruction error concentrates in image and 3D space. It also reveals that simple regions contain too many Gaussians and degrade as much as complex ones at lower budgets, despite being inherently cheaper to represent. Subsequently, in KoalaGS, during training we use this complexity prior to bias relocation toward poorly reconstructed areas while ensuring smooth degradation across LoDs. A primitive importance score then enables inference at low-capacity, while preserving the scene structure. Tested across three datasets, KoalaGS maintains competitive full-capacity quality while significantly improving quality across the budget spectrum, yielding smoother transitions across LoDs, and enabling faster progressive streaming.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: KoalaGS: 高斯镀层的复杂- 智能连续详细水平
articles.content_zh: 在压缩的计算预算下部署训练有素的3D高斯电镀场景,需要一台原始设备,在较小的前缀上提供时才能继续有效。 在这种连续的详细(LOD)设置中,挑战在于决定哪个高斯人应该随着预算的减少而保留能力. 对3DGS-MCMC重建的试点研究表明,在优化前根据输入视图计算出的图像复杂度,预测重建错误集中在图像和3D空间的地方. 这也揭示了简单的地区包含太多高斯人,在低预算下退化的程度和复杂程度一样,尽管其代表的内在成本较低. 之后,在KoalaGS, 在培训期间,我们利用这种复杂性,先偏向于向重建不良的地区迁移,同时确保整个LODs的平稳退化。 原始的重要性得分后,在低容量时就可以推论,同时保留场景结构. 通过三个数据集的测试,KoalaGS保持了具有竞争力的全容量质量,同时大大改进了整个预算范围的质量,实现了更平稳地跨LODs的过渡,并能够更快地进行渐进流化。

articles.title: Neural Implicit Energy Optimization for LiDAR Mapping
articles.content: Neural implicit representations provide memory-efficient signed distance field (SDF) parameterizations for large-scale LiDAR scenes, but the geometry recovered from sparse and often noisy inputs carries jitter and artifacts. Classical geometric optimization techniques resolve such artifacts with surface energy functionals, whose minimizers correspond to smooth surfaces. Motivated by this principle, we formulate neural LiDAR mapping as the optimization of energy functionals over the parameter space of neural implicit representations. Specifically, we regularize the signed distance field with an energy functional defined on the shape operator of its level set, which represents the curvature of the surface, thus encouraging smoothness along the surface. This adapts classical geometric priors to the scale of million-point LiDAR maps. Experiments on large-scale datasets show reconstructions with improved smoothness at preserved geometric fidelity, and no additional inference-time cost. The code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LiDAR 绘图的神经内含能量优化
articles.content_zh: 神经隐含表示为大型LiDAR场景提供内存高效的签名距离域(SDF)参数化,但从稀疏且经常吵闹的输入中恢复的几何学携带着焦躁和文物. 古典几何优化技术用表面能量功能解决这种文物,其最小化器与平滑的表面相对应. 基于这个原理,我们将神经LiDAR映射作为能量功能在神经隐含表达的参数空间上的优化. 具体地说,我们用其水平集的形状操作器上定义的能量功能来规范已签名的距离场,这代表了表面的曲率,从而鼓励了表面的光滑. 这使得古典几何前缀适应了百万点LiDAR地图的规模. 对大型数据集的实验显示,在保存的几何忠诚度下,重建的光滑度有所提高,没有额外的推论时间成本. 该代码在\href{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}{https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/nieo}公开发布.

articles.title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
articles.content: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过点轨迹预测学习4D世界
articles.content_zh: 可靠的多视图预报需要来自不同相机的视频来描述同一演化中的3D场景. 为此,我们引入了Video-Point Model(VPM),这是一个以多视图视频历史为条件的世界模型,以及从任意观点和持续场景点的3D轨迹联合预测未来视频的语言教学. 我们扩展了预先训练的世界模型,采用相机条件的多视点处理,将相机之间的互补观测整合,并增加一个预测物理点如何穿越时间的轨迹头. 每个轨迹都追踪到所有视线上的单一点, 并监督这些轨迹与视频生成, 为了支持培训和评估,我们建立了VPM-Data,一个模拟设备,将同步多视图视频与持续点轨迹对齐,以及VP-World Bench,一个跨越模拟和真实环境的预测基准。 我们进一步将VPM扩展至机器人控制,在生成器中加入机器人动作作为象征性模式. 行动标志共享点监督主干线,并与未来视频联合解析,从而将政策建立在相同的3D-意识代表中. 在VP-World Bench和现有的4D生成基准上,点表监督在视频专用对等器上既提高了视频忠诚度,也提高了3D运动精度,在模拟和真机器人实验中,它也提高了动作驱动模型的操纵成功率.

articles.title: WildMAE: Structure-Aware Masked Autoencoding for Wildlife Image Reconstruction
articles.content: Camera-trap imagery presents substantial variation in animal appearance, illumination, background clutter, and visual degradation. Masked autoencoders (MAEs) offer a label-free framework for modeling such data through reconstruction of randomly hidden image patches. We present WildMAE, a decoder-side extension of MAE that combines local structure-aware refinement with masked-to-visible cross-attention. A zero-gated convolutional residual path introduces a two-dimensional neighborhood prior, while gated cross-attention allows masked positions to retrieve contextual information from visible-position features without replacing the original Transformer decoder. The associated training recipe progressively introduces normalized-pixel, Sobel-edge, and perceptual objectives. In the original Snapshot Serengeti study, covering 4,744 test images at 75% masking, the reported reconstruction scores were 27.90 versus 24.33 dB PSNR, 0.840 versus 0.780 SSIM, and 0.160 versus 0.320 LPIPS for WildMAE and vanilla MAE, respectively. Additional historical records document favorable average differences under four synthetic degradation conditions and describe component variants. We present the method, experimental observations, and their scope together: the retained metrics are historical protocol-dependent results, rather than a newly reproduced, harmonized comparison or a validation of restoration from genuinely unavailable pixels. WildMAE provides a practical architectural case study for combining global token mixing with spatial and targeted contextual refinement in wildlife masked-image modeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WildMAE:用于野生动物图像重建的结构-智能蒙面自动编码
articles.content_zh: 相机捕捉图象在动物外观、照明、背景杂乱以及视觉退化方面有很大差异。 Masked自动编码器(MAEs)提供了一个无标签的框架,通过随机隐藏的图像补丁重建来建模这类数据. 我们介绍WildMAE,这是MAE的解码器侧展,它结合了局部结构感知的改进和蒙面对可见的交叉注意. 零格化的折叠残余路径在之前引入了二维邻接,而门化的交叉意向则允许遮蔽位置从可见位置特征中获取背景信息,而无需替换原来的变形器解码器. 相关的培训方法逐步引入了规范的像素、索贝尔尖端和感知目标。 在最初的Snapshot Serengeti研究中,覆盖了4,744个装有75%面具的测试图像,所报道的重建分数分别为27.90比24.33 dB PSNR,0.840比0.780 SSIM,以及0.160比0.320 LPIPS为WildMAE和vanilla MAE. 其他历史记录记录了在四种合成降解条件下有利的平均差异,并描述了组成部分变体。 我们把方法,实验观测及其范围一并提出:所保留的度量衡是历史协议所依赖的结果,而不是从真正无法使用的像素中重新复制、统一比较或确认恢复。 WildMAE提供了一个实用的建筑案例研究,将全球标志性混合与野生动植物遮掩图像模型的空间和有针对性的背景改进结合起来。

articles.title: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
articles.content: Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. Across diverse inputs, SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D placement while keeping the reconstructed scenes physically stable. Furthermore, SceneRig is effective for downstream robotics: its scenes predict real-robot policy outcomes more accurately than the baseline method and more reliably support replay of recorded manipulations without trajectory adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SceneRig:用于模拟的代理系统——从单一图像中进行3D场景重建
articles.content_zh: 模拟是机器人的强大工具,但是在规模上建造多样的,模拟准备的场景仍然很困难. 从单一图像中重建场景是一个很有希望的替代方案,但光是视觉相似性是不够的:物体也必须被回收,准确放置,并被实际禁足. 依靠后热物理沉淀的现有方法常常会错置物体,产生看起来正确但行为不善的场景. 我们介绍SceneRig, 一个代理系统,将一个单一的图像变成一个可以编辑,模拟的场景。 SceneRig结合几何,视觉,和物理工具重建忠实的3D场景. 然后一个代理在物理模拟器内进行编辑与验证循环,以实现物理稳定性. 在各种投入中,SceneRig改进了实例分割,以对象为中心的外观,以及3D布置,同时保持重建后的场景物理稳定. 此外,SceneRig对下游机器人很有效:它的场景比基线方法更准确地预测了真机器人政策结果,并且更可靠地支持在不进行轨迹调整的情况下重播记录的操纵.

articles.title: Can a Display Be Used for Rapid LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration?
articles.content: ScreenCalib enables light detection and ranging (LiDAR)--camera extrinsic calibration using an ordinary programmable display, providing known visual markers and controlled geometry while reducing dedicated target preparation. The camera observes displayed AprilTags, whereas the LiDAR measures the physical screen surface and boundary, requiring indirect cross-modal association. Display geometry introduces association ambiguities, while indoor clutter complicates extraction. ScreenCalib addresses these challenges through tag-guided display extraction, geometric hypothesis generation and refinement, and surrounding scene edges for ambiguity resolution. The single-pose mode requires only one static placement. The joint multi-pose mode combines independent static observations through cross-pose consensus and jointly refines the shared extrinsics and tag scale, reducing sensitivity to tag-size measurement errors without requiring continuous motion or inter-pose trajectory estimation. Experiments in simulation and on three different sensor platforms cover mechanical and nonrepetitive LiDARs in clean and cluttered environments. Benchmark results show that ScreenCalib outperforms competitive calibration-board-based methods in translation accuracy. Joint multi-pose refinement further reduces mean rotation and translation errors across the three platforms and improves rendered-map alignment. Evaluation across readily available displays, including cell phones, tablets, laptops, computer monitors, and televisions, further examines ScreenCalib's versatility as a practical alternative to dedicated calibration targets. The source code is available at https://github.com/ZuhaoZou2026/ScreenCalib.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 显示是否可用于快速LiDAR- Camera extrinsic校准 ?
articles.content_zh: ScreenCalib可以使用普通可编程显示器进行光探测和测距(LiDAR)-摄像头校准,提供已知的视觉标记和控制几何,同时减少专用目标准备. 摄像头显示的是April Tags,而LiDAR测量物理屏幕表面和边界,需要间接的跨模式结合。 显示几何会引入关联模糊性,而室内杂交则会使提取复杂化. ScreenCalib通过标记制导的显示提取,几何假说生成和完善,以及周围的场景边缘以模糊分辨率来应对这些挑战. 单pose模式只需要一个静态放置. 联合多pose模式通过交叉pose共识将独立的静态观测结合起来,并联合完善共享的外延和标记尺度,降低对标记大小测量误差的敏感度,而不需要连续运动或交叉pose轨迹估计. 模拟实验和在三个不同的传感器平台上进行的实验覆盖了清洁和杂乱环境中的机械和非重复的LiDARs. 基准结果表明,ScreenCalib在翻译准确性方面优于竞争性校准板方法。 联合多功能改进进一步减少三个平台的均值旋转和翻译错误,改善渲染图的对齐. 包括手机、平板电脑、笔记本电脑、计算机显示器和电视在内的现成显示器的评价,进一步审查了ScreenCalib的多功能性,将其作为专用校准目标的一种实用的替代办法。 源代码见https://github.com/ZuhaoZou2026/ScreenCalib.

articles.title: Continual Concept Personalization in Diffusion Models via Residual-Space Adaptation
articles.content: Text-to-image personalization aims to equip pretrained diffusion models with the ability to learn user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. Existing methods, however, typically train each concept independently or assume that all concepts are available simultaneously. In practical applications, concepts often arrive sequentially, requiring models to continually learn new subjects, objects, or styles while minimizing interference with previously acquired concepts. We address this continual concept personalization setting by extending residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models. Our work achieves the highest concept fidelity among competing continual personalization methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Beyond these empirical gains, the learned residual-space dynamics reveal where adaptation capacity is concentrated within the diffusion model. Restricting adaptation to the identified layers by our method preserves nearly the same performance while reducing the number of trainable parameters by up to 72\%, demonstrating that residual-space dynamics can identify the layers that contribute most to continual concept personalization and directly guide more parameter-efficient adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过残余空间适应在扩散模型中持续实现概念个性化
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像的个性化旨在为预先训练的传播模型配备能力,能够仅从少数参考图像中学习用户特有的概念. 然而,现有方法通常独立地培训每个概念,或假设所有概念同时存在。 在实际应用中,概念往往依次出现,要求模型不断学习新的科目,对象或风格,同时尽量减少对先前获得的概念的干扰. 我们处理这种持续的概念个性化设定,将剩余空间适应扩大到预先训练的传播模型的有条理的适应过程。 我们的工作在相互竞争的不断个性化方法中实现了最高的概念忠诚,同时保持几乎零的遗忘。 除了这些经验性成果外,所学到的剩余空间动态揭示了适应能力集中在传播模式内的地方。 通过我们的方法限制对已识别层的适应,几乎保持了相同的性能,同时将可训练参数的数量减少多达72%%,表明剩余空间动态能够识别最有助于持续概念个性化的层,并直接引导更具参数效率的适应.

articles.title: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
articles.content: Despite the success of video world models, extending them to multiple agents is difficult because it requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent in time and between agents. To address this gap, we introduce OverSeer, a multi-agent world model that augments egocentric agent views with auxiliary camera views. We suggest that, by fixing the auxiliary views in space, they act as a proxy for a world-centric representation: Unlike the agents' views, which can change entirely due to a simple change in agent position, changes in the auxiliary views directly map to localized changes in the world state. We show that these fixed views substantially help the model to maintain consistency. We also show that, due to their redundant and semi-static nature, the auxiliary views can be efficiently compressed with a delta-VAE that encodes only the changes relative to a static reference image, reducing the number of tokens required to process them. Experiments in Minecraft and Doom demonstrate improved world and agent consistency, with qualitative results on real-world multi-camera captures indicating that the approach is not tied to game engines. Our compression analysis further shows that delta-VAE substantially reduces the computational overhead of auxiliary-view generation. We conclude that these fixed views provide a simple and efficient way to improve multi-agent world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 浏览器:多代理世界模式超越代理
articles.content_zh: 尽管视频世界模式取得了成功,但是将其推广到多个代理是困难的,因为它需要生成数个在时间和代理之间一致的针对代理的视频流. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了OverSeerr,一种多代理世界模型,通过辅助摄像头视图来增强以自我为中心的代理视图. 我们建议,通过确定空间中的辅助观点,它们充当以世界为中心的代表: 与代理人观点不同的是,由于代理人位置的简单改变,代理人观点可以完全改变,辅助观点的改变直接映射到世界状态的局部变化. 我们表明,这些固定观点大大有助于模式保持一致性。 我们还表明,由于其冗余和半静态的性质,辅助视图可以通过只编码相对于静态参考图像的变化的三角洲-VAE来有效压缩,从而减少处理它们所需的令牌数量. Minecraft 和 Doom 的实验展示了世界和剂一致性的改善,关于现实世界多相机捕捉的定性结果表明,这个方法没有与游戏引擎挂钩. 我们的压缩分析进一步显示,Derta-VAE大大降低了辅助视图生成的计算间接费用. 我们的结论是,这些固定的观点为改进多代理世界模式提供了简单有效的途径。

articles.title: Predictive Latents for Autoregressive Language Models: Possibility, Gauge, and Obstruction
articles.content: Autoregressive language models are trained by next-token cross-entropy, yet several recent systems also iterate a hidden state without emitting a token: continuous thoughts, pause steps, and recurrent depth. This note separates three risks on one latent process. The token risk $R_{\mathrm{tok}}$ scores a readout. The teacher-forced latent risk $R_1$ scores a one-step map that sees the true hidden state. The open-loop risk $R_H$ scores the same map after it has been iterated on its own outputs. If the Bayes next-token posterior is a function of a $k$-dimensional statistic with full-rank covariance, a width-$k$ latent, a linear least-squares transition, and a refit unembedding match the Bayes token predictor. The statistic is identified only up to an invertible gauge: whitening the residual stream does not change the token law once the unembedding is refit. The matching obstructions are sharp. A constant latent drives $R_1$ to zero while token cross-entropy falls back to the marginal entropy. A perfect token predictor can still hide a null-space walk whose open-loop error grows linearly in the horizon. A small next-latent loss does not certificate next-token prediction, and a small next-token loss does not certificate free latent rollout, unless a rank or injectivity condition is stated with the number.

articles.title: CoGaussian: Open-Vocabulary Gaussian-based Collaborative 3D Scene Understanding
articles.content: Collaborative perception enables agents to retrieve the scene semantics and geometry beyond the field of view of any individual agent. This broader scene understanding enhances transportation safety and improves efficiency in multi-robot systems. However, existing collaborative semantic occupancy methods rely on dense 3D voxel annotations and are limited to recognizing objects within a predefined set of semantic classes. To overcome these limitations, we present CoGaussian, an open-vocabulary Gaussian-based collaborative semantic occupancy prediction framework. CoGaussian represents a scene as a set of foundation model-aligned sparse 3D Gaussians, which serve as a compact representation for communicating and fusing geometric and semantic information across multiple agents. On the Semantic-OPV2V benchmark, our method outperforms existing open-vocabulary single-agent approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of open-vocabulary collaborative scene understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 科高士语: 开放式词汇高斯合作3D场景理解
articles.content_zh: 协作感知使特工能够获取场景语义和几何学,超越任何单个代理人的视野. 这种更广泛的场景理解增强了运输安全,提高了多机器人系统的效率. 然而,现有的协作语义占用方法依赖于密集的3D voxel注解,并且仅限于在预定义的一组语义类中识别对象. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了CoGaussian,一个开放式的、基于高斯语的合作语义占用预测框架。 CoGausian代表的场景是一组基础模型对齐的稀疏的3D Gaussians,它作为一个紧凑的表示,用于跨越多种物剂进行几何和语义信息的交流和交流. 在语义-OPV2V基准上,我们的方法优于现有的开放-省单剂方法,突出了开放-省合作场景理解的有效性.

articles.title: Copyright Leakage Detection in AI Generated Videos
articles.content:
Video generation models can create realistic-looking video footage from images and text prompts. Some of the recent advances have raised concerns about the reproduction of copyrighted visual content. However, copyright leakage detection in generated videos remains largely unexplored.
  In this paper, we introduce a new benchmark data set for copyright leakage detection, comprising 50 copyrighted concepts, each with 5 images. For each concept, we have 5 videos created using the image+prompt video generation model and the prompt-only video generation model. Following that, we develop an AI toolset based on a contrastive retrieval framework that formulates copyright leakage detection as a video-to-image retrieval problem by matching aggregated video frame embeddings against a database of copyrighted image embeddings. Our method uses a single similarity threshold and retrieves the most similar copyrighted reference as supporting evidence.
  We conducted experiments showing strong retrieval and detection performance, achieving 99.6\% detection accuracy with only a single false negative. These results show the effectiveness of the retrieval-based method for scalable and explainable copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos. Data can be accessed publicly from https://zenodo.org/records/21386117 and the source code for this project is publicly available at https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-Leakage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AI 生成的视频中的泄漏探测
articles.content_zh:
视频生成模型可以从图像和文本提示中创建现实的外观视频镜头. 最近的一些进展引起了人们对版权视觉内容复制的关注. 然而,在生成的视频中发现版权泄漏的情况基本上仍未得到探讨。
在本文中,我们引入了一套新的版权泄漏探测基准数据集,包含50个版权概念,每个概念有5个图像. 对于每个概念,我们有5个视频使用图像+即时视频生成模型和即时视频生成模型创建. 之后,我们开发了基于对比性检索框架的AI工具集,通过将嵌入的汇总视频帧与版权图像嵌入数据库相匹配,将版权渗漏检测定为视频到图像检索问题. 我们的方法使用一个单一的相似性阈值,并检索最相似的版权引用作为佐证.
我们进行了试验,显示有很强的检索和探测性能,达到99.6XX的探测精度,只有一种假阴性. 这些结果显示了基于检索的方法在AI生成的视频中可伸缩和可解释的版权泄漏检测的有效性. 数据可在https://zenodo.org/records/21386117上公开查阅。 该项目的源代码可在https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-leakage上公开查阅。

articles.title: VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
articles.content: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VLM - 指导联系人重新定位和人类-人类互动的基因伙伴模型
articles.content_zh: 人与人的互动需要机器人在严重的部分可观察性下操作:在密切的物理接触中,人的伴侣被占有,截断,或者在机器人视野之外,导致姿势估计失败,并经常需要外部跟踪或特权的人类状态. 同时,沉重的相互隔离也给用于学习的人类-人类运动捕捉数据带来了错误. 我们提出REACT,这是从人与人示威中学习可部署的人与人互动政策的框架。 REACT将语义接触结构作为连接演示处理,互动学习,以及机载控制的关键监督信号. 首先,由VLM制导的接触模型和重定向管道确定具有重大意义的联系人并将其转移到人-人几何上,同时保持相互作用结构。 利用这些说明,特权互动政策通过互动感知接触的奖励来学习基于身体的行为,然后被提炼成可部署的自我中心深度政策,完全通过光现实的人类深度渲染从船上的感知得到训练。 为解决严重的部分可观察性问题,我们引入了基因伙伴状态模型化目标,从隐蔽的自我中心观点预测伙伴运动. 我们通过模拟和真实的Unitree G1类人造生物对REACT进行评估,涉及五种接触丰富的相互作用。 语义性接触模型大大改进了对已证明的相互作用的保存,而基因性伙伴-状态模型则改进了对五种相互作用中四种相互作用的接触记忆,大多数是在重聚下。 在真正的硬件上,REACT单独使用机载感知来进行所有五个相互作用.

articles.title: Latent Bridge: From Video Latents to 3D Geometry via Feature Alignment
articles.content: Video generation and feed-forward 3D reconstruction typically use separate representations, requiring RGB decoding and visual re-encoding to recover geometry from generated latents. We propose Latent Bridge, which connects video generative latent spaces with geometric feature spaces to directly predict 3D geometry from video latents. We develop representation-specific bridges for Wan2.1 and V-RAE, enabling feed-forward prediction of cameras, depth, and 3D point clouds without the intermediate RGB pathway. Each bridge is trained on RGB videos through feature distillation, while the video encoder and geometry model remain frozen. Training requires neither ground-truth geometry nor execution of the downstream geometric aggregator or prediction heads. At inference, the same video latents support both RGB decoding and geometry prediction. The same trained bridge can be reused for image-to-video and text-to-video generation within the same video latent space, without bridge retraining. Experiments on Co3Dv2 and WildRGB-D demonstrate competitive geometric reconstruction quality, efficient end-to-end generation and reconstruction, and faster latent-to-geometry decoding, highlighting latent alignment as a practical and reusable interface between video generation and 3D reconstruction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hustvl/Latent-Bridge.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Latent 桥: 从视频 Latents 到 通过特性对齐的 3D 几何
articles.content_zh: 视频生成和feed-forward 3D重建通常使用单独的表达方式,要求RGB解码和视觉重编码从产生的潜伏物中恢复几何. 我们提出Latent Bridge,将视频基因潜伏空间与几何特征空间连接起来,从视频潜伏中直接预测3D几何. 我们为Wan2.1和V-RAE开发具有代表性的桥梁,从而能够对摄像机、深度和没有中间RGB路径的3D点云进行向导预测。 每座桥通过特征蒸馏对RGB视频进行培训,而视频编码器和几何模型仍然冷冻. 培训既不需要地面真实几何,也不需要执行下游几何聚合器或预测头。 推论,同样的视频潜伏支持RGB解码和几何预测. 同样的训练有素的桥可以在同一个视频潜在空间内用于图像到视频和文本到视频生成,而无需桥面再培训. Co3Dv2和WildRGB-D的实验展示了具有竞争力的几何重建质量,高效的端对端生成与重建,以及更快的潜伏到几何解码,强调潜在对接是视频生成与3D重建之间的实用和可重复使用的界面. 我们的代码见:https://github.com/hustvl/Latent-Bridge。

articles.title: Touch-JEPA: Tactile Representation Learning from Hand-Object Video with Limited Tactile Supervision
articles.content: Understanding contact and tactile magnitude in hand-object interaction is a key step toward physically intelligent systems, yet learning such representations is limited by the cost and restricted coverage of tactile measurements. We present Touch-JEPA, a framework for learning tactile representations from hand-object videos with limited tactile supervision. We first introduce a self-supervised pretraining objective that learns from video alone without tactile supervision. Using video-derived hand geometry, Touch-JEPA predicts masked visual features at corresponding hand-surface locations from spatial and temporal context, encouraging the representation to capture latent contact dynamics. We then extend this formulation to joint representation learning, where masked prediction is applied to all videos while tactile supervision is available only for a labeled subset, grounding the shared representation in measured contact and magnitude. With self-supervised pretraining alone, simple supervised readouts on frozen Touch-JEPA features outperform supervised baselines in contact discrimination and tactile magnitude estimation across three human-hand benchmarks, and transfer to robotic hands without robot tactile training data. Joint learning with limited tactile supervision further improves contact and magnitude estimation on the human-hand benchmarks. Together, these results show that hand-object video can provide scalable self-supervision for tactile representation learning, while limited tactile measurements provide complementary physical grounding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Touch-JEPA:Tactile代表与有限Tactile监督从手-对象视频学习
articles.content_zh: 了解手物体相互作用中的接触量和触觉量是朝着物理智能系统迈出的关键一步,然而,学习这种表达因触觉测量的成本和覆盖范围有限而受到限制。 我们介绍Touch-JEPA,这是在有限的触觉监督下从手物体视频中学习触觉表现的框架。 我们首先引入了一个自我监督的预训目标,这个目标单独从视频中学习而无需触觉监督. Touch-JEPA利用视频衍生的手几何技术,从空间和时间角度预测相应手表位置的蒙面视觉特征,鼓励表现以捕捉潜在的接触动态. 然后,我们把这一提法扩大到联合代表学习,即对所有视频采用蒙蔽的预测,而触觉监督只用于标有标签的子集,从而将共享的表示建立在测量接触和规模的基础上。 单靠自我监督的预训,在冷冻的Touch-JEPA上简单的有监督的读取功能在接触歧视和触觉大小估计上就超过了监督的基线,在三种人手基准上,在没有机器人触觉训练数据的情况下转移到机器人手中。 在有限的触觉监督下进行联合学习,进一步改善了接触和对人手基准的规模估计。 这些结果一起表明,手物视频可以为触觉表现学习提供可伸缩的自超视觉,而有限的触觉测量则提供互补的物理地面.

articles.title: SenseAlign: Understanding Vision and Touch through Language at Test Time
articles.content: Tactile-visual-language models combine vision and touch through a shared language space to recognize objects and materials. In real-world deployment, changes in lighting, contact quality or sensor hardware can shift visual or tactile inputs and degrade recognition performance. When both modalities contribute to a prediction, an unreliable modality can override correct evidence from the other. Since labeled data are generally unavailable during deployment, test-time adaptation offers a way to recover recognition performance from unlabeled observations. In this setting, we find that comparing accumulated observations with the text embeddings of candidate classes reveals modality reliability differences that confidence can miss. Refining features against competing classes also improves recognition beyond geometric alignment alone. These findings motivate SenseAlign, which uses a common semantic reference for test-time modality weighting and feature correction. Alignment Trust weights each modality according to its support for shared predicted classes. Anchor Realignment uses the same class text embeddings to fit a shared feature correction that separates predicted classes from alternatives. Both modules use the same unlabeled history while keeping all encoders frozen. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate strong recognition performance under both natural shifts and controlled corruptions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 感官对齐:测试时通过语言理解视觉和触摸
articles.content_zh: Tactile-visual-language模型通过共享语言空间将视觉和触摸结合起来,以识别物体和材料. 在现实世界部署中,照明,接触质量或感应硬件的改变可以转移视觉或触觉输入,降低识别性能. 当两种模式都有助于预测时,一种不可靠的模式可以推翻另一种模式提供的证据。 由于贴标签的数据在部署期间一般无法获取,试验时间的适应提供了从未贴标签的观测中恢复识别性能的方法. 在此情况下,我们发现,将累积的观察结果与嵌入候选类别的案文进行比较,会发现信任可能缺失的模式可靠性差异。 精炼与相互竞争的阶级相比的特征,也增进了仅几何校对之外的认知. 这些发现激励了SenseAlign,它使用通用的语义参考来进行测试时模式的加权和特征校正. 根据信托基金对共享预测类别的支持,对每个模式进行对齐加权。 Anchor Regignment使用相同的类文本嵌入,以适应一个将预测类与替代类分开的共享特征修正. 两个模块都使用相同的无标签历史,同时保持所有编码器的冻结. 各种数据集的广泛实验表明,在自然变化和受控制的腐败中,识别性能很强。

articles.title: Deep Learning-Based Road Lane Quality Assessment from Egocentric Dashcam Video
articles.content: Reliable lane markings are important for both human drivers and automated driving systems, but their condition is still commonly assessed through manual inspection. Existing autonomous-driving datasets primarily support lane detection and scene understanding and usually lack maintenance-oriented labels for lane-marking visibility, continuity, or degradation. In this study, we present a geo-referenced smartphone dashcam dataset and baseline framework for lane-marking quality assessment. The dataset contains 63,839 road-facing frames collected across South Texas using a GPS-enabled dashcam application. A subset of 3,339 frames is matched with OpenStreetMap-derived lane-count labels, which are used as weak supervision for lane-count regression and map-consistency evaluation. We propose three lane-quality measures: Contrast Stability Index (CSI), which captures lane-background contrast using Laplacian responses; Line Continuity Ratio (LCR), which estimates structural continuity using edge and Hough-line evidence; and Regression Lane Confidence Score (RLCS), which measures agreement between predicted and map-derived lane counts on matched frames. The baseline prediction models attained strong performance, with CSI (MAE $0.039$, $R^2=0.97$) and LCR (MAE $0.093$, $R^2=0.84$). Notably, CSI and LCR are no-reference, segmentation-derived quality metrics that can be computed without dense human labels. In a pilot validation using 50 human-ranked images, these proposed lane-specific metrics show stronger rank agreement with human lane-quality ordering (e.g., Spearman's $ρ=0.7316$ and Kendall's $τ=0.5472$ for LCR) than general image-quality measures such as PSNR, SSIM, BRISQUE, NIQE, and LPIPS. We believe the dataset, metrics, and baseline provide an initial step toward scalable, low-cost, location-aware lane-marking quality assessment. Data and code: https://github.com/Shaif95/Road_Quality
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 来自Egocentral Dashcam视频的基于学习的深路巷质量评估
articles.content_zh: 可靠的车道标志对人驾驶员和自动驾驶系统都很重要,但其状况仍然通常通过人工检查来评估. 现有的自动驾驶数据集主要支持车道检测和场景理解,通常缺乏面向维护的车道标识可见度,连续性,或退化的标签. 在这项研究中,我们提出了一个地理参考的智能手机破碎相机数据集和车道标记质量评估基线框架。 该数据集包含使用GPS启用的破烂相机应用程序在南德克萨斯州各地收集的63,839个路面框架. 3,339帧的子集与OpenStreetMap衍生的车道计数标签相匹配,它们被用作对车道计数回归和地图一致性评价的薄弱监督. 我们建议采取三个车道质量措施:对比稳定指数(CSI),该指数利用拉普拉西安反应来反映车道-背景对比;线路连续性比率(LCR),该指数利用边缘和Hough线证据来估计结构连续性;以及倒退巷信心计分(RLCS),该指数衡量预测的车道计数和地图推算的车道计数在相应框架上的一致。 基准预测模型表现良好,CSI(0.039美元、2雷亚尔=0.97美元)和LCR(0.093美元、2雷亚尔=0.84美元)。 值得注意的是,CSI和LCR是无参考,分化衍生的质量度量,可以在没有密集的人类标签的情况下计算出来. 在使用50个人排名图像的试点验证中,这些拟议的专用车道测量标准显示,与人类车道质量定单(如Spearman的0.7316美元和Kendall的0.5472美元换LCR)相比,PSNR,SSIM,BRISQUE,NIQE,LPIPS等一般图像质量措施的等级一致度更强. 我们认为,数据集、指标和基线是朝着可伸缩、低成本、位置识别车道质量评估迈出的第一步。 数据与代码:https://github.com/Shaif95/Road_Qality.

articles.title: GazeLens for Efficient Egocentric Video Question Answering with Simple Gaze-Driven Adaptive Token Reduction
articles.content: Smart glasses can help users understand their activities and surroundings, but small vision-language models must preserve useful evidence within limited computation. This is difficult because redundant frames consume the visual budget, while aggressive spatial compression can discard relevant details. Although gaze identifies the wearer's focus, the question may require evidence from the surrounding scene. To address these constraints, we propose GazeLens, which combines frame selection with gaze- and question-guided token reduction. First, HOG transitions and image sharpness select frames before visual encoding. For each selected frame, Gaussian pooling then forms gaze-focused and complementary summaries. Because their relevance depends on the question, a lightweight gate blends them into a primary token. Together with a global scene token, this retains both focused and contextual summaries within two tokens per frame. On StreamGaze, GazeLens achieves higher macro and micro accuracy than the evaluated full-grid and token-reduction baselines, with lower input-forward FLOPs than the shared-backbone token-reduction baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GazeLens 高效的 Egocentral 视频问题回答 简单 Gaze- Driven 适应性切除
articles.content_zh: 智能眼镜可以帮助用户了解自己的活动和周围环境,但小型视觉语言模型必须在有限的计算中保存有用的证据. 这很困难,因为冗余帧消耗了视觉预算,而积极的空间压缩可以丢弃相关的细节. 虽然凝视能辨别穿戴者的焦点,但这个问题可能需要周围场景提供证据. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议加泽伦斯,将框架选择与目光和问题引导的减少符号相结合。 首先,HOG过渡和图像锐度在视觉编码之前选择帧. 对每个选定的框架,高斯集合将形成重点突出和互补的摘要。 因为它们的相关性取决于问题,一个轻量级的门将它们融合成一个主符. 这与全球场景标志一起,保留了每个框架两个标志内的重点和背景摘要。 在StreamGaze上,GazeLens实现的宏观和微观精确度高于评估的全网格和信使减少基线,输入前FLOP比共享后骨信使减少基线更低.

articles.title: Learning from Automatic 3D Gaussian Splatting Edits for Online Bayesian Scene Change Detection
articles.content: Online scene change detection requires integrating incoming observations to determine which regions have changed relative to a reference scene. We update change beliefs as new images arrive using generalised Bayesian evidence fusion. However, the prior probability of change and evidence models are unknown beforehand, and numerical Bayesian inference can be costly. We address these challenges by learning offline from automatic edits to a reference 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model. These edits generate labelled training views without manual annotations. Together with unchanged reference observations, they provide supervision for learning scene-specific evidence models and estimating the effective pixel prior and response statistics. Online prediction combines current evidence with historical support, while closed-form local Bayes factors, parameterized by the learned response statistics, update an accumulated 3D Gaussian field. Object-guided refinement produces the final change masks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on PASLCD and CCS3D, with $67.64\%$ and $75.82\%$ mIoU, respectively. On PASLCD, the complete pipeline runs at $17.2$\,FPS over complete query sequences, the fastest among the evaluated online methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从自动3D Gaussian 镀层编辑器学习在线贝叶斯景色变化检测
articles.content_zh: 在线场景变化检测需要整合收到的观测结果,以确定哪些区域相对于参考场景发生了变化. 随着新图像的到来,我们更新了改变信念, 使用泛泛的巴伊西亚证据组合。 然而,先前的改变概率和证据模型是事先未知的,数字贝叶斯推论可能代价高昂. 我们通过从自动编辑到参考3D高斯电镀(3DGS)模型的离线学习来应对这些挑战. 这些编辑生成贴有标签的训练视图,而无需手动说明. 连同不变的参考观测,它们为学习场景特定证据模型和估计有效的像素前方和反应统计提供了监督. 在线预测将当前证据与历史支持相结合,同时封闭式本地贝叶因子,以学到的响应统计为参数,更新一个累积的3D高斯场. 对象制导的精细化产生最后的改变口罩. 我们的方法在PASLCD和CCS3D上实现了最先进的精确度,分别为67.64美元和75.82美元。 分别是mIoU. 在PASLCD上,整个管道运行于17.2美元\,FPS超过完整的查询序列,是评估的在线方法中最快的.

articles.title: CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
articles.content: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 闭合器:对物体-目标导航进行实证-智能主动视觉验证
articles.content_zh: 对象-目标导航(ObjectNav)要求一个被体现的代理在看不见的环境中找到一个特定类别的实例并停止靠近它. 毒剂一般依靠物体探测器,但必须在网上从有限的自我中心视频流(有时是单帧)判断,是否检测到的候选人是目标. 探测器经常自信地误读类似的物体,如一张床的沙发,而停留在假阳性上会使剧集失败. 现行制度也以贪婪的方式对待候选人,使他们处于或部分受到观察。 我们提出CLOSER,这是一个了解证据的积极核查框架,将停止作为获取闭路证据、将视觉语言模型(VLM)核查与主动感知相结合。 CLOSER对开源VLM进行微调,将跨帧跟踪的候选对象的每个视图标注为目标,非目标,或不确定,选择基于嵌入式多样性门的互补视图,并将其每个视图的概率与轻量级网络连接. 如果经调整的判断仍不确定,则扩散政策会促使代理人只使用履带面具和深度对候选人采取行动,直至作出决定。 CLOSER在当地运行,并插入现有的ObjectNav系统而不对其进行再培训. 在Gibson和Habitat-Matterport 3D上,它使平均成功率提高了3.6点,成功率按路径长度加权了2.0点,表明在承诺改进包含的导航之前核实证据。

articles.title: Answering in the User's Variety: Calibrated Accommodation Pairs for Post-Training
articles.content: People adapt how they talk to the person in front of them. However, chat models tend to respond in Standard English regardless of the dialect used by the user. A uniform answer can hide whether training treats these users alike, and output audits cannot tell as well. We trace how each post-training stage, from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning, changes a model's tendency to match the user, and read what each update prefers from two content-matched replies, one matching the user and one not. Across 10 open model lineages, post-training standardizes replies to every informal cue, yet after adjusting for how likely each reply already was, the DPO update still favours matching British and Australian spelling over AAE and Singlish on 10 lineages, and models still produce AAE features when asked. We then introduce calibrated accommodation pairs (CAP), preference data that reward matching users' dialect density while preserving Standard English for Standard-English users. On a fully open model, CAP raises convergence on features it was not trained on without a detectable increase in dialect for Standard-English users or a cost in instruction following. In contrast, one-sided pairs reach a similar gain only by overshooting the user and imposing dialect. Our findings show that uniform replies can hide selective updates and audits should read the update as well as the output. Code: https://github.com/kouzhizhuo/cap-accommodation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用用户的品种回答:校准的训练后住宿配对
articles.content_zh: 人们会适应他们如何和面前的人说话. 然而,聊天模式往往以标准英语回应,无论用户使用何种方言. 统一的答案可以隐藏培训是否一视同仁地对待这些用户,产出审计也无法分辨. 我们追踪每个培训后阶段,从有监督的微调(SFT)到偏好优化(DPO)和强化学习,如何改变一个模型与用户匹配的倾向,并阅读每个更新从两个内容匹配的回复中选择的,一个匹配用户,一个不匹配. 在10个开放的模范线条中,培训后将每个非正式线条的答复标准化,然而,在调整了每条线条答复的可能性之后,DPO更新版仍然倾向于在10条线条上将英国和澳大利亚的拼写比作AAE和Singlish,当被问及时,模型仍然产生AAE特征。 然后引入校准住宿配对(CAP),优先数据奖励匹配的用户方言密度,同时为标准英语用户保留标准英语. 在一个完全开放的模型中,CAP提高了对它所训练的特性的趋同,但没有为标准英语用户提供可察觉的方言增加,或者没有随后的教学费用。 相比之下,单面对子只通过过度射击用户和强加方言来达到类似的收益. 我们的调查结果表明,统一的答复可以隐藏有选择的更新,审计应该阅读更新和产出。 代码:https://github.com/kourzhizhuo/cap-acounter.

articles.title: LocaLeJEPA: Maximum Entropy Representations under Geometric Priors
articles.content: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer an appealing approach to self-supervised learning, but are typically prone to representation collapse. LeJEPA resolves this by introducing a theoretically grounded distribution-matching objective that drives the embedding towards an isotropic Gaussian. However, this approach is fundamentally tied to Euclidean assumptions, and its global target does not reflect domain-specific geometric priors, such as the use of non-Euclidean embedding geometries, e.g., equivariant CNNs or hyperbolic ViTs. We thus introduce LocaLeJEPA, a framework motivated by a manifold-theoretic reformulation of LeJEPA's entropy-maximization property. The accompanying LocaLeReg, a novel locally Euclidean distribution-matching regularizer, enables a stable and scalable implementation of the LocaLeJEPA framework. We then perform extensive experiments in the vision setting on models trained on ImageNet-1K. LocaLeJEPA significantly outperforms LeJEPA when paired with hyperbolic ViT-S/8 and equivariant ResNet-50 backbones, and also with ordinary Euclidean ViT-S/8 and ViT-L/14 backbones. This holds both in terms of linear and k-NN classification performance on ImageNet and on a series of downstream tasks tested. We view the LocaLeJEPA formalism as a principled approach to the JEPA paradigm that better respects intrinsic data geometry while also accommodating generalizations to exotic embedding geometries. Code available at https://github.com/alessioborgi/LocaLeJEPA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LocaleJEPA:几何前兆下的最大内涵
articles.content_zh: 联合预测架构(JEPA)为自我监督的学习提供了一种吸引人的方法,但通常容易出现代表性崩溃。 LeJEPA通过引入一个理论上基于分布比对的目标来解决这个问题,这个目标推动嵌入到异热带的高斯人身上. 然而,这种方法在本质上与欧几里得假设联系在一起,其全球目标并不反映特定域的几何前兆,例如使用非欧几里得嵌入几何前兆,例如等效的CNN或双曲维T. 因此,我们引入了LocaleJEPA,这个框架的动机是多理论重塑LeJEPA的肽-最大氧化物属性。 与之配套的LocaLeReg是当地一种新颖的Euclide分配比对调节器,它使得LocaLeJEPA框架得以稳定和可扩展的实施. 然后,我们在图像网-1K上培训的模型的远景设定中进行了广泛的实验。 LocaleJEPA在配对双曲ViT-S/8和等效ResNet-50骨干时,以及普通的Euclide ViT-S/8和ViT-L/14骨干时,其性能大大超过LeJEPA. 这在ImageNet上的线性能和k-NN分类性能上以及测试的一系列下游任务上都存在. 我们认为,LocaLeJEPA形式主义是对JEPA范式的原则性做法,它更好地尊重内在数据几何学,同时也顾及对异国情调嵌入几何的概括。 可在https://github.com/alessioborgi/LocaleJEPA查阅代码。

articles.title: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Omni LLMs can naturally locate key audio and visual evidence and integrate information across modalities for audiovisual reasoning. Existing audio-visual reasoning benchmarks that mainly rely on multiple-choice questions usually score models solely based on answer correctness, making it difficult to assess whether a model truly forms a reasoning chain from evidence to the correct answer. In addition, textual or unimodal shortcuts may allow models to answer correctly without analyzing the necessary audio-visual evidence, further weakening the reliability of evaluation benchmarks. To address these issues, we introduce EvaOmni, an evidence-grounded benchmark containing 392 videos and 1,027 purely human-annotated question-answer pairs, covering 15 capabilities and three levels: retrieval and localization, basic understanding, and complex reasoning. We design a series of rigorous annotation procedures in which experts annotate audio and visual evidence and construct video-based distractors; humans review whether questions meet strict inspection criteria, and finally models filter textual and unimodal shortcuts. Beyond high-quality question-answer pairs, we require models to simultaneously return the answer and supporting evidence intervals in order to evaluate the complete reasoning chain. We propose the Coverage Grounded Score (C.G.) to measure how much annotated evidence a model identifies, and the Bottleneck Grounded Score (B.G.) to penalize poor temporal localization in either modality; both are incorporated into answer correctness. Across 7 open-weight and 17 proprietary Omni LLMs, Gemini3.7-Flash achieved the highest overall accuracy (79.4%), C.G. (70.8%), and B.G. (35.1%). At Level 3, it reached 79.1% accuracy, but its B.G. was only 12.3%. These results show that even the most advanced models still have room for development in grounded audio-visual reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EvaOmni:视听理由证据组合基准
articles.content_zh: Omni LLMS可以自然地找到关键的视听证据,并整合各种视听推理方式的信息. 现有的主要依靠多选题的视听推理基准通常只根据答案正确性来评分模型,因此很难评估一个模型是否真的形成了从证据到正确答案的推理链. 此外,文字或单式快捷方式可能使模型在不分析必要的视听证据的情况下正确回答,从而进一步削弱了评价基准的可靠性。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了EvaOmni,这是一个循证基准,包含392个视频和1 027个纯粹人为附加说明的对答,涵盖15个能力和三个层面:检索和本地化、基本理解和复杂的推理。 我们设计了一系列严格的注释程序,专家们在其中对视听证据进行注释,并构建基于视频的分辨器;人类审查问题是否符合严格的检查标准,最后模拟过滤文本和单模式快捷方式。 除了高质量的问答对,我们需要模型同时返回答案和辅助证据间隔,以便评价完整的推理链. 我们提议采用 " 覆盖基准计分 " (C.G.)来衡量一个模型所识别的附加说明的证据,以及 " Bottleneck基准计分 " (B.G.)来惩罚两种模式中时间定位不当的现象;两者都纳入了答案正确性。 在7个开放重量级和17个专有Omni LLMs中,双子座3.7-Flash达到了最高的总体精度(79.4%),C.G.(70.8%)和B.G.(35.1%)。 在3级,它达到了79.1%的精确度,但其B.G.仅为12.3%。 这些结果表明,即使是最先进的模型,在有根据的视听推理中,仍然有发展的余地。

articles.title: WorldSR: Harnessing World Knowledge Search for Grounded Image Super-Resolution
articles.content: Generative-prior-based super-resolution (SR) methods leverage implicit knowledge learned from large-scale models to enhance low-resolution inputs. However, such priors are inherently stochastic and optimized for diverse generation, conflicting with the deterministic, high-fidelity reconstruction required for SR. It is also tied to the base model, costly to update, and prone to hallucinations as real-world data evolves. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldSR, a novel framework that augments SR with explicit, entity-aligned visual world knowledge. WorldSR automatically decomposes the input into semantic entities and performs entity-wise retrieval of structurally and semantically aligned images from a large-scale external corpus. For efficiency and reliability, we incorporate a memory mechanism to reuse previously retrieved results and a multi-step filtering process to refine candidate references. The selected references as world knowledge are then integrated through a novel multi-reference super-resolution model, which provides fine-grained constraints for detail synthesis and structural recovery. Experiments on real-world SR benchmarks show that WorldSR consistently improves structural fidelity and visual quality, outperforming existing generative super-resolution methods. Our results suggest that entity-level grounding in external visual world knowledge provides a simple and effective complement to model-bound generative priors.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界SR:利用世界知识搜索地面图像超级解析
articles.content_zh: 基因优先的超分辨率(SR)方法利用从大规模模型中吸取的隐含知识来增强低分辨率输入. 然而,这些前科本质上是多彩多彩的,并且对不同的一代人进行了优化,与斯洛伐克共和国所需的确定性、高忠诚度重建相冲突。 它还与基础模型联系在一起,更新费用高昂,随着现实世界数据的发展,容易产生幻觉。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了WorldSR,这个新颖的框架以明确、实体化的视觉世界知识来充实SR。 世界 SR会自动分解输入到语义实体中,并进行从一个大规模外部实体中从结构上和结构上对齐的图像进行实体式检索. 为了提高效率和可靠性,我们采用了一种内存机制,以重新利用以前获得的结果,并采用多步骤过滤程序,以完善候选参考。 随后,通过新颖的多参考超分辨率模型整合了作为世界知识的选定参考,为细节合成和结构恢复提供了精细的制约. 关于现实世界的SR基准的实验表明,世界SR不断提高结构的忠诚度和视觉质量,优于现有的基因超分辨率方法. 我们的结果表明,实体一级对外部视觉世界知识的定位为模型化的遗传学前科提供了简单而有效的补充。

articles.title: DISTRACT: Degradation-Indexed Study of Textual Reference Across Competing Targets
articles.content: Vision-language trackers (VLTs) accept descriptions intended to assist tracking, but accepting text does not establish that its content changes tracking decisions, particularly as visual evidence deteriorates. We introduce DISTRACT, a matched-intervention benchmark that holds video, target, and distractor fixed while crossing four text priors with four image degradations along a controlled severity axis. We evaluate five VLTs on four datasets using behavioral contrasts, layerwise representation probes, and activation patching. Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use. Some effects contract under degradation, whereas others show no significant endpoint change after multiplicity correction. UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly to changes in text semantics, with no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction in the tested settings. Model-internal analyses reveal that at decision-near states, correct-versus-conflicting text is decodable in Molmo2 and JointNLT but not in the other three systems. In the responsive models, decodability peaks at late states where replacement produces little behavioral change, whereas replacing selected earlier states redirects conflict-associated trajectories toward the target. Because matched-correct donors do not significantly outperform unrelated donors, these interventions identify earlier intervention-sensitive states without establishing target-specific semantic rescue. DISTRACT thus exposes when and where text affects tracking under degraded visual evidence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DISTRACT:跨竞争目标文字参考的退化强化研究
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言跟踪器(VLTs)接受旨在协助跟踪的描述,但接受文本并不能确定它的内容会改变跟踪决定,特别是在视觉证据恶化时. 我们引入了DISTRACT,一个匹配的干预基准,在跨越四个文本前缀时固定了视频、目标和分心器,并沿一个受控重心轴发生四个图像降解。 我们利用行为对比、分层表达探测器 和激活补丁 来评估四个数据集的五个VLT。 Molmo2和联合NLT展出定向文字使用. 退化下的某些影响合同,而另一些影响在多重更正后没有显著的终点变化。 UVLTrack,MMTrack,和DUTrack仅对文字语义的变化反应弱,在测试的设置中没有直接的行为效果幸存的FDR校正. 模型-内部分析表明,在接近决定状态时,正确文本与冲突文本在Molmo2和联合NLT中可以解码,但在其他三个系统中则不能解码。 在反应性模型中,替代不会产生什么行为变化的晚期状态的可解码性峰值,而取代先前选定的状态则将冲突相关轨迹转向目标。 由于对应的正确捐助者没有大大超过无关的捐助者,因此这些干预措施在未确定特定目标语义救援的情况下,确定了早期干预敏感国家。 因此,DISTRACT披露了文本何时何地影响在退化的视觉证据下的跟踪。

articles.title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
articles.content: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代码2Video-Compass:T2V、I2V和V2V通用代码视频生成综合基准
articles.content_zh: 与直接视频生成相比,基于代码的视频生成提供了精细的控制,目标编辑,组件再利用. 这种方法要求多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)将视觉和时间要求转化为可执行的程序,产生完整的视频. 然而,现有的基于代码的基准主要针对专门的任务,使得不同创意类别和输入模式的完整视频创建没有得到充分的评价. 我们引入了Code2Video-Compass,这是跨文本到视频(T2V),图像到视频(I2V)和视频到视频(V2V)设置的基于代码视频生成的通用基准. Code2Video-Compass包含2,104项任务,包括10个类别,24个子类型,以及三个复杂维度,包括构造,动态动画,以及状态依赖. 它将从文字指令和视觉参考中解析的任务与相应的T2V,I2V,以及从完整的专业和用户创建的视频中衍生出来的V2V任务结合起来. 我们提出一个双重评价框架,将12个客观指标和5个主观指标结合起来。 客观评价涵盖业务性能,视频质量,文本-视频对齐,以及参考忠诚度,主观评价则使用MLLM法官来评价遵循和整体视频质量的指令. 对最近来自9个家庭的15个专有和开放量的MLLMs的广泛评价表明,即使是主要模型在可靠地生成符合文字和视觉要求的高质量完整视频方面都面临挑战,随着构造、动态动画和状态依赖性复杂性的提高,性能普遍下降。 我们预计,Code2Video-Compass将推进可靠、连贯和可控制的基于代码的视频生成,并激励在方案视觉创建方面取得更广泛的进展。

articles.title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
articles.content: Deep learning models have become essential tools in medical imaging, yet training them end-to-end for diverse tasks remains challenging due to limited labeled data and computational constraints. To address this, we introduce Brain2Vec, a foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans pooled from multiple studies. Brain2Vec can serve both as a weight initialization backbone for fine-tuning downstream tasks and as a standalone feature extractor. We evaluated Brain2Vec in three tasks: downstream predictive performance, convergence speed, and embedding quality. Using Brain2Vec's pretrained weights as initialization and fine-tuning on labeled data for a brain age prediction task, results demonstrate improved final accuracy and faster convergence compared to random initialization. Additionally, its frozen embeddings outperform anatomically defined volumetric features on four of five downstream classification tasks and perform competitively with a state-of-the-art foundation model pre-trained on substantially more data. Lastly, we show that Brain2Vec encodes information primarily from a spatially localized and neuroanatomically meaningful set of brain regions, and that manipulating a subset of latent features produces monotonic, region-specific effects on the reconstructed anatomy. Brain2Vec code and trained models are available as an open-source package on https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec. Users can apply Brain2Vec locally by installing the package, or directly through the NiChart cloud platform https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com, where Brain2Vec features can be derived without requiring local installation or specialized infrastructure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Brain2Vec:结构脑磁共振的自导自导3D基础模型
articles.content_zh: 深层学习模型已成为医学成像方面必不可少的工具,但由于贴有标签的数据有限和计算限制,因此对模型进行不同任务的端到端培训仍然具有挑战性。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了Brain2Vec(Brain2Vec),这是一个基础模型,在74,425 T1加权磁共振成像(MRI)扫描上预训,通过多种研究集合. 大脑2 Vec既可作为重力初始化主干线,用于微调下游任务,也可作为独立的特性提取器. 我们评价了Brain2Vec的三项任务:下游预测性能、汇合速度和嵌入质量。 利用Brain2Vec预先训练的重量作为脑龄预测任务的标注数据的初始化和微调,结果显示与随机初始化相比,最终精度提高,趋同速度加快. 此外,其冻结嵌入在五个下游分类任务中的四个任务上超过了解剖定义的体积特征,并具有竞争能力,在大量数据方面预先培训了最先进的基础模型。 最后,我们显示,Brain2Vec主要从空间局部和神经解剖有意义的一组大脑区域对信息进行编码,而操纵一组潜伏的特征则对重建的解剖学产生单一的区域特异性效应。 大脑2 在https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec上,Vec代码和训练有素的模型作为开源软件包提供. 用户可通过安装软件包或直接通过NiChart云平台在本地应用Brain2Vec https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com,其中Brain2Vec的特性可以在不需要本地安装或专用基础设施的情况下产生.

articles.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Machine Learning with Evidence-based Planning for Medical Image Analysis
articles.content: Deep learning has become the default tool for medical image analysis, driven by the open-source movement. However, achieving the best performance on a given task remains difficult, with architecture selection and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) still considered "more of an art than a science". Automated machine learning (AutoML) automates parts of model training, yet helps little in medical imaging: general-purpose approaches lack medical architectures and preprocessing, and medical-focused ones demand engineering expertise and remain confined to narrow tasks such as 3D segmentation. We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework that automates model training for diverse single- and multi-modal medical tasks through a natural language interface. Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by retrieving published results to guide model selection and configuration, and employs parallel HPO where multiple agents explore adjustment strategies concurrently. MedicalMLOmni achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks; PMC-VQA is the exception, where a vision-language model with broader pre-training leads. Backbone-matched controls attribute the gains to the framework, not the backbone. By removing coding requirements, MedicalMLOmni lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有循证医疗图像分析规划的自动机器学习多代理框架
articles.content_zh: 深层学习已经成为医学图像分析的默认工具,由开源运动驱动. 然而,在特定任务上实现最佳表现仍然是困难的,建筑选择和超参数优化(HPO)仍然被认为是"更多的艺术而不是科学". 自动化机器学习(AutoML)将模型培训的部分自动化,然而在医学成像方面帮助甚微:通用方法缺乏医疗架构和预处理,以医学为重点的方法需要工程专业知识,仍然局限于3D分割等狭义任务. 我们引入了MedicalMLOmni,这是一个多代理AutoML框架,通过自然语言界面,将多种单式和多式医疗任务的模型培训自动化. 具体而言,MedicalMLOmni通过检索公布的结果来进行循证规划,以指导模型选择和配置,并采用平行的HPO,由多个代理人同时探索调整策略. MedicalMLOmni在20个基准中的19个基准上取得了最佳得分;PMC-VQA是例外,其中视觉语言模型具有更广泛的培训前领先. 后骨匹配控制将收益归结于框架,而不是骨干. 通过取消编码要求,MedicalMLOmni降低了对拥有丰富数据集但工程专业知识有限的域专家的屏障.

articles.title: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
articles.content: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StreamEval:评价互动流视频生成模式
articles.content_zh: 随着流媒体视频生成的进步,与生成的视频进行实时互动变得越来越重要. 我们引入了 StreamEval , 用于交互流视频生成的统一基准, 涉及五项任务:avatar对话、avatar性能、世界生成、指令编辑和参考编辑。 流线 Eval包含300个脚本测试案例,持续15-300小时,每个案例都具体说明初始资产,递增收到的多式联运请求,以及国家变更和内容保存的明确要求。 业绩按四个评价方面来评估:任务执行、状态一致性、视觉忠诚和视听协调,通过10项具体任务衡量标准在0-100尺度上进行即时评估。 在对300个测试案件中的37个不同模型进行评估后,我们发现,高视觉质量和保留身份并不一定与可靠的请求执行或持续的国家一致性相吻合。 特别是,执行请求仍然具有挑战性:在7个阿凡达性能模型中,任务特有分数最高的是36.90分,在文本条件世界一代中,为25.93分,在三个报告参考编辑模型中,为15.00分。 这些结论确定,在时间安排和保全限制下可靠地执行请求,是推进全方位实时互动系统的中心挑战。 领导牌可在https://streameval.ai上查阅。

articles.title: VisualEvolve: A Skill Self-Evolution Framework for Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Visual tool use enables vision-language models (VLMs) to acquire task-relevant evidence, but its effectiveness can be limited by predefined visual operations and the tool-use strategies learned during training. Representing these operations and strategies as reusable external skills allows them to be refined through self-evolution without updating model parameters. However, skill refinement can introduce performance regressions. Meanwhile, inspecting accumulated task execution trajectories together with skill evolution history may lead to evolution evidence overload. To address these challenges, we propose VisualEvolve, a self-evolving framework that evolves executable visual operations and tool-use strategies for VLMs through a Select--Execute--Evolve--Evaluate cycle. Skill-Library Snapshot Selection uses performance on a fixed validation set disjoint from execution tasks to select an effective historical snapshot for subsequent evolution, limiting the propagation of performance regressions. Progressive Evidence Access (PEA) guides capability-gap diagnosis through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy comprising the Skill-Performance Report, Evolution Log, Trajectory Summaries, and relevant raw trajectory segments. Across four VLM backbones and six evaluation sets from three benchmarks, VisualEvolve improves over the Initial Skill Library in 23 of 24 settings, with a maximum gain of 15.1 percentage points on VisualProbe Hard using Qwen3.5-Plus. Ablation studies support the contributions of Snapshot Selection and PEA, while further experiments show that skills can be improved using experience from different data settings and directly reused across backbones. Moreover, VisualEvolve enables effective skill self-evolution with over an order of magnitude fewer task-solving trajectories than estimated for representative RL-based methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VisualEvolve:视觉理性技能自演框架
articles.content_zh: 视觉工具的使用使得视觉语言模型(VLMs)能够获得与任务相关的证据,但其有效性可以受到预先定义的视觉操作和在训练中学习的工具使用策略的限制. 将这些操作和战略作为可重复使用的外部技能来表述,使得它们能够通过自我进化而得以完善,而无需更新模型参数. 然而,技能改进可以引入性能回归. 同时,检查累积的任务执行轨迹以及技能演化史,可能导致演化证据超载. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用VisualEvolve这一自演化框架,通过选择-执行-演化-评价周期,为VLM制定可执行的视觉操作和工具使用战略。 Skill-Library Sawshot Shoot使用固定验证集上与执行任务脱节的性能来选择一个有效的历史快照来进行后续演化,限制了性能回归的传播. 进步证据获取系统通过粗细至精细的层次来指导能力差距诊断,包括技能绩效报告、演化日志、轨迹摘要和相关原始轨迹部分。 通过四个VLM主干线和来自三个基准的六套评价,VisualEvolve在24个设置中比初始技能库的23个改进,使用Quen3.5-Plus在VisualProbe Hard上的最大收益为15.1个百分点. 校对研究支持Snapshot Setch和PEA的贡献,而进一步的实验显示,利用不同数据设置的经验可以提高技能,并直接跨骨干重复使用. 此外,视觉 演进使得有效的技能自我演化,其规模比基于RL的代表性方法所估计的任务解决轨迹要少。

articles.title: RACE: Learning Multimodal Search through Referential Abstraction and Compositional Evidence
articles.content: Training multimodal search agents requires tasks that make visually grounded search necessary for determining the answer. Textual identity clues and unused target evidence allow shortcuts in synthetic questions, weakening supervision for visual search and evidence integration. We propose RACE, an image-conditioned task synthesis framework that constructs dependencies from images to targets and from target-specific evidence to answers. Referential Abstraction (RA) replaces identity-revealing text with specific visual references or ambiguous relational references resolved by searching among depicted candidates. Compositional Evidence (CE) links retrieved facts about multiple entities in one image or entities from different images into joint questions whose answers require every designated contribution. Both operations also apply to images found during search, allowing new visual observations to determine subsequent search targets or supply answer evidence. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-27B on only 12K teacher-generated trajectories from RACE raises average accuracy across ten multimodal benchmarks from 53.5 to 56.0, a relative improvement of approximately 4.7% over the matched base agent. Our code, data, and model will be publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RACE: 通过参考摘要和组成证据学习多式联运搜索
