articles.content_zh: 培训多式联运搜索人员需要完成的任务,使视网膜搜索成为确定答案的必要条件。 文字身份线索和未使用的目标证据允许合成问题中的快捷键,削弱了对视觉搜索和证据整合的监督. 我们建议建立基于图像的任务综合框架,构建从图像到目标以及从特定目标证据到答案的依赖性。 参考摘要(RA)用具体的视觉参考或模糊的关系参考取代身份检索文本,通过在被描绘的候选人中搜索而解决。 组成证据(CE)将从不同图像中获取的多个实体的事实或从不同图像中获取的实体连成联合问题,这些问题的答案要求每个指定的贡献。 这两个操作也适用于搜索过程中发现的图像,允许新的视觉观测来决定后续的搜索目标或提供答案证据. 仅对来自RACE的12K名教师产生的轨迹进行精细调整的Quen3.5-27B将10个多式联运基准的平均精度从53.5提高到56.0,比对应的基剂相对改善约4.7%。 我们的代码、数据和模型将公开发布。

articles.title: CountVideoBench: A Benchmark to Evaluate Prediction Biases on the Object Counting task by Video-Language Models
articles.content: Object counting in videos remains a poorly characterized capability of multimodal large language models. Counting questions are included in many existing VideoQA benchmarks, but the ground-truth count distributions in these benchmarks are heavily skewed toward small values. Across the nine benchmarks we survey, the median ground-truth count is at most five, and the three most frequent values together account for between 45% and 93% of the videos. The resulting mean accuracy is then dominated by the most frequent counts; a value-dependent bias at a rare count contributes negligibly to the average and remains invisible. We introduce CountVideoBench, a benchmark of 2,600 synthetic videos covering 26 cardinalities in the interval [5, 50] (100 videos each), grouped into six clusters of consecutive counts that span the range while enabling near-neighbor comparisons. Each video contains a single class of static objects under a controlled camera motion, removing object motion and reducing recognition as confounds. We evaluate sixteen video-language models from nine architecture families in a zero-shot setting. No model exceeds 27.6% Exact Match. The dependence of accuracy on cardinality varies across models, ranging from monotonic decline to a non-monotonic peak-and-collapse pattern, which rules out increasing difficulty with cardinality as the dominant explanation of counting failure. Every model further concentrates its predictions on its own set of preferred integers, with accuracy peaks coinciding with these values and collapsing at adjacent counts. These findings highlight the need for balanced, diagnostic counting benchmarks to reliably assess this fundamental visual capability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计数视频 座椅:通过视频语言模型评估对象计数任务的预测比喻的基准
articles.content_zh: 视频中的对象计数仍然是多式联运大语言模型的特征不佳的能力。 许多现有的VideoQA基准中都包含了计数问题,但这些基准中地面真实的计数分布严重向小值倾斜. 我们调查的9个基准中, 中位数地面真相计数最多为5个, 由此得出的平均准确性由最频繁的计数所支配;在稀有计数中依赖价值的偏差对平均值有微弱的帮助,并且仍然是无形的。 我们引入了由2,600个合成视频构成的基准,其中包含间隔[5,50](每集100个视频)的26个基本内容,分为6组连续计数,跨越范围,同时可以进行近邻比较。 每段视频都包含一个受控相机运动下的单类静态物体,去除物体运动并降低识别为错觉. 我们从9个建筑家庭的16个视频语言模型中, 在零镜头的设定中进行评估。 没有模型超过 27.6% 准确匹配. 精确度对临界值的依赖程度因模型而异,从单调衰落到非模拟峰值和碰撞模式不等,后者排除了以临界值作为计数失败主要解释的日益困难. 每个模型进一步将其预测集中在自己的一组首选整数上,精度峰值与这些值相吻合,并在相邻计数时崩溃。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要平衡、诊断性地计算基准,以可靠地评估这种基本的视觉能力。

articles.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
articles.content: Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. This design keeps the full flexibility of a coding agent, and every reading it acts on stays grounded in the tools' geometry. On MMSI-Bench and ReVSI, the toolkit improves a strong open-source model, Qwen3.8-27B, by +13.9 and +20.5 points over the same agent without tools, and a strong closed-source model, Gemini-3.8-Flash, by +11.2 and +9.6 points. With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. Both tool gains shrink as the backbone grows more capable, but SpatialClaw's shrinks far more on ReVSI, from +13.2 to +2.7, while ours stays at +9.6. S-Agent 2.0 also works across different general coding agent harnesses, such as Codex and Claude Code.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: S-Agent 2.0: 空间原因与一般编码代理
articles.content_zh: 空间推理要求一个模型来研究物体在3D空间中的位置,它们如何互相联系,如何移动. 代理VLMs最近为这些任务带来了很大的改进,让模型用3D感知工具积极收集证据,而不是在单传中回答. 即便如此,在许多问题上,工具返回正确的证据,而模型仍然没有得出正确的答案:原始读数成为可用结论的模型和工具之间的差距被置之不理. 我们提出S-Agent 2.0,一个空间推理代理,为现成的普通编码代理配备了命令行感知工具包,我们围绕一个原则设计接口:帮助VLM关闭证据循环:获取场景证据,在持续的场景记忆中记住它,并且用简单的空间语言解释每次阅读. 这种设计保持了编码代理的充分灵活性,每读一次它都作用于停留在工具的几何上. 在MMSI-Bench和ReVSI上,工具包改进了强大的开源模型Qwen3.8-27B,通过+13.9和+20.5的点数超越了没有工具的同一剂,以及强大的闭源模型双子座-3.8-Flash,通过+11.2和+9.6点. 开放骨干S-Agent 2.0在MMSI-Bench上达到66.5,在ReVSI上达到82.3,领先于同一骨干(62.6和74.5)的专用系统SpaceClaw,在双子座-3.8-Flash上达到74.1和90.5,相对其67.0和79.7. 两个工具增益都随着骨干能力增强而收缩,但SpaceClaw在ReVSI上的收缩要大得多,从+13.2到+2.7,而我们的则停留在+9.6. S-Agent 2.0也工作于不同的一般编码代理吊带,如Codex和Claude Code.

articles.title: RayCo4D: Ray-Conditioned Continuous Motion Model for Monocular 4D Dynamic Reconstruction
articles.content: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video requires inferring motion from noisy and intermittently visible observations. Long-range tracks provide valuable geometric constraints, but integrating their fragmented temporal coverage into shared, continuous motion remains challenging. We introduce \textbf{RayCo4D}, a ray-conditioned continuous motion model for monocular 4D reconstruction that explicitly separates visual measurements from latent 3D motion states. Each track is associated with a reference-time 3D query constrained to its camera ray, and its image and depth observations constrain shared latent motion nodes through local many-to-many associations. Each node maintains an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ pose and body-frame velocity at sparse support times. A white-noise-on-acceleration process prior couples neighboring states and defines continuous-time interpolation, allowing observations across visibility intervals to jointly constrain the same latent state sequence.The inferred shared motion is transferred to Gaussian primitives through dual-quaternion blending, while reference-anchored local $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ residuals capture fine-scale non-rigid deformation beyond the shared scaffold. Experiments on diverse monocular dynamic scenes show that RayCo4D achieves competitive novel-view synthesis quality, improves structural and temporal consistency under rapid motion and incomplete tracks, and supports continuous-time rendering.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RayCo4D:单体4D动态重建的雷定式连续运动模型
articles.content_zh: 从单视视频中重建动态3D场景,需要从吵闹和间歇可见的观察中推断运动. 长距离轨道提供了宝贵的几何限制,但将它们分散的时间覆盖纳入共同的、持续的运动仍然是挑战。 我们引入\textbf{RayCo4D},一个单光4D重建的射线条件连续运动模型,明确将视觉测量与潜在3D运动状态区分开来. 每个音轨都与一个被其相机射线所限制的参考时间3D查询有关,其图像和深度观测通过本地的多对多关联来约束共享的潜伏运动节点. 每个节点维持一个 $\ mathrm{SE} (3)$ 的姿势和车身速度, 支持时间不多 。 白噪声加速度过程的前情侣邻邦并定义连续时间插值,允许跨可见度间隔的观测,共同约束相同的潜在状态序列. 所推断的共享运动通过双方角的混合转移给高斯原始人,而参考-安心本地的$\mathrm{SE}(3)$的剩余物捕捉到超出共享脚手架的细度非刚性变形. 对多种单体动态场景的实验显示,RayCo4D实现了竞争性小说视野合成质量,在快速运动和不完全轨道下提高了结构和时间一致性,支持连续时间渲染.

articles.title: Gated Prototype Transfer for Zero-Support Medical Vision Language Model
articles.content: Realistic few-shot adaptation of medical vision-language models (VLMs) can leave low-prevalence classes without any labeled support. The training-free SS- Text+ solver remains operational in this setting, but its zero-support prototypes receive no visual adaptation and fall back to a purely textual class prototype. We in- troduce Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer (GProtoT), a pre-repulsion module that transfers supported-class visual residuals to missing classes using VLM similarity and an ontology-based clinical distance. A validation-free evidence gate scales transfer based on semantic relevance and residual agreement, thereby limiting unsupported extrapolation. In 50 paired realistic one-shot trials on MESSIDOR with FLAIR features, severe and proliferative diabetic retinopathy were absent from every support set. Relative to SS-Text+, gated ProtoT improved missing-class recall by 5.23 points, average class accuracy by 1.37 points, and the missing/supported recall harmonic mean by 1.83 points. It reduced negative- transfer frequency from 46-48% for ungated transfer to 2%, while at the cost of reductions of 1.20 percentage points in supported-class recall and 0.45 percentage points in top-1 accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-based gating provides a safety mechanism for the knowledge source. GProtoT is based on SS- Text+ and requires no gradients, validation data, or additional model inference, of- fering a low-compute path toward accountable adaptation under incomplete clini- cal supervision. Code is available: https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 零支持医学视觉语言模型的原型转让
articles.content_zh: 医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)的实实在在的几发改编可以留下低发率的班级,而没有任何标签支持. 免训练的SS-Text+解析器在此设置中仍然可以运行,但其零支持原型没有获得可视化改造,并回归纯文本类原型. 我们通过转录Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer(GProtoT),一个利用VLM相似性和基于肿瘤的临床距离将支持级视觉残基转移至缺失类的预推模块. 基于语义相关性和剩余协议的无验证证据门比例转移,从而限制了无支持的推断. 在对具有FLAIR特征的MESIDOR进行50个对齐的一发试验中,每组支助中都缺少严重和扩散性糖尿病复方疗法。 相对于SS-Text+,Gated ProtoT改进了缺失级召回5.23分,平均级精度为1.37分,缺失/支持的召回谐音平均值为1.83分. 它将负转移频率从负调值的46-48%降低到2%,同时将支持级召回的1.20个百分点和最高1的准确度降低0.45个百分点。 这些结果表明,基于证据的定位为知识来源提供了安全机制。 GProtoT基于SS-Text+,不需要梯度、验证数据或额外的模型推论,即-在不完全的clini-cal监督下,为可问责的适应设置低计算路径。 代码:https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT

articles.title: Auto-Director: Leveraging Multi-Agent Collaboration for Autonomous Video Editing
articles.content: Autonomous video editing from open-world resources remains a challenging problem in multimedia content creation. Retrieval-based methods are constrained by fixed source material and lack creative flexibility, while generative models struggle with long-horizon coherence and often diverge from user intent. Both paradigms fail to replicate the structured, multi-stage reasoning that underlies professional post-production. To address these limitations, we present Auto-Director, a tool-augmented multi-agent framework that mirrors professional editorial workflows: a Planning Agent decomposes abstract topics into fact-grounded scripts via retrieval-augmented planning; a Material Agent indexes open-world footage through shot segmentation and visual tagging; an Editor Agent assembles semantically aligned clips with MLLM-driven spatial adaptation; and a Critic Agent governs an iterative Reflect-and-Revise loop that checks scene-level alignment and pacing. To rigorously evaluate this new paradigm, we introduce VEdit-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated topics with human-annotated Golden Scripts and a five-dimensional metric suite covering Narrative Logic, Factual Accuracy, Semantic Alignment, Compositional Quality, and Stylistic Cohesion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Auto-Director significantly outperforms baseline methods in both automated metrics and human evaluation, effectively bridging the gap between amateurs and professional-grade video production.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自动导演:利用多代理协作进行自动视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 从开放世界资源进行自主视频编辑仍然是多媒体内容创作中的一个挑战性问题. 基于检索的方法受到固定源材料的限制,缺乏创造性的灵活性,而基因模型则与长距离的连贯性发生斗争,并经常偏离用户意图. 这两种模式都未能复制构成专业生产后基础的结构化、多阶段的推理。 为了克服这些局限性,我们介绍Auto-Director,这是一个工具强化的多代理框架,反映了专业编辑工作流程:一个规划代理通过检索-Augleed 规划将抽象主题分解为事实脚本;一个材料代理通过镜头分割和视觉标记来索引开放世界的镜头;一个编辑代理集合了与MLLLM驱动的空间适应性一致的剪辑;以及一个批评代理管理一个反复反射和校正循环,以检查场面的调整和节奏。 为了严格评价这个新模式,我们引入了Vedit-Bench,这是100个专家精准专题的基准,带有人文说明的金字本和一个五维度的计量套件,涵盖叙述逻辑、事实准确性、语义校正、组成质量和结构统一。 广泛的实验表明,自动导演在自动度量衡和人的评价方面都大大超过基准方法,有效地缩小了业余人员与专业级视频制作之间的差距。

articles.title: HistoLoop: Iterative Contextual Inference with a Looped Transformer for Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
articles.content: Predicting spatial gene expression from H&E images offers a scalable complement to experimental spatial transcriptomics. However, despite progress in spatial context modeling, how to construct subsequent context from spot states updated by earlier contextual interactions remains underexplored. We introduce HistoLoop, a looped Transformer that formulates prediction as iterative contextual inference. At each refinement step, HistoLoop aggregates the current spot states into context tokens at the corresponding resolution, processes them with a shared spatial Transformer, and retrieves spot-specific contextual information through cross-attention. A memory-mediated update integrates this information into persistent spot states, which are then used to construct context at the next, finer resolution. Under the HEST-Bench HVG50 evaluation protocol, HistoLoop achieves the highest macro-averaged gene-wise Pearson correlation among the compared methods across six cancer-specific tasks spanning five organs in HEST-1K. Ablation studies support the importance of recurrent state refinement and reconstructing context from updated spot states at progressively finer resolutions. Expression-derived clustering further suggests that HistoLoop better captures spatially organized multigene patterns.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HistoryLoop: 以历史学为基础的空间基因表达预测的循环变换器进行迭代背景推论
articles.content_zh: 从H&E图像中预测空间基因表达,为实验空间转录学提供了可扩展的补充. 然而,尽管在空间背景建模方面取得了进展,但如何从早期背景互动更新的现点状态构建后续背景仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们引入了HistoLoop,一个循环变形器,它将预测作为迭代的背景推论。 在每一个完善步骤上,HistoLoop在相应的解析度上将当前斑点状态汇总成上下文符号,用共享的空间变换器进行处理,并通过交叉意向检索特定斑点背景信息. 一个内存介质的更新将这些信息整合到持久性的斑点状态,然后用于构建下个更细的解析度的上下文. 根据HEST-Bench HVG50评价协议,HistoLoop在HEST-1K中跨越5个器官的6个癌症特定任务的比较方法中,实现了最大宏观平均基因皮尔逊相关. 对比研究证明,必须不断改进国家状况,从最新现成状态开始,逐步完善决议。 表达衍生集群进一步表明,HistoLoop更好地捕捉空间排列的多基因模式.

articles.title: PACE: Plan, Attend, Check, and Emit for Training-Free Response Timing in Streaming Video Understanding
articles.content: Streaming video understanding requires a model to decide not only what to answer but also when to answer. Evidence arrives progressively, and recent benchmarks identify premature responses, issued before the queried event has concluded, as a recurring failure mode. Existing approaches often learn response timing through additional training, while training-free alternatives typically rely on scalar gating signals that do not explicitly represent when an answer becomes final. We organize chunk-wise streaming errors into three patterns: sampling variation can make an answer unstable, a stable answer may lack support in the observed video, or an answer may be supported by the current evidence while the event remains unfinished. We propose PACE (Plan, Attend, Check, and Emit), a training-free framework designed around these three failure modes. Given a question, PACE drafts a plan specifying what to observe and what will signal completion. As the stream unfolds, it invokes an off-the-shelf video LLM at informative moments, evaluates each draft for stability, grounding in its cited frames, and completion, and records verified observations in an event ledger. Experiments on ProactiveVideoQA and OVO-Bench Forward show that PACE improves over the official protocols by up to 5.9 average PAUC points and 6.2 average accuracy points across proprietary and open-source backbones, yielding state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PACE: 计划、出席、检查和免费培训响应
articles.content_zh: 流畅的视频理解要求一个模型不仅决定答案,而且决定何时回答。 证据逐渐到来,最近的基准确定,在被询问事件结束前发布的反应过早,是一种反复发生的失败模式。 现有办法往往通过额外培训学习反应时间,而无培训的替代办法通常依赖在答复成为最终答案时没有明确代表的标尺标记信号。 我们把分块流出的错误组织成三种模式: 采样变异可以使一个答案不稳定, 稳定的答案可能在被观测到的视频中缺乏支持, 或者在事件未完成时,一个答案可能会得到当前证据的支持. 我们提议PACE(计划、出席、检查和Emit),这是围绕这三种失败模式设计的无培训框架。 面对一个问题,计算机设备行动伙伴关系起草了一项计划,其中具体规定了观察的内容和表示完成的内容。 随着溪流的展开,它引用了现成的视频LLM在信息化时刻,评价每个草稿的稳定性,在其引用的框中定位,完成,并在事件分类账中记录经核实的观测结果. 关于主动VideoQA和OVO-Bench Forward的实验显示,PACE比官方协议改进了最高5.9个PAUC平均点和6.2个跨专有和开源主干线的平均准确点,产生了最先进的性能.

articles.title: ABACUS: A Benchmark for Image Editing Models to Assess Object Category and Counting Under Scene Conservation
articles.content: Instruction-based image editing models can now add, remove a specified number of objects or change their category while preserving the scene. Yet these models often fail to produce the correct number, and these failures grow sharply as scenes become more complex and the requested count increases. Current benchmarks largely miss this problem: they score edits with holistic similarity metrics or with vision-language model (VLM) judges that are themselves poor at counting, so numerical errors go unnoticed or are graded incorrectly. As a result, the true numerical ability of today's editing models has never been accurately measured. We address this issue with ABACUS, a new benchmark, evaluation protocol and dedicated scoring metric for numerical image editing. Our protocol is judge-free: no VLM or MLLM scores an edit or counts objects (a VLM only confirms the category of rare ambiguous crops). Instead, it verifies each edit at the instance level against panoptic ground truth confirmed by detector consensus, checking both that the exact requested count was achieved and that the rest of the scene was preserved, across the add, remove and change operations. By evaluating leading image editors, our method reveals substantial numerical editing failures that worsen with increasing scene complexity and object count; failures that prior benchmarks often overlooked or misjudged.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ABACUS: 图像编辑模型评估对象类别和在景物保护下计数的基准
articles.content_zh: 基于指令的图像编辑模型现在可以在保留场景的同时添加,删除指定数量的对象或更改其类别. 然而,这些模型往往不能产生正确的数字,这些失败随着场景变得更加复杂和要求的计数增加而急剧增加. 目前的基准在很大程度上忽略了这个问题:它们用整体相似性衡量标准或视觉语言模型(VLM)评分,这些评分本身在计数上很差,所以数字误差不被注意或分级错误. 因此,今天的编辑模型的真实数值能力从未被精确地测量. 我们用ABACUS来处理这个问题,这是一个新的基准、评价协议和数字图像编辑专用评分指标。 我们的协议是无判断的:没有VLM或MLLM评分一个编辑或计数对象(一个VLM只确认罕见的模棱两可的作物类别). 相反,它根据探测器协商一致确认的全光学地面真实性,在实例一级核实每一次编辑,同时检查所要求准确的计数是否已经实现,以及现场的其余部分是否得到保存,在整个添加,移除和更改操作. 通过评价主要图像编辑器,我们的方法揭示出大量的数值编辑失败,随着场景的日益复杂和对象的计数而恶化;先前的基准常常忽略或误判的失败.

articles.title: Towards Consistent Geospatial Representations: Aligning One Encoder to Many Foundation Models
articles.content: Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) differ widely in pretraining objective, modality and resolution, and none leads across benchmarks. We ask whether their representations are complementary, and whether a single encoder can inherit that complementarity. We introduce Pangaea-Latents, an extension of the Pangaea benchmark providing frozen embeddings of $5$ GFMs over its $11$ datasets, along with reproduced baselines, and find GFM embeddings to be neither redundant nor disjoint. We then propose GeoMixture, a preliminary framework to align a ViT to several GFMs per dataset through a multi-representation alignment (mREPA) objective. Our encoder ties the best GFM in average rank across nine Pangaea datasets, trading peak performance for cross-task consistency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实现地理空间代表性的一致性:使一个编码器与许多基础模型保持一致
articles.content_zh: 地理空间基础模型在培训前目标、模式和解决方面差别很大,没有一种模式可以跨越基准。 我们问它们的陈述是否相辅相成,单一编码器是否能够继承这种互补性。 我们介绍了Pangaea-Latents,这是Pangaea基准的延伸,该基准在其11美元数据集上提供了5美元GFM的冷冻嵌入,以及复制的基线,并发现GFM嵌入既不是多余的也不是脱节的。 然后,我们提出GeoMixture,这是一个初步框架,通过多代表对齐(mREPA)目标,使每个数据集的VIT与几个GFM一致。 我们的编码器将九套Pangaea数据集的平均最佳GFM联结起来,用峰值性能来交换交叉任务的一致性.

articles.title: AGGR-Mamba: Mamba-based Network with Attention-Guided Gated Residual Refinement for Undersampled MRI Reconstruction
articles.content: Undersampled magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from partially acquired k-space data, thereby reducing scan time. However, missing frequency-domain measurements often lead to residual aliasing artifacts, blurred edges, and loss of local structural details. In this paper, we propose AGGR-Mamba, a lightweight output-stage residual refinement method built upon a Mamba backbone for undersampled brain MRI reconstruction. The Mamba backbone first produces an initial reconstruction, and the proposed refinement modules then correct the remaining local errors and high-frequency artifacts in a controlled residual manner. Specifically, an Attention Refine Head is introduced to recalibrate local anatomical structures, edge textures, and residual-error regions through channel and spatial attention. In addition, a GDFN-style gated residual refinement branch is designed to selectively preserve informative residual features while suppressing redundant or unstable responses. By combining attention-based recalibration with gated residual selection, AGGR-Mamba improves local structure recovery without substantially disturbing the backbone reconstruction. Experiments are conducted on the IXI brain MRI dataset with T1- and T2-weighted images under acceleration factors of R=4 and R=8. The results show that AGGR-Mamba achieves competitive PSNR and SSIM performance across different reconstruction settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed output-stage refinement strategy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AGGR-Mamba:以Mamba为基地的网络,对未加取样的核磁共振进行改进 重建
articles.content_zh: 被取样的磁共振成像(MRI)重建旨在从部分获得的k空间数据中恢复高质量的图像,从而缩短扫描时间. 然而,缺失的频域测量往往导致残存的异名文物,边缘模糊,局部结构细节丢失. 在本文中,我们提出AGGR-Mamba,这是一种轻量级输出级剩余精炼方法,其基础是Mamba骨干,用于对大脑核磁共振进行检测不足。 Mamba主干线首先产生初步重建,拟议的改进模块然后以可控的残余方式纠正剩余的局部错误和高频文物. 具体来说,引入了一个Reflect Reflectine Head,通过信道和空间关注来重新校正局部解剖结构,边缘纹理,以及残留-error区域. 此外,一个GDFN风格的门式残余精炼分支旨在有选择地保留信息丰富的残余特征,同时压制多余或不稳定的反应. AGGR-Mamba将基于注意力的重新调整与有门的剩余选择相结合,改善当地结构的恢复,同时不严重干扰骨干重建。 在加速因子R=4和R=8下,用T1-和T2-加权图像在九一脑磁共振数据集上进行实验. 结果显示,AGGR-Mamba公司在不同重建环境中取得了具有竞争力的PSNR和SSIM业绩,显示出拟议产出阶段完善战略的有效性。

articles.title: CPVB-RG: Cross-Prior Visual Bridging for Prior-Aware Chest X-Ray Report Generation
articles.content: Radiologists interpret follow-up chest X-rays by comparing current and prior examinations to identify new, resolved or progressing findings. Most report generation systems either omit this longitudinal context or fuse prior features without distinguishing interval changes from anatomy that remains stable over time. We propose CPVB-RG, a prior-aware framework that combines current and prior radiographs with available clinical text. Its Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (CPVB) contains Progression-Guided Focus Attention (PGFA) and two Cross-Attention units. PGFA is designed to contrast progression-difference attention with shared-spatial attention, aiming to reduce invariant responses whilst retaining coarse spatial correspondence between examinations. The Cross-Attention units then connect the resulting longitudinal visual evidence with clinical semantics. CPVB-RG is trained in two stages, using prior-guided image-text alignment followed by autoregressive report generation with a lightweight language decoder. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray show consistent improvements across language and clinical metrics. On MIMIC-CXR, CPVB-RG achieves 0.2847 F1RadGraph and 0.6692 VLScore, with statistically significant gains over the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline. These results support the effectiveness of the proposed difference-aware and spatially guided fusion design for prior-aware chest X-ray report generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CPVB-RG:用于前卫胸X射线报告生成的跨优先视觉连接
articles.content_zh: 放射学家通过比较当前和以前的检查来解释后续胸X射线,以找出新的、已解决的或正在取得进展的检查结果。 大多数报告生成系统要么省略了这一纵向上下文,要么将先前的特征引信化,而不区分间隔变化和随时间推移保持稳定的解剖学。 我们提议使用CPVB-RG,这是一个将当前和以前的放射图与现有的临床文本相结合的事先认识框架。 其跨优先视觉桥(CPVB)包含进步-引导焦点注意(PGFA)和两个交叉注意单元. PGFA旨在将渐进偏差的注意力与共享空间的注意力作对比,旨在减少变化中的反应,同时保留检查之间的粗糙空间对应。 交叉观察单位然后将由此产生的纵向视觉证据与临床语义学联系起来. CPVB-RG分两个阶段进行训练,使用前导图像文本对齐,然后使用轻量级语言解码器进行自递式报告生成. 关于MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray的实验显示,在语言和临床指标方面都取得了一致的改进。 在MIMIC-CXR上,CPVB-RG实现0.2847 F1RadGraph和0.6692 VLScore,在统计学上比最接近的解码器比对的前意识基线有显著增益. 这些结果支持了为预知的胸X射线报告生成而拟议的差异感和空间引导的聚变设计的有效性.

articles.title: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
articles.content: Geometric Relative Positional Encoding has become the primary mechanism for injecting spatial inductive biases into multi-view transformers. Existing designs condition attention on camera-level frustums or ray-marched depth, associating cross-view tokens through the sensor geometry. Such sensor-centric formulations, however, describe only where a token is observed from, leaving the rich surface geometry of the scene region depicted by the token. In this paper, we advocate a shift toward surface-aware positional encoding that explicitly grounds patch tokens in the geometry of physical surfaces. We introduce HRoPE, which represents the local geometry of each patch as a slanted 3D plane, following the slanted support-window assumption of classical multi-view stereo. We inject token-level, plane-induced homographies into attention as relative transformations. This equips the transformer with a geometric prior for rectifying perspective distortions and aligning patch features across viewpoints. Our encoding requires no ground-truth geometry: the plane parameters can be predicted end-to-end under a view-synthesis objective alone, or derived from foundation models. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, CO3Dv2, and DL3DV show that our best variant of HRoPE consistently outperforms the evaluated geometric positional encodings for novel view synthesis. Extensive ablations and analysis show the effectiveness of the proposed encoding. Please refer to our project page at: https://gaohchen.github.io/HRoPE
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HROPE: 同位素相对位置编码
articles.content_zh: 几何相对位置 编码已成为将空间诱导偏差注入多视变压器的主要机制。 现有的设计将注意条件于相机层的frustum或射线深处,通过传感器几何将交叉视图符号连接起来. 然而,这种以感官为中心的配方只描述从中观察到一个符号的地方,留下该符号所描绘的场景区域的丰富的表面几何特征. 在本文中,我们主张转向表面知觉位置编码,在物理表面几何上明确设置补丁符号. 我们引入了HROPE,它代表每个补丁作为斜立面的局部几何,遵循古典多景立体的斜立式支持-窗口假设. 我们把信号级,平面引起的同位素 注入到相对的转变中 这为变压器配备了几何前缀,用于纠正视角扭曲,并调整跨视角的补丁特征. 我们的编码不需要地面真实几何:平面参数可以在单视合成目标下预测端到端,或者从基础模型中推导出. 有关RealEstate10K,CO3Dv2和DL3DV的广泛实验表明,我们最佳的HROPE的变体一贯优于评价的几何位置编码,用于新视觉合成. 广泛的编目和分析显示了拟议编码的有效性。 请参看我们的项目网页:https://gaohchen.github.io/HROPE。

articles.title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. While modern MLLMs perform well on common charts, their accuracy drops sharply on long-tail charts with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale. We introduce \textbf{ChartEvo}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to underperforming chart types through experience-driven harness-level self-improvement. ChartEvo jointly evolves reusable chart-specific Skills and executable Tools, while learning reusable local tool-call chains to compose evolved capabilities and control the inference overhead of tool-augmented reasoning. On long-tail charts from ChartBench and ChartX, ChartEvo improves accuracy over its base MLLM, Qwen3.7-Plus, by \textbf{45.6\%} and \textbf{32.5\%}, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of recursive self-improvement for long-tail chart adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 图表Evo:自演代理人哈内塞斯用于长塔图原因
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)在图的理解和推理方面有很大的进步,但其性能在图型之间仍然很不平衡. 虽然现代的MLLMs在常见图表上表现良好,但其精度却在具有多种视觉结构和推理要求的长尾图上急剧下降. 工具增强剂可以通过引入专门的视觉能力来改进复杂的图表推理,但手动工程策略和工具对于千差万别和不断演变的长尾巴来说是难以衡量的. 我们引入\textbf{ChartEvo},一个递归自我改进框架,通过经验驱动的牵引式自改进,使图表代理能够适应表现不佳的图表类型. 图表 Evo联合进化了可重复使用的图表特定技能和可执行工具,同时学习可重复使用的本地工具调用链,以编译进化的能力,控制工具增强推理的推论间接费用. 在图奔驰和图X的长尾图上,图埃沃分别通过\textbf{45.6\%}和\textbf{32.5\%},提高了其基础MLLM,Quen3.7-Plus的精度,证明了对长尾图修改的递归自我改进的有效性.

articles.title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
articles.content: Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation. It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry. To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement. Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction. We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement. To facilitate this task, we also curate a multi-source scene dataset covering diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, which will be open-sourced for community benefit. Experiments on our benchmark show our model significantly outperforms baselines without explicit geometric reasoning. We further develop a multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline that uses the model for text-driven scene generation. Project Page: https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GALA: 可控对象安排的几何-智能语言模型
articles.content_zh: 关于精细布置限制(如支持和遏制)的理由对于现实的3D场景创作至关重要. 对于依赖像定向边框(OBB)这样的简化对象表示法的现有方法来说,这仍然是一个重大挑战,因为后者对详细的几何学视而不见。 为解决这一局限性,我们引入了GALA,一种几何感知语言模型,对可控物体的放置有明确的点云感知. 我们的模型通过预测一个目标物体的6D姿势,在以场景背景和位置指示为条件的时间内进行自动递归. 我们采用分两个阶段的培训战略:第一阶段通过预训任务来协调几何和文字模式;第二阶段对安置模式进行微调。 为了便利这项工作,我们还管理了一个涵盖不同房间类型和精细家具安排的多来源场景数据集,该数据集将开放源码供社区使用。 关于我们基准的实验显示,我们的模型在没有明确几何推理的情况下,大大超过了基线。 我们进一步开发多阶段规划定位验证剂管线,采用文本驱动场景生成模式. 项目网页:https://xcelephant.github.io/paper/gala/

articles.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
articles.content: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VGL-stGen:学习肺组织学和空间转录学的共享模式
articles.content_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模式的大型语言模型,根据经过预先训练的医学视觉语言模型改编,使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学与单细胞参考. 训练融合了图像表达和表达细胞型对子,基因条件化的伪标签将tellopomic细胞型监督转移到了组织图像. 一个部署的检查站支持13项经过评价的任务,这些任务涉及组织分类和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞特征和观察到的基因表达的组合中有条件的表达完成。 任务特定的解码产生绝对的标签,基因列表和结构化的表达级别. 为了有条件的完成,固定被询问的基因身份,并自动预测其水平,从而改进结构化的预测。 受控的适应表明,将监管限制在请求的表达级符号上,可以进一步改善图像条件的完成. 图像-透视实验表明,正确配对的神学会添加超过观测表达的信息. 外部分类部分依赖于具有共享注释线的计算参考,一些H&E来源在癌症培训或模型开发期间被暴露. 在这些条件下,VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉语言骨干如何从空间转录学和组织学中学习,通过共享基因模型将组织形态和分子状态联系起来.

articles.title: PI-MLLM: Psychophysics-Inspired Multimodal Large Language Model for Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis
articles.content: Oddly Satisfying Videos (OSVs) can evoke strong viewer responses through repetitive motion, visual tactility, and ASMR-like sounds despite containing few explicit semantic emotion cues. This makes OSVs a challenging setting for Video Emotion Analysis (VEA), since most existing methods focus on semantic video content and under-model the physical sensory dynamics that shape viewer responses. To support Oddly Satisfying Video Emotion Analysis (OSVEA), we construct the Oddly Satisfying Video Dataset (OSVD), comprising 12,000 annotated 5-second clips. Each clip provides viewer-emotion labels under video-only, audio-only, and audio-visual conditions, together with explanations grounded in visual and acoustic sensory evidence. Building on OSVD, we propose PI-MLLM, a psychophysics-inspired multimodal large language model that integrates Modality-Specific Dynamics Alignment (MSDA) and Coalition-Based Audio-Visual Attribution (CAVA). MSDA uses auxiliary prediction objectives to align modality representations with visual motion and acoustic energy-onset dynamics. CAVA evaluates emotion scores across modality coalitions and applies Shapley attribution to identify the dominant modality and determine whether visual and auditory evidence is synergistic or conflicting. Experiments show that PI-MLLM improves both viewer-side emotion prediction and sensory-grounded explanation quality, suggesting the value of physical sensory cues to video emotion analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PI-MLLM:心理物理学-启发式多式大型语言模型 奇异满足视频情感分析
articles.content_zh: 奇怪的是,Satisfying Videos(OSVs)可以通过重复运动、视觉触觉和类似ASMR的声音引起观众的强烈反应,尽管其中很少包含明确的语义情感提示。 这使得OSVs成为视频情感分析(VEA)的具有挑战性的设定,因为大多数现有方法都侧重于语义视频内容,以及塑造观众反应的外观感官动态模型. 为了支持奇异满足视频情感分析(OSVEA),我们构建奇异满足视频数据集(OSVD),包含1.2万个注解的5秒片段. 每段片段都提供唯视频,唯音频,和视听条件下的观众-情感标签,以及基于视觉和声感证据的解释. 在OSVD的基础上,我们提出PI-MLLM,这是一个心理物理学启发的多模式大语言模型,它融合了Modality-Special Dynamics Unitation(MSDA)和基于联盟的视听归属(CAVA). MSDA使用辅助预测目标,使模式表达方式与视觉运动和声学能量对接动态一致. CAVA评价跨模式联盟的情感分数,并应用Shapley归属来识别主导模式,并确定视觉证据和听觉证据是协同还是相互冲突. 实验显示,PI-MLLM既改善了观众侧情感预测,又提高了感官定位解释的质量,为视频情感分析提出了物理感官提示的价值.

articles.title: Reliability-Aware Reconstruction of V-Shaped Surfaces with a Low-Cost Multi-Zone SPAD Sensor
articles.content: Low-cost multi-zone single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) sensors provide compact time-of-flight measurements but are limited by sparse sampling and unreliable depth estimates near geometric discontinuities. This letter presents a reliability-aware reconstruction framework for V-shaped surfaces using two complementary TMF8821 acquisition configurations. Point-wise reliability is learned from sensor confidence, transient peak amplitude, and peak sharpness, and is incorporated into a graph-based depth optimization. The reconstructed geometry is evaluated by robust two-plane fitting and a perpendicular cross-section. Experiments on 60-degree, 90-degree, and 120-degree targets reduce the mean V-angle error from 11.21 degrees to 9.66 degrees (13.8%). For the representative 90-degree target, the combined point-to-plane RMSE decreases from 14.56 mm to 13.65 mm.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用低成本多区域SPAD的 V 形状表面的可靠性- 智能重建 传感器
articles.content_zh: 低成本的多区单磷雪崩二极管(SPAD)传感器提供了紧凑的飞行时间测量数据,但由于采样稀少和接近几何断层的深度估计不可靠而受到限制。 此字母为V形面使用两个互补的TMF8821获取配置提供了可靠意识的重建框架. 点的可靠性是从传感器的置信度,瞬态峰值振幅,峰值锐度等学来的,并融入了基于图表的深度优化. 重建后的几何学通过坚固的双平面搭配和一个垂直截面来评价. 在60度,90度,120度目标上的实验将平均V角误差从11.21度降至9.66度(13.8%). 对于代表性的90度目标,综合点对点RMSE从14.56毫米下降到13.65毫米.

articles.title: SplatFlux: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Reconstruction and Generation from Video Latents
articles.content: This work presents SplatFlux, a feed-forward latent-to-4DGS framework for both video-based 4D reconstruction and conditional 4D generation. Our key observation is that observed videos and conditionally generated content can be represented in the same pretrained video latent space, allowing both tasks to be formulated as latent-to-4DGS decoding. To construct compact and temporally coherent 4D scenes, SplatFlux introduces a static-dynamic decoupled 4D Gaussian representation that explicitly predicts dynamic probabilities for Gaussian primitives. This representation separates static scene structures from moving regions, enabling complete 4D scene construction in a feed-forward manner through static aggregation and dynamic motion interpolation. To learn static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic Gaussian motion without costly annotations, we further develop an auxiliary distillation strategy that provides pseudo dynamic masks and optical-flow cues. Extensive experiments across 3D and 4D reconstruction and generation demonstrate that SplatFlux achieves state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SplateFlux: 种子前导 4D 高斯重建和从视频 Latents 生成
articles.content_zh: 这部作品呈现了SplatFlux,它是一个供基于视频的4D重建以及有条件的4D生成的Feed-forward潜在到4DGS框架. 我们的主要观察是,可观察到的视频和有条件生成的内容可以被表现在同一预先训练的视频潜在空间,使得这两个任务都能够被设定为潜在到4DGS解码. 为了构建紧凑和时间上连贯的4D场景,斯柏特福卢斯引入了静态动力解耦的4D高斯代表,明确预测了高斯原始人的动态概率. 这种表示方式将静态场景结构与移动区域区分开来,通过静态聚合和动态运动内插,使得4D场景建筑能够以向反馈的方式完成. 为了学习静态动力分解和动态高斯运动而无需花费高昂的注释,我们进一步发展了辅助蒸馏策略,提供伪动态口罩和光学流提示. 跨越3D和4D的重建与生成的广泛实验证明,SplateFlux实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: Convergent Performance, Divergent Mechanisms in LoRA-Adapted Vision Foundation Models for Brain MRI
articles.content: Adapting Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to medical imaging via LoRA has become standard practice, yet model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics, treating backbones with similar performance as interchangeable. We investigate whether equal performance implies equal internal representational shift. We analyse four ViT-B/16 backbones, DINOv3, SigLIP2, MerMED-FM, and BiomedCLIP, pre-trained with different objectives (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and on different data domains (natural vs. medical images). We adapt each to brain tumour segmentation and evaluate on six datasets covering both segmentation and Alzheimer's disease classification. Using attention divergence, weight-change analysis, and activation patching, we find that the four models converge to similar segmentation performance (mean Dice 78-81%) through markedly different internal dynamics, yet diverge in cross-task transfer: segmentation adaptation improves Alzheimer's disease classification for DINOv3 but degrades it for the other three backbones. We reveal a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance: the most heavily modified layers are not the causally relevant ones, with early-to-mid layers identified as sufficient for segmentation recovery. Restricting LoRA to these layers matches or approaches full-layer segmentation while reducing classification degradation in the three affected backbones, providing a mechanistically grounded strategy that is more parameter-efficient and more robust than standard full-layer adaptation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LoRA-Adaped的大脑核磁共振基础模型中的趋同性性能、不同机制
articles.content_zh: 通过LORA对视觉基础模型(VFMs)进行医学成像的改造已经成为标准做法,然而模型选择几乎完全由下游任务度量表指导,将性能相似的骨干视为可互换. 我们调查平等业绩是否意味着平等的内部代表性转变。 我们分析了四个Vit-B/16主干线,即DINov3、SigLIP2、MerMED-FM和BiomedCLIP,这些主干线具有不同的目标(自我消化与对比视觉语言)和不同的数据域(自然与医疗图像)。 我们每个都适应脑肿瘤的分化, 并评估六个数据集, 包括分化和阿尔茨海默病的分类。 通过注意力差异分析、权重变化分析以及激活补丁,我们发现这四个模型通过显著不同的内部动态与相似的分化性能(平均Dice 78-81%)汇合在一起,然而在跨任务转移中却存在差异:分化适应可以改善DINov3的阿尔茨海默氏病分类,但可以降低其他三个骨干。 我们揭示了修改幅度与因果重要性之间的脱节:修改最多的层不是因果相关的层,早期到中间层被确认足以进行分解恢复. 将LORA限制在这些层次上,匹配或接近全层分化,同时减少三个受影响的骨干骨干部的分类退化,提供了一个基于机械的战略,比标准全层适应更具有参数效率,更强.

articles.title: Region-Guided Food-Package Evidence Extraction and Abstention-Aware Draft R3337 Screening with Selective VLM Review
articles.content: Applying South Africa's draft R3337 warning criteria to food-package photographs requires nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. This study presents a region-guided evidence extraction and abstention-aware screening workflow for draft R3337. A three-class detector localises nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions, after which PaddleOCR and structured extraction recover nutrient values, ingredient evidence and product-form information. Recovered evidence is aggregated and assessed using deterministic draft R3337 rules. When evidence is incomplete, uncertain or conflicting, the workflow abstains through Review or Insufficient evidence rather than forcing an automatic outcome. For qualifying unresolved cases, a selective vision-language model (VLM) review stage using Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct reassesses unresolved evidence. Accepted evidence is merged and the same deterministic rules are reapplied. The workflow was applied to 442 products represented by 3,929 images. Evaluation used a manual validation set of 65 products. Before selective VLM review, 31 of 60 decidable products received automatic outcomes and 30 were correct, giving 51.7% coverage and 96.8% accuracy among automatic outcomes (selective accuracy). Selective VLM review resolved eight additional products, increasing coverage to 65.0%. Of 39 automatic outcomes, 38 were correct, giving 97.4% selective accuracy. The single false warning was retained from the rules-only workflow, while no unsafe warning omissions occurred after selective review. Evidence-level evaluation nevertheless identified incorrect VLM-recovered nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. These findings show that selective VLM review can recover unresolved evidence, while deterministic screening and explicit abstention remain necessary for reliable image-based draft R3337 screening.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 区域指导的食品包装证据提取和留置-预留R3337草案 审查
articles.content_zh: 将南非的R3337预警标准草案适用于食品包装照片需要营养、成分和产品形式的证据。 这项研究为R3337草案提供了一个区域指导的证据提取和弃权式筛选工作流程。 一个三级探测器将营养信息面板,成分清单和产品识别区域本地化,之后PaddleOCR和结构化提取恢复营养值,成分证据和产品形式信息. 利用R3337规则草案对已收回的证据进行汇总和评估。 当证据不完整、不确定或相互冲突时,工作流程通过审查或证据不足而放弃,而不是强迫自动结果。 对于未解决的案件,采用Qune3-VL 8B的选择性视觉语言模型(VLM)审查阶段,指示重新评估未解决的证据。 接受的证据被合并,同样的确定性规则重新适用。 该工作流程应用于以3 929幅图像为代表的442种产品。 评价采用由65个产品组成的人工验证组。 在选择性VLM审查之前,60种可决定产品中有31种获得自动结果,30种正确,自动结果的覆盖率为51.7%,准确度为96.8%(选择性准确性)。 选择性的VLM审查解决了另外8种产品,覆盖率提高到65.0%. 在39个自动结果中,38个正确,给予97.4%的选择性准确性。 仅从规则工作流程中保留了单一的虚假警告,而选择性审查后没有出现不安全的警告遗漏。 然而,证据一级的评价查明了未收回的VLM营养、成分和产品形式的证据。 这些调查结果表明,有选择的VLM审查可以收回未解决的证据,而确定性筛选和明确弃权对于基于图像的可靠草案R3337筛选仍然是必要的。

articles.title: Learn to Modify: Self-evolving Multi-agent Refinement Framework for Conversational Text-to-Motion Generation
articles.content: Despite rapid progress in text-to-motion generation, existing methods are commonly designed for single-shot generation. When users are dissatisfied with specific motion details, they are often forced to regenerate the entire sequence from scratch, which is computationally inefficient and potentially destroys previously established kinematic context. A practical generation system should instead support iterative user feedback and refine only the affected spatio-temporal regions while preserving the remaining motion. Therefore, we introduce a conversational motion generation paradigm that requires the system to coordinate instruction understanding, motion generation, localized editing, and quality assessment. Recent advances in LLM-driven multi-agent systems provide a promising foundation for such role-specialized coordination. To tackle these challenges, a Self-evolving Multi-Agent RefinemenT Framework (SMART) is proposed for conversational motion generation. Within SMART, to preserve semantic consistency, we design a semantic-guided masked motion editing mechanism, which precisely grounds natural language feedback into spatiotemporal motion regions to enable localized refinements without altering unedited regions. To reduce redundant exploration, we propose a memory-based self-evolving strategy that dynamically accumulates motion editing knowledge from interaction history and reuses past successful experience. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMART effectively supports multi-turn conversational motion generation and enables efficient motion refinement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习修改:自演多剂 优化对话文本到动作生成框架
articles.content_zh: 尽管在文本到动作生成上取得了迅速的进展,但现有的方法通常都是为单发生成而设计的. 当用户对具体的运动细节不满时,他们往往被迫从零开始重新生成整个序列,这在计算上效率低下,并有可能破坏之前已经确立的运动上下文. 实用生成系统应支持用户的迭代反馈,仅完善受影响的时空区域,同时保留剩余运动。 因此,我们引入了对话运动生成范式,要求系统协调指令理解,运动生成,本地化编辑和质量评估. 在LLM驱动的多代理系统方面最近取得的进展为这种作用专门化的协调提供了一个有希望的基础。 为应对这些挑战,建议为对话运动生成制定一个自我演变的多剂优化框架。 在SMART内部,为了保持语义一致性,我们设计了一个语义引导的蒙面运动编辑机制,这个机制准确地将自然语言反馈作为spatiopal运动区域的基础,以便能够在不改变未经编辑的区域的情况下进行局部的改进. 为了减少冗余探索,我们提出基于内存的自我演化策略,从互动历史中动态积累运动编辑知识,再利用过去的成功经验. 广泛的实验表明,SMART有效支持多回合对话运动生成,并能够高效地完善运动.

articles.title: Attractive Faces Skew Text-to-Image Reward Models and Leaderboards
articles.content: Human preference is now central to the evaluation, guidance, finetuning, and ranking of text-to-image models. However, the susceptibility of human preferences to bias in image generation remains underexplored. We identify a key observation: for human faces, perceived attractiveness overrides image quality in preference judgments, even when comparing real photographs of identical fidelity. In a controlled user study, annotators rank more attractive faces as higher quality, even when unattractive real faces are compared with attractive AI-generated ones. We examine the downstream consequences of this bias. Firstly, simulating Elo rankings from user study data shows attractiveness can invert a leaderboard's ranking, elevating synthetic attractive faces over real, unattractive ones. Secondly, the same bias reappears in the human preference models. Editing 40 annotated facial attributes in isolation, we find that attractiveness is the strongest correlate of score for four of five human preference models (PickScore, MPS, HPSv2.1, HPSv3), and the strongest predictor of score in regression analysis. We further show that preference aligned generation shifts faces toward younger, more feminine faces, and can override explicit prompts for unattractive faces, thereby limiting user control. Finally, we explore mitigation strategies, both for data collection and post training on human preference models. These findings highlight the need for preference models that disentangle image quality from human cognitive bias, enabling more reliable evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 吸引人的脸 扭曲文字到图像的奖励模式和领导板
articles.content_zh: 人类的偏好现在成为文字对形象模型的评价,指导,微调和排名的核心. 然而,人类在形象生成方面偏好偏好的可能性仍未得到充分探讨。 我们发现了一个关键的观点:对于人的面孔来说,感知的吸引力凌驾于偏好判断中的图像质量之上,即使在比较同样忠诚的真实照片时也是如此. 在一项受控制的用户研究中,注释者将更具吸引力的面孔排为更高的质量,即使将无吸引力的真实面孔与有吸引力的AI生成的面孔进行比较. 我们审查了这种偏见的下游后果。 首先,模拟 从用户研究数据得出的Elo排名显示,吸引力可以颠倒领导板的排名,提升合成吸引人的脸比真实的,不吸引人的脸. 第二,同样的偏见在人类偏好模式中再次出现。 孤立地编辑40个附加说明的面部属性,我们发现吸引力是人类五种偏好模型(PickScore,MPS,HPSv2.1,HPSv3)中四个分数最强的关联,也是回归分析中最强的分数预测器. 我们进一步表明,偏好一致的一代人面对更年轻、更女性的面孔,并且可以凌驾于对无吸引力面孔的明确提示之上,从而限制用户的控制。 最后,我们探讨缓解战略,包括数据收集和关于人类偏好模式的后期培训。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要将图像质量与人类认知偏见分开的偏好模型,从而能够进行更可靠的评价。

articles.title: Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation
articles.content: Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging that uses offline calibration to improve online cache compression. Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer-head allocations is prohibitively expensive. To enable efficient calibration, we show that attention-output error strongly correlates with end-to-end video quality and can therefore serve as a lightweight proxy for allocation risk assessment. We evaluate different allocation strategies using this proxy and construct a fixed layer-head risk map offline. Given a cache budget at inference time, CALM uses dynamic programming to determine the best allocation of merging ratios. Experiments across three different autoregressive video models demonstrate that CALM consistently outperforms uniform token merging under the same memory budget, by reducing the LPIPS to original videos by around 21% with higher video-quality scores.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 离线让在线更好:校准缓存压缩视频生成
articles.content_zh: Token合并是一种有效的方法,通过集成时间冗余的代币,仅保留少量代表物来减少自递式视频生成中的KV-cache内存消耗. 然而,现有方法通常对所有关注层和头实施统一的合并比率。 我们注意到,不同层次和头部对象征性合并表现出的敏感度大不相同,但相互关联,而且这些敏感度模式在各提示之间仍然一致。 基于这一观察,我们引入了 CALM, 一个校准的图层-头合并分配,它使用离线校准来改进在线缓存压缩. 详尽评估所有可能的层头拨款都极为昂贵。 为了能够有效校准,我们表明,注意力输出错误与端到端的视频质量密切相关,因此可作为分配风险评估的轻量级代用。 我们利用这个代用词来评价不同的分配策略,并构建一个线下固定的层头风险图. 鉴于在推断时间会有缓存预算,CALM使用动态编程来确定合并比率的最佳分配. 跨越三个不同自递录式视频模型的实验表明,CALM在相同的内存预算下,通过将LPIPS降为原声视频约21%,且视频质量分数较高,因此CALM一贯优于统一符号合并.

articles.title: Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement
articles.content: Incorrect exposure degrades both image brightness and recoverable scene detail. Existing sRGB-based correction methods are limited by the non-linear image signal processing pipeline, whereas RAW-based methods are usually developed for a single degradation type, such as low-light denoising or high-light recovery. In this paper, we focus on joint exposure correction and restoration directly in the RAW domain and propose a unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration (RIECR) framework for both under- and over-exposed images. RIECR decomposes the problem into two coupled sub-problems that follow the RAW imaging model: linear illumination correction and residual degradation restoration. First, a Linear Illumination Correction Network (LICN) estimates exposure-aware linear gains by using channel-specific RAW cues. It exploits the high signal-to-noise ratio of Green channels for robust brightening and the relatively unsaturated Red/Blue responses for high-light darkening. Second, a dual-branch Frequency-based Enhancement Network (FEN) restores the remaining degradation with a Frequency Dynamic Convolution (FDC) module. FDC decomposes convolutional responses into low- and high-frequency components and adaptively suppresses amplified noise or recovers clipped textures according to the exposure context. We further build a real paired RAW benchmark containing 223 scenes and 1,784 pairs covering complex multi-exposure errors. Experiments against sixteen state-of-the-art methods show that RIECR achieves state-of-the-art performance on real RAW exposure correction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过线性照明和频率增强统一RAW图像曝光校正和修复
articles.content_zh: 不正确的曝光会同时降低图像亮度和可回收的场景细节. 现有的基于sRGB的校正方法受到非线性图像信号处理管道的限制,而基于RAW的方法通常为单一的降解型开发,如低光去诺或高光回收. 在本文中,我们侧重于在RAW领域直接进行联合曝光校正和修复,并为未曝光和过度曝光的图像提出统一的RAW图像校正和修复框架。 RIECR将问题分解成遵循RAW成像模型的两个连结子问题:线性照明校正和剩余降解还原. 首先,一个线性照明校正网络(LICN)通过使用频道专用RAW提示来估计接触感线性增益. 它利用Green通道的高信号对噪声比来进行强亮,相对不饱和的Red/Blue反应来进行高光变暗. 其次,一个基于频率的双分支增强网络(FEN)用频率动态转录(FDC)模块恢复剩余的降解. FDC分解反应为低频和高频元件,并适应性地抑制放大噪声或根据接触环境恢复剪切纹理. 我们进一步构建一个真正的对齐RAW基准,包含223场景和1,784对覆盖复杂的多接触错误. 针对16种最先进的方法进行的实验表明,RIECR在真正的RAW暴露校正上实现了最先进的性能.

articles.title: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CrossFit-GS:用于COLMAP-无3D高斯电镀的Fold Pose估计
articles.content_zh: 免波斯3D高斯电镀(3DGS)旨在绕过繁琐的结构-从-Motion(SfM),直接从无位图像序列重建场景. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了CrossFit-GS,这是一个推迟承诺的渐进框架,它减轻了累积的轨迹漂移,打破了扭曲图误差传播的自我强化循环。 具体来说,我们把输入序列分割成互离子集,并保持两个互补的子图. 每个候选姿势对一个从未使用目标框架优化过的冷冻对面潜水图进行交叉改进,从而为姿势估计提供了独立的几何参考. 检查板验证和空间覆盖保障进一步拒绝不可靠的更新,只有经核实的姿势才会被承诺给相应的所有者子地图. 轨迹精炼后,中间子图被丢弃,最后的全球代表用固定精炼的姿势从头开始训练. 跨多个基准的广泛评价表明,CrossFit-GS可大大减少累积轨迹漂移,并不断改进相机对现行方法的估算和新视角综合。

articles.title: CAPS: Clinically-Verifiable Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis for Missing MRI Imputation in Brain Tumor Segmentation
articles.content: Multi-parametric MRI is the gold standard for neuro-oncology, yet acquiring complete 4-modality protocols may be unfeasible in real-world clinical practice. When handling missing modalities, existing automated systems force a critical compromise: robust segmenters operate as uninterpretable "black boxes" that bypass image generation, while standard synthesis models often produce blurry reconstructions lacking diagnostic reliability. To address this issue, we propose CAPS, a Clinically-Verifiable Anatomy-Prioritized Synthesis framework that reconciles computational precision with clinical transparency. Our multi-modal generative architecture is driven by a hybrid objective function (L_1 + L_AFP + L_DualDice) that explicitly enforces the preservation of deep anatomical features and strict topological boundaries, rather than relying solely on pixel-wise optimization. Evaluated comprehensively on the BraTS Adult Glioma dataset, the framework achieves superior synthesis fidelity across intensity-based metrics, and demonstrates robust downstream segmentation performance (82.38% mean Dice), successfully restoring verifiable visual context. Furthermore, the framework exhibits exceptional zero-shot cross-domain generalization, maintaining high structural fidelity across completely unseen Meningioma, Pediatric, and Sub-Saharan African cohorts without domain-specific adaptation. Finally, a blinded radiological assessment confirms that our anatomy-aware approach significantly enhances both perceived image quality and clinical utility, providing clinicians with the reliable visual evidence required to trust downstream automated workflows.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CAPS: 脑肿瘤分裂中缺失核磁共振的临床可验证解剖学优先合成
articles.content_zh: 多参数 核磁共振是神经肿瘤学的金本位,但获得完整的4模式协议在现实世界的临床实践中可能不可行. 在处理缺失模式时,现有的自动化系统迫使一个关键的折中方案: 强力的分区器作为无法解释的"黑匣子"运行,绕过图像生成,而标准合成模型往往产生缺乏诊断可靠性的模糊重建. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用CAPS这一临床可验证的解剖学优先合成框架,使计算精度与临床透明度相协调。 我们的多模式基因结构是由混合目标函数(L_1 + L_AFP + L_DualDice)驱动的,它明确强制保护深解剖特征和严格的地形界限,而不是完全依赖像素优化. 对BrATS Adult Glioma数据集进行了全面评估,该框架实现了基于强度的衡量尺度的超强合成忠诚度,并展示了强力的下游分解性能(82.38%指Dice),成功恢复了可核查的视觉环境. 此外,该框架展现出非凡的零镜头跨域通用,在完全不为人知的梅宁吉欧马、小儿科和撒哈拉以南非洲组别中保持高结构的忠诚度,而不对具体领域进行调整。 最后,一项盲目的放射评估证实,我们的解剖意识方法大大提高了所感知的图像质量和临床效用,为临床医生提供了相信下游自动化工作流程所需的可靠视觉证据.

articles.title: DocLayout-YOLO: Axis-Attentive Document Layout Detector with Mesh-Guided Synthetic Pretraining
articles.content: Accurate and efficient document layout analysis is critical for modern document parsing systems. However, although the YOLO framework represents a leading paradigm for the real-time detector, its adaptation to heterogeneous documents remains underexplored. To address this gap, we propose DocLayout-YOLO, a document-specialized real-time detector that integrates diverse synthetic document pretraining and page-axis context modeling. From the data perspective, we introduce MeshLayout-1M, a synthetic pretraining corpus generated by the proposed Mesh-candidate BestFit algorithm, which provides large-scale and diverse document layouts for pretraining and improves adaptation to heterogeneous document scenarios. From the model perspective, we propose Page-Axis Layout Attention (PALA), which captures long-range dependencies along the horizontal and vertical page axes while remaining computationally efficient. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocLayout-YOLO achieves state-of-the-art performance on four heterogeneous document benchmarks, obtaining 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1% mAP50:95 on D4LA, M6Doc, HJDataset, and PRIMA-LAD, respectively. Compared with existing real-time detectors, DocLayout-YOLO establishes a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off in document layout analysis. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/opendatalab/DocLayout-YOLO/tree/release-v2.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DocLayout-YOLO:带有 Mesh-Guided合成预训的轴加速文档布局检测器
articles.content_zh: 准确有效的文件布局分析对现代文件解析系统至关重要。 然而,虽然YOLO框架是实时探测器的主要范例,但它对各种文件的适应仍然没有得到充分利用。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议使用DocLayout-YOLO,这是一个专门使用的文件实时探测器,将多种合成文件预训和页轴上下文建模结合起来。 从数据角度出发,我们介绍MeshLayout-1M,这是一种由拟议的Mesh-candidate BestFit算法生成的合成预训程序,它为预训提供了大规模和多样的文件布局,并改进了对不同文件情景的适应. 从模型角度,我们提议Page-Axis布局注意(PALA),它沿水平和垂直页轴捕捉远距离的依赖性,同时保持计算效率. 广泛的实验表明,DocLayout-YOLO在四个不同的文件基准上实现了最先进的性能,并取得了 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1%/mAP50:95,分别为D4LA、M6Doc、HJDataset和PRIMA-LAD。 与现有的实时探测器相比,DocLayout-YOLO在文档布局分析中确立了一种优异的精度效率权衡. 代码、模型和数据见https://github.com/opendatalab/DocLayout-YOLO/tree/release-v2。

articles.title: OV-Foam: How 3D Representations Shape Semantic Feature Lifting
articles.content: Existing feature lifting approaches for open-vocabulary segmentation rely on simple backprojection to assign features to primitives. In the case of 3D Gaussian splatting reconstruction, the primitives overlap heavily, leading to suboptimal reconstructions, governed by many primitives per ray. Backprojection, however, reduces to a least-squares solvable problem, exactly when no two primitives share a ray. Motivated by this insight, we propose OV-Foam, which uses PowerFoam as the underlying representation. This representation uses a power-diagram to partition the scene, resulting in zero overlap between primitives and a substantial reduction in primitives per ray, which ultimately simplifies the lifting problem and allows for closer-to-optimal feature assignment. We show that the space partitioning primitives of OV-Foam reach near-optimal assignment, and our experiments demonstrate improved open-vocabulary segmentation over Gaussian baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OV-Foam:如何3D表达 形状语义特征提升
articles.content_zh: 现有的功能提升方法用于开放-vocabulary分割,依赖于简单的后投影来给原始人分配特征. 在3D高斯浮雕重建中,原始人大量重叠,导致重建不理想,每射线由许多原始人管理. 然而,后期预测会降低到一个最小的可溶性问题,恰好是在没有两个原始人共享射线的时候. 基于这一见解,我们提议使用PowerFoam作为基本代表的OV-Foam。 这种表示法使用电位图来分割场景,导致原始人之间零重叠,每射线的原始人大量减少,最终简化了升降问题,允许更接近最优化的特征分配. 我们显示 OV-Foam 的空间分割原始物 接近最理想的任务 我们的实验显示 高斯基线上的开放-伏特加分化

articles.title: GAMF-Net: Grouped Availability-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Smartphone Skin Lesion Classification
articles.content: Smartphone clinical images provide a low-cost data source for computer-aided skin lesion classification in resource-constrained settings, but images alone cannot fully capture patients' medical histories and lesion symptoms. To address the lack of structured organization among heterogeneous clinical variables, the ambiguity between observed and imputed values, and the risk that clinical information may interfere with visual evidence, we propose GAMF-Net, a grouped availability-aware multimodal fusion network. Ten clinical variables are divided into three semantic groups---demographics, history-related risk, and lesion presentation---and each group jointly encodes field values and field-level availability masks. The image branch produces the base classification logits, while each clinical group generates image-conditioned class-level residual evidence. Only available groups participate in availability-normalized equal-weight fusion; when all clinical information is unavailable, the model reduces exactly to the image-only pathway. We evaluate the method on PAD-UFES-20 under a patient-disjoint five-fold protocol with separate training, validation, and test partitions. GAMF-Net achieves an Accuracy of $74.17\pm2.85\%$, a balanced accuracy (BACC) of $70.11\pm2.11\%$, a Macro-F1 of $68.85\pm0.85\%$, and a Macro-AUROC of $93.42\pm1.20\%$, outperforming all image-only and multimodal baselines reimplemented under a unified protocol. Compared with the strongest baseline, MetaBlock, the corresponding improvements are 2.37, 2.59, 4.14, and 1.02 percentage points, respectively. Ablation results show that clinical information substantially improves class-balanced performance, constrained equal-weight fusion is more effective than dynamic fusion, and the lesion-presentation group provides the most informative clinical complement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GAMF-Net: 智能手机皮肤粘膜分类的组合式可用性-软件多式组合
articles.content_zh: 智能手机临床图像为在受资源限制的环境下计算机辅助的皮肤损伤分类提供了低成本数据源,但仅凭图像无法完全捕捉患者的病史和损伤症状. 为了解决不同临床变量之间缺乏结构组织的问题、观测值和估算值之间的模糊性以及临床信息可能干扰视觉证据的风险,我们建议建立GAMF-Net,这是一个分组的可用性-认识多模式聚变网络。 10个临床变量分为3个语义组——人口学组,历史相关风险组,以及损伤呈现组——每个组联合编码场值和场级可用口罩. 图像分支生成基础分类日志,而每个临床组群生成图像有条件的类级残留证据. 只有可用群体参与可用性正常的等重聚变;当所有临床信息都无法获得时,模型就完全缩小到只有图像的路径. 在PAD-UFES-20上, GAMF-Net的精确度为74.17\pm2.85\$,平衡精度(BACC)为70.11\pm2.11\$,宏-F1为68.85\pm0.85\$,宏-AUROC为93.42\pm1.20\$,优于统一协议下重新执行的所有图像和多模式基线. 与最强基线MetaBlock相比,相应的改进分别为2.37,2.59,4.14和1.02个百分点. 膨胀结果显示,临床信息大大改善了类平衡性能,受限的等重聚比动态聚变更有效,损伤-呈现组提供了最丰富的临床补充.

articles.title: PointForward V2: Point-Aligned Interaction for Feedforward Driving Reconstruction
articles.content: Feedforward reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes requires integrating observations across multiple views and time steps into a coherent 3D representation. PointForward established state-of-the-art feedforward driving reconstruction by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries, demonstrating the effectiveness of point-aligned scene representations. However, these queries are largely processed independently, limiting information exchange across space and time, while direct global attention among tens of thousands of point queries is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we present \textbf{PointForward V2}, which advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Our key idea is to mediate query interaction through compact, scene-structured registers. For the static background, frame-wise Static Scene Registers compress point information, communicate across frames, and propagate the aggregated context back to the queries. For each dynamic instance, queries from different frames are aligned in an object-centric canonical space and interact through instance-specific Dynamic Instance Registers. We further employ 4D positional encoding that combines aligned spatial coordinates with original timestamps, enabling spatially aligned yet temporally distinguishable interactions. In this way, PointForward V2 enables scalable spatio-temporal reasoning directly among lifted 3D queries without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across large-scale driving benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 前进点 V2:促进向前进驱动重建的点对接
articles.content_zh: 向后重建动态驱动场景,需要将多种观点和时间步骤的观察纳入连贯的三维代表。 PointForward通过将图像观测提升到稀疏的3D查询中,以显示点对齐场景表现效果的方式,建立了先进的驱动重建的源头. 然而,这些查询基本上是独立处理的,限制了跨时空的信息交流,而数以万计的点查询之间的直接全球关注在计算上是令人无法接受的。 在这项工作中,我们提出\ textbf{PointForward V2},它将点对齐的表示推进到点对齐的交互. 我们的关键想法是通过紧凑的场景结构登记册来调解查询互动。 对于静态背景,采用帧式的静态场景登记册压缩点信息,跨帧通信,并将汇总上下文传播回查询中. 对于每个动态实例,来自不同框架的查询在一个以物体为中心的条形空间中对齐,并通过实例特定的动态实例登记册进行互动。 我们进一步采用4D定位编码,将对齐的空间坐标与原来的时间戳结合起来,使空间对齐但可分时的相互作用成为可能。 这样,PointForward V2就可以在不引起全球关注的情况下,在解除的3D查询中直接进行可伸缩的时空推理. 有关Waymo,nuScens,Argoverse 2的实验展示了跨越大规模驾驶基准的先进性能.

articles.title: Reliability-Guided Vision-Language Decoding with Text-Aware Skip Refinement for Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Medical image segmentation remains challenging when targets exhibit limited visual distinction, irregular structure, or substantial variation across imaging modalities. Medical text can reduce this ambiguity, but indiscriminate fusion may introduce unreliable guidance. We present RELiF, a vision--language framework that integrates text through reliability-guided decoding. Its Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG) adaptively controls cross-modal updates, while the Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA) refines high-resolution features using text guidance. RELiF is evaluated on radiographic, CT, and endoscopic segmentation tasks, where it shows competitive performance across diverse imaging characteristics and target appearances. Additional analyses examine efficiency and stability. The complementary uncertainty representation derived from the reliability response also shows an association with prediction difficulty, with higher uncertainty values occurring more frequently in pixels associated with segmentation errors. Code: https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可靠性 - 引导视野 - 语言 与文本- 智能跳过校正
articles.content_zh: 当目标视差有限、结构不规则或成像方式差异很大时,医疗图像分割仍然具有挑战性。 医学文本可以减少这种模糊性,但不加区别的聚变可能会引入不可靠的指导. 我们提出RELiF,这是一个通过可靠性指导的解码整合文本的视觉语言框架. 其可靠性导引的Fusion Gate(RFG)可适应性地控制跨模式的更新,而文本导引的Skip Finement适配器(TSRA)则利用文本导引改进高分辨率特性. RELiF在射线、CT和内视分片任务上得到评价,显示不同成像特征和目标外观的竞争性性能。 其他分析审查了效率和稳定性。 从可靠性反应中得出的互补的不确定性表示也显示出与预测难度的联系,更高的不确定性值在与分解错误相关的像素中更频繁地出现. 代码:https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-09-02.

articles.title: LatticeRank: Spacing-Ranked Consistency for Native-Grid 3D Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Variable voxel spacing changes more than image resolution: it alters the discrete sampling lattice, tensor geometry, and anatomical evidence available to a 3D segmentation network. While conventional pipelines restore images to a canonical grid, direct-grid deployment requires the model itself to tolerate these changes. We observe that candidate grids are not exchangeable views -- a coarse grid removes more structural information than a mildly resampled one -- yet standard consistency objectives assign them equal influence. We therefore propose LatticeRank, a training-only framework that aligns candidate posteriors in physical space and allocates consistency supervision by voxel-spacing order: among endpoint-matched candidates, the auxiliary loss concentrates on the coarsest requested grid, while inference retains a single network forward with no candidate branch or ensemble. On MSD Task04, LatticeRank improves coarse-grid Extra Dice over mean consistency by 0.03436 across five seeds while meeting the prespecified reference-grid noninferiority criterion. A controlled ladder shows that grid exposure provides the largest recovery, posterior consistency adds a second gain, and spacing-ranked allocation yields the strongest direct-grid result; requested spacing thus provides a simple, model-independent ordering signal for direct-grid consistency learning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LatticeRank: 本地- Grid 3D 医疗图像分割的间距- Rank 一致性
articles.content_zh: 可变的 voxel 间隔变化大于图像分辨率:它改变离散的采样纹饰,拉伸几何,以及3D分解网络可用的解剖证据. 虽然常规管道将图像恢复到犬形网格,但直网部署需要模型本身容忍这些变化. 我们观察到,候选网格不是可以交换的观点 -- -- 一个粗糙的网格去除的结构信息比一个温和的复印信息要多 -- -- 而标准的一致性目标却赋予它们同等的影响。 因此,我们提出LatticeRank,这是一个只在物理空间上协调候选人后方的训练框架,并按排位顺序分配一致性监督:在端点匹配的候选者中,辅助损失集中在要求的较宽网格上,而推论则保留一个单一的网络,没有候选分支或综艺。 在MSD Task04上,LatticeRank在满足预先指定的参考网非贫性标准的同时,将粗格-格格特加Dice改进为5个种子的平均一致性为0.03436。 受控阶梯显示,电网曝光提供了最大的恢复,后一致性增加了第二个收益,按间隔排序的分配产生最强的直接电网结果;因此,要求的间隔为直接电网一致性学习提供了简单,模式独立的订购信号.

articles.title: WildAIGC-Bench: Can AI Image Detectors Handle the Wild? A Benchmark of Generated and Edited Images in Online Circulation
articles.content: AI-generated images linked to news events and online claims can mislead audiences, enable fraud, or cause public controversy. We introduce WildAIGC-Bench, built through recurring collection across news websites, fact-checking sources, and related social media content. The pipeline combines broad coverage, timely updates, and human-verified labels through scheduled discovery, automatic screening and preliminary annotation, and human review of image-specific evidence. The benchmark contains 407 verified AI-generated or edited images, each accompanied by a source webpage link and an evidence summary. Images retain the conditions encountered online, including compression, screenshots, and recapture. Evaluation of dedicated visual detectors, multimodal large language models, and a simple Perception Encoder baseline reveals substantial recall gaps relative to existing benchmarks. WildAIGC-Bench provides both a practical detection challenge and a basis for continued data expansion and source-based verification. The dataset is released at https://github.com/YuZijian/WildAIGC-Bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WildAIGC-Bench:AI图像探测器能处理野外吗?. 在线发行中生成和编辑图像的基准
articles.content_zh: AI生成的与新闻事件和在线诉求相关的图像可能会误导受众,导致欺诈,或者引起公众争议. 我们介绍WildAIGC-Bench, 该管道通过定期发现、自动筛选和初步说明以及人对特定图像证据的审查,将广泛覆盖、及时更新和经人验证的标签结合起来。 该基准包含407个经核实的AI生成或编辑的图像,每个图像都附有源网页链接和证据摘要. 图像保留了在网上遇到的条件,包括压缩、截图和重获。 对专用视觉探测器、多模式大型语言模型和简单感知编码器基线的评价显示,相对于现有基准而言,存在很大的召回差距。 WildAIGC-Bench既为实际探测提供了挑战,也为数据的持续扩展和基于源的验证提供了基础. 数据集发布于https://github.com/YuZijian/WildAIGC-Bench.

articles.title: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MoDDIT: 传播变形器中的简单调试
articles.content_zh: 实时视频生成,交互式世界模型,以及在线设备图像合成几乎是一个现实. 扩散变压器(DiT)实现了优异的样品质量,把瓶颈转移到模型本身的吞吐量上. 自然图像本来就是稀少的,因为一幅图像的很大一部分往往是背景,对场景内容贡献不大,很容易被揭穿. DiTs未能利用这种垃圾,因为它们会静态和统一地处理图像符号. 我们提出MoDDiT,一种简单的架构修改,通过MLP和自觉操作学习路由符号. 通过独立通过两个块的路由符,MODDIT允许在MLP中进行动态计算分配,这些分配在符号,图像,以及去诺定时步上都有所不同. 使用MODDIT从零开始训练图像生成模型,大大减少了培训和推论的计算成本,处理的代币只有12.5%. 通过增加垃圾和模型深度,MODDIT减少了成本,并改进了非常规基线的生成性能. 所学的分布是可解释的,揭示了在视觉内容和噪音水平上计算的不同. 我们还使用MODDIT来训练视频生成模型, 分配与运动相关,

articles.title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
articles.content: As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations. However, dense patch representations expose a redundant interface to downstream predictors, which must implicitly infer spatial organization and temporal correspondence, presenting three challenges. First, object information is distributed across patches, forcing each downstream predictor to redundantly recover object structure that could otherwise be reused across tasks before modeling interactions. Second, the lack of explicit entity correspondence across time makes historical transitions expensive, restricting the predictor's flexibility in utilizing context. Third, without explicit transport structure, existing JEPA models typically use pointwise l1/l2 distances, which are insensitive to spatial displacement when predicted and goal supports are largely disjoint. We propose the Slot-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Slot-JEPA), which decomposes dense representations into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks. Pretrained once and frozen downstream, this decomposition exposes a reusable object-structured interface. Building on it, our Transition Memory Predictor (TMP) stores visual transitions as compact masks and retrieves useful context using statistics of corresponding slots. Its two branches separate slot-specific dynamics from shared cross-slot dynamics. We further use Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to supervise mask prediction and evaluate candidate plans by transporting mass between aligned predicted and goal masks, providing a signal better aligned with spatial progress. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, the slot-reconstructed features remain transferable. Slot-JEPA also improves goal-conditioned planning across six planar environments and four robotic arm planning tasks on the REALM-JEPA benchmark.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Slot-JEPA: 后期世界模型的定型接口
articles.content_zh: 作为典型的潜伏世界模型,联合预测建筑提供了强烈的语义表述。 然而,密集的补丁表示向下游预测器暴露了一个冗余的接口,它必须隐含地推断空间组织和时间对应,这带来了三个挑战. 首先,对象信息在补丁之间分布,迫使每个下游预测器在模拟相互作用之前重复恢复本来可以跨任务重复使用的对象结构. 第二,由于长期缺乏明确的实体对应关系,历史过渡费用昂贵,限制了预测者利用背景的灵活性。 第三,没有明确的运输结构,现有的JEPA模型通常使用点/l2距离,在预测和目标支持基本脱节时,这些距离对空间位移不敏感。 我们提议采用以槽为基础的联合预测结构(Slot-JEPA),它将密集的表示分解为稳定的语义插槽和时空变化的空间面具。 这种分解会暴露出可重复使用的对象结构接口。 在此基础上,我们的过渡内存预置器(TMP)将视觉过渡作为紧凑的口罩存储,并利用相应插槽的统计检索有用的上下文. 其两个分支将特定档位动态与共享跨档位动态分开. 我们还利用不平衡的优化运输(UOT),通过在对齐的预测口罩和瞄准口罩之间运输质量来监督口罩预测和评估候选计划,提供与空间进步更吻合的信号. 在7项可视理解的基准中,时间档调整的特征仍然可以转让。 Slot-JEPA还改进了6个平面环境的有目标条件的规划,以及REALM-JEPA基准上的4个机器人臂部规划任务.

articles.title: Auditing Where Concept Bottleneck Accuracy Comes From on CUB
articles.content: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promise predictions that humans can inspect and correct through concepts such as "curved beak". Yet on CUB-200-2011, their standard benchmark, progress is measured like that of ordinary classifiers: by task and concept accuracy. Neither reveals whether the label is predicted from the exposed concept scores, or whether a concept is supported by visual evidence of that concept rather than by co-occurring features such as cues to the species as a whole. We audit where the accuracy of CBMs and Concept Embedding Models (CEMs) on CUB comes from. The CUB annotations are too noisy to explain it: class-level training labels agree with per-image annotations on only ~82% of image--concept pairs, and classifiers trained on per-image annotations reach only ~37% species accuracy. Leakage probes show that CEM predictions cannot be reconstructed from their concept scores; the missing class information sits in internal embeddings. We identify four design axes through which class information can enter concept scores---receptive field, shared versus concept-specific representations, norm-dependent scoring, and task supervision. An ablation shows that most of it enters through non-local features: restricting a ResNet50 backbone to local BagNet patches lowers the accuracy recoverable from concept scores from 72% to 43%, close to what ground-truth annotations support, while joint training raises it again at the cost of concept accuracy. Localization and occlusion show that locality makes grounding measurable but does not guarantee it: under class-level labels, local concept scores use the head as a proxy for body, wing, and tail concepts, and CEM concept scores barely respond to occluding their supporting part. Task and concept accuracy should thus support, not drive, the evaluation of CBMs, and given the noisy annotations, CUB accuracy gaps should not be overinterpreted.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 审计CUB概念的准确性
articles.content_zh: Bottleneck Models(CFM)概念预言,人类可以通过"弯曲的喙"等概念来检查和纠正. 然而,在CUB-200-2011标准基准上,进展的衡量方式与普通分类人员相同:按照任务和概念的准确性。 也没有揭示标签是从暴露的概念分数中预测的,或者一个概念是否得到这一概念的视觉证据的支持,而不是共同出现的特征,如给整个物种的提示。 我们审计CUB上的建立信任措施和概念嵌入模型的准确性。 CUB说明过于吵吵,无法解释:班级训练标签只同意图像概念对偶的~82%的逐象说明,接受过逐象说明训练的分类人员只达到~37%的物种精度. 泄漏探测器显示CEM预测无法从其概念分数中重建;缺失的类信息坐落在内部嵌入中. 我们确定了四个设计轴线,通过这些轴线,类信息可以进入概念分数 -- -- 接受领域,共享与概念具体表述,规范依赖分数,以及任务监督。 一项删减表明,大部分内容是通过非本地特性进入的:将一个ResNet50主干线限制在本地的BagNet补丁中,将概念分数中可回收的精度从72%降低到43%,接近地面真实说明支持的内容,而联合培训则以概念精度为代价再次提升. 本地化和隐蔽性表明,地方性使得地基可以测量,但并不能保证:在类级标签下,地方概念分数使用头作为身体,翅膀,尾部概念的代名词,CEM概念分数几乎不会回应占位支持部分. 因此,任务和概念的准确性应当支持而不是推动对建立信任措施的评价,而且鉴于说明很吵,不应过度解释CUB的准确性差距。

articles.title: Assessing Representation Semantics Under Language Pretraining in Fine-Grained Classification
articles.content: Understanding how supervision signals shape semantic visual representations remains challenging, particularly in fine-grained, low-data settings. Standard evaluations of vision models rely on downstream accuracy, which often fails to capture structural differences in learned representations. We propose a compact explainability-driven framework for comparing encoders trained with classification-only and caption-generation supervision on CUB-200. Using a controlled two-stage protocol in which both encoders are ultimately optimized for the same classification task, we enable a direct comparison of the resulting representations. Saliency maps are generated using attention rollout and gradient-weighted rollout and evaluated with five metrics covering faithfulness (positive and negative perturbation) and localization (keypoint emphasis, background attribution, and Earth Mover's Distance). Across random seeds and explanation methods, caption supervision yields representations that are more sensitive to the removal of salient regions, better aligned with annotated object parts, and less reliant on background regions, whereas classification supervision produces representations that are slightly more robust to the removal of low-saliency regions. An ablation study on the Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset shows consistent trends across key metrics. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework makes supervision-induced representational differences observable and quantifiable beyond downstream accuracy alone. More broadly, it provides a systematic basis for assessing learned representations and comparing alternative training and transfer-learning strategies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在精细分类语言预训下评估代表性语义
articles.content_zh: 理解监督信号如何塑造语义视觉表现仍然具有挑战性,特别是在精细的低数据环境中. 愿景模型的标准评价依赖于下游的准确性,这往往无法捕捉到所学表现的结构性差异. 我们提出一个紧凑的可解释性驱动框架,以比较经过专门分类和CUB-200字幕生成监督培训的编码器。 使用一个可控的两阶段协议,其中两个编码器最终被优化用于相同的分类任务,我们使得能够直接比较由此产生的表示. 利用注意力的展开和梯度加权的展开生成显著的地图,并用5个衡量标准进行评估,包括忠诚度(正和负扰动)和局部化(关键点强调、背景归属和地球移动器的距离)。 在随机种子和解释方法中,字幕监督生成的表述对清除突出区域更为敏感,与标注的对象部分更加一致,较少依赖背景区域,而分类监督生成的表述对清除低高度区域略强。 对牛津-IIIT Pet数据集进行的一项扩展研究显示,关键衡量标准的趋势是一致的。 这些结果表明,拟议的框架使监督引起的代表性差异可以观察到,而且可以量化,超出了下游的准确性。 更广泛地说,它为评估学到的表述和比较替代培训和转让学习战略提供了一个系统的基础。

articles.title: A Process-Informed, Photorealistic Digital Twin for Vision-Based Inline Inspection of C-SMC Strip Deposition
articles.content: Inline quality assurance for Sheet Molding Compound (SMC) manufacturing is hindered by the lack of large-scale, accurately labeled image datasets for training machine-learning models. This work presents a process-informed, photorealistic digital twin for carbon-fiber SMC strip deposition. A rigid-body simulation reproduces the deposition kinematics (settling, friction, belt motion), while a physically grounded polarization-rendering model produces realistic appearance, so that every image carries exact, mutually consistent labels in synchronized formats: oriented bounding boxes, point annotations, density maps, and polarization renderings (Angle and Degree of Linear Polarization).
