Because the joint distribution of many overlapping strips cannot be specified analytically, simulation yields exact, scalable ground truth that manual annotation cannot provide. The twin produces over 16,000 images across 3,300 frames, and the synthetic data replicate near-isotropic fiber orientation (axial concentration r < 0.05) consistent with as-deposited commercial SMC. Trained purely on synthetic data, YOLOv11 and CSRNet reach detection mAP50 up to 0.91, with a dedicated oriented-bounding-box detector confirming the oriented labels are directly trainable (mAP50 = 0.83); on real manufacturing images, the synthetic-to-real difference in edge and texture structure (Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance 0.46, distribution overlap 0.56) is of the same magnitude as the difference between two real acquisition series of the same material (0.41, overlap 0.57). The approach substantially reduces the labeling burden for camera-based inline inspection of fiber orientation and volume content.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: C-SMC脱衣物沉降状态的视网膜检查
articles.content_zh: 由于缺乏用于培训机器学习模型的大规模、准确标签的图像数据集,不利于对薄膜混合材料制造进行内部质量保证。 这项工作为碳纤维SMC条状沉积提供了一个过程知情、光现实化的数字双胞胎。 僵硬的身体模拟复制沉积动因子(沉积,摩擦,带运动),而实体基底的极化-落地模型则产生现实的外观,使每个图像都带有精确的,相互一致的标签,格式是:定向的边框,点注,密度图,以及极化渲染(Angle和度线性极化). 由于无法在分析上确定许多重叠条的合分布,模拟产生精确,可伸缩的地面真伪,人工注释无法提供. 双胞胎生产出超过16,000幅图像,跨越3,300帧,合成数据复制了近异位纤维方向(轴浓度r < 0.05),与被弃置的商业SMC一致. YOLOv11和CSRNet纯粹在合成数据上进行训练,可达到检测mAP50至0.91,专用的定向捆绑箱检测器确认定向标签是可直接训练的(mAP50=0.83);在真实制造图像上,在边缘和纹理结构上的合成-实际差异(Kolmogorov-Smirnov距离0.46,分布重叠0.56)与同一材料的两个真正获得系列的区别(0.41,重叠0.57)相同. 这种方法大大减轻了对纤维定向和体积内容进行以照相机为基础的内线检查的标签负担。

articles.title: Spherical Geometry-Aware Panoptic Scene Graph Generation for Equirectangular Panoramas
articles.content: Panoptic scene graph generation (PSGG) represents scene entities with segmentation masks and directed relations. Equirectangular projection (ERP) panoramas challenge PSGG through distortion, latitude-dependent pixel areas, and an artificial seam. We propose a two-stage spherical geometry-aware framework that fuses overlapping perspective-view predictions using observation reliability, spherical overlap, and angular proximity. Relation reasoning combines spherical-area-aware aggregation, weighted no-relation supervision, and dual-longitude score fusion. We also construct a dataset of 340 high-resolution panoramas with 10,571 nodes and 6,632 directed relations. Against corresponding baselines, spherical fusion improves PQ by 36.03% under matched views, while relation reasoning improves mR@50 by 11.20% under PredCls with ground-truth masks and object labels. The full framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% under SGDet with predicted panoptic segments. These results demonstrate the value of spherical geometry for panoramic PSGG.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 球形几何- 软件 Panoptic 场景图生成
articles.content_zh: 泛视场景图生成(PSGG)代表场景实体,带有分区口罩和定向关系. equictangular project(ERP)全景通过扭曲,依赖纬度的像素区域,以及人工缝合来挑战PSGG. 我们提出一个两阶段的球形几何认识框架,利用观测可靠性,球形重叠,角近等方法,将重叠的视角-视角预测引信. 关系推理结合了球面-区域-意识聚合,加权无关系监督,双经分数聚变. 我们还建造了一个340个高分辨率全景数据集,有10 571个节点和6 632个定向关系。 根据相应的基线,球状聚变在匹配视图下将PQ提高36.03%,而关系推理在PredCls下将mR@50提高11.20%,并带有地面真伪口罩和物体标签. 整个框架在SGDet下将mR@50改进了52.99%,并预设了泛光片段。 这些结果显示球形几何对全景PSGG的价值.

articles.title: P$^3$-VLM: A Point-based Alternative for Grounded 3D Vision-Language Models
articles.content:
Examining existing benchmarks for grounding in 3D VLMs reveals a pervasive "semantic leakage" in the evaluation and prompting protocols: a heavy reliance on bounding boxes as spatial prompts or representation primitives. Because bounding boxes are highly informative of object categories, they introduce a shortcut for the models to neglect visual information during 3D VLM training. We demonstrate this with a "blind" LLM that, prompted only with the box coordinates, can perform surprisingly well. To further analyze this shortcut, we propose point-based grounding prompting - querying models with a single 3D point instead of a box. Under this protocol, the accuracy of the blind LLM drops from 36.4% to 18.0% on ScanNet's Nr3D, and similarly degrades for 3D VLMs (e.g. LL3DA).
  Building on this insight, we introduce P$^3$-VLM, a novel tri-pathway 3D VLM that supports point-based prompts and achieves 52.1% state-of-the-art accuracy on location-grounded captioning under this setting. To achieve this, we redesign the architecture while keeping it detector-free, scene-centric, and suitable for 3D GS inputs. P$^3$-VLM utilizes three complementary pathways (location-, task-, and context-aware), enabling strong reasoning about scenes without any bounding box dependencies. The key benefit of point-based learning is a consistent improvement across settings: P$^3$-VLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under point-based grounding while also improving robustness, OOD generalization, and performance on ungrounded scene-centric 3D VQA benchmarks, reflecting its reduced reliance on bounding-box shortcuts and resulting stronger visual-spatial reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: P$^3$-VLM:基于点的三维视野-语言模型替代方法
articles.content_zh:
检查在3D VLMs中搁浅的现有基准,揭示了评价中普遍存在的"语义渗漏"和提示协议:严重依赖边框作为空间提示或表示原始. 由于边框对对象类别信息性很强,它们引入了一个快捷键,让模型在3D VLM训练中忽略视觉信息. 我们用一个“盲”LLM来证明这一点, 它只有用盒子坐标来激发, 才能令人惊讶地表现良好。 为了进一步分析这个快捷键,我们提出基于点的地面提示——用单个3D点而不是一个框查询模型. 根据这一协议,盲LLM的精度在ScanNet的Nr3D上从36.4%下降到18.0%,对于3D VLM(如LL3DA)来说,类似的降解.
基于这一见解,我们引入了P$^3$-VLM,这是一种新型的三维通道3D VLM,它支持基于点的提示,并在此设置下基于位置的字幕上达到52.1%的精度. 为了实现这一目标,我们重新设计建筑,同时保持其无探测器,以场景为中心,并适合3DGS输入. P$^3$-VLM使用三种互补途径(位置、任务和对上下文的认识),能够对场景进行有力的推理,而没有任何边框依赖性。 以点为基础的学习的主要好处是各环境之间不断改进: P$^3$-VLM在点地基下实现最先进的性能,同时提高稳健性,OOD概括性,以及以无根据场景为核心的3D VQA基准上的性能,反映出它减少了对边框快捷键的依赖,并因此加强了视觉空间推理.

articles.title: AdaptMIL: Domain Adaptation for Multiple Instance Learning in Digital Pathology
articles.content: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) support a wide range of histopathology tasks on whole-slide images through multiple instance learning (MIL). Despite recent progress, these models remain sensitive to cross-hospital distribution shifts: performance often degrades when a task head (e.g., classification) is trained on data from one hospital and then used on data from another hospital. To address this challenge, we propose AdaptMIL, a training strategy for integrating domain adaptation into MIL training. AdaptMIL is motivated by our finding that directly applying domain adaptation objectives during MIL training can interfere with MIL aggregation learning, often resulting in performance degradation over standard training. AdaptMIL resolves this by decoupling representation-level domain alignment learning from MIL aggregation learning through a two-stage training procedure. We show that AdaptMIL improves cross-hospital performance and outperforms alternative adaptation methods across experiments spanning multiple WSI datasets, tasks, PFMs, MIL architectures, and domain adaptation objectives. AdaptMIL's code will be released upon publication.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 适应MIL:数字病理学多例学习领域适应
articles.content_zh: 病理基础模型(PFMS)通过多例学习(MIL)支持全滑坡图像上的广泛组织病理任务. 尽管最近取得了进展,但这些模型仍然对跨医院分布变化敏感:当一个任务主管(如分类)接受一个医院的数据培训,然后用于另一个医院的数据时,性能往往会下降。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用适应性综合培训(Adapital)这一培训战略,将适应领域纳入适应性综合培训。 适应 MIL的动机是我们发现,在MIL培训期间直接应用域内适应目标会干扰MIL汇总学习,往往导致业绩比标准培训低。 适应 MIL通过两个阶段的培训程序,将代表级域对接学习与MIL汇总学习脱钩来解决这个问题. 我们显示,AdapitalMIL改进了跨医院的性能,并且超越了跨越多个WSI数据集、任务、PFM、MIL架构和域内适应目标的实验的替代适应方法。 适应 MIL的代码将在出版后发布.

articles.title: Differentiable Task-Driven Coded Aperture Camera Design with 3D Gaussian Scene Representations
articles.content: Camera design heavily influences perception task performance, yet cameras are typically designed by domain experts through costly experimentation, in isolation from the tasks they serve. Existing joint-design methods either rely on differentiable simulation limited to pre-captured 2D images, restricting them to optics or image-processing pipeline design, or use non-differentiable camera simulators optimised with derivative-free or reinforcement-learning methods that scale poorly with the number of design parameters. We present a differentiable framework for jointly designing complex camera systems and downstream perception tasks. We use it to design two coded-aperture depth-from-defocus cameras, a monocular and a stereo configuration, by jointly optimising the coded aperture mask, camera parameters, and a depth estimation network end-to-end. Our framework represents scenes with 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructed from real-world captures, providing a differentiable image formation process for gradient-based optimisation over design spaces intractable for prior differentiable approaches. Results demonstrate that our differentiable method improves over existing coded aperture design and non-differentiable camera design baselines, offering a step forward in automated and principled camera design for autonomous systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可区分的任务驱动编码相机设计 3D 高斯场景代表
articles.content_zh: 相机设计严重影响了感知任务性能,然而相机通常由域专家通过昂贵的实验设计,与他们所服务的任务隔离. 现有的联合设计方法或者依靠限于预摄2D图像的不同模拟,仅限于光学或图像处理管道设计,或者使用无差异的相机模拟器,优化后采用衍生的无阻或加固的学习方法,这些方法与设计参数数量相比规模差. 我们为联合设计复杂的相机系统和下游感知任务提供了一个不同的框架。 我们用它来设计两台编码-孔径深度从脱焦相机,一个单镜头和立体构型,共同优化编码孔径罩,相机参数,以及深度估计网络端到端. 我们的框架代表的场景是3D Gaussian Splating从现实世界的捕捉中重建而来,它为基于梯度的优化提供了一种不同的图像形成过程,而设计空间对于以前不同的方法来说是难以克服的。 结果表明,我们不同的方法比现有的编码孔径设计和无差别相机设计基线有所改善,为自主系统自动化和有原则的相机设计提供了一步。

articles.title: Beyond the Evidence Boundary: Behavioral Mirage Under Progressive Degradation in Medical VLMs
articles.content: VLMs for medical image interpretation are typically evaluated on clean inputs, despite the progressive evidence loss that can occur in high stakes clinical settings. Existing robustness studies show that performance can degrade while confidence remains high, but do not establish when a previously reliable model-case pair ceases to behave reliably. We introduce a baseline-anchored framework that traces baseline-correct cases through progressive image degradation to identify an empirical evidence boundary, and define mirage as continued commitment at this boundary, regardless of correctness. Across three VLMs on three medical datasets, only MedGemma provides a sufficiently large baseline-correct pool for trajectory analysis. On VQA-RAD, the only dataset in which the question text varies, language-only answerability is associated with baseline correctness (AUROC 0.677) and with commitment at the boundary (AUROC 0.653 to 0.670). MedGemma's post-boundary behavior is heterogeneous, including direct mirage, correct recovery, mirage dissolution, consistent abstention, and oscillation, with mirage rates of 16.0 to 100.0% across dataset-modality pairs. Despite this behavioral heterogeneity, residual-stream probes decode commit-versus-abstain behavior at the boundary with AUROC of 0.895 to 0.994 under nested cross-validation. These results show that progressive evidence loss can produce persistent commitment that output entropy and abstention behavior do not consistently reflect, motivating boundary-aware evaluation, option-order controls, and improved abstention mechanisms for reliable medical foundation models operating under partial observation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越证据界限:医疗超低强度水平逐步退化下的行为幻象
articles.content_zh: 用于医疗图像判读的VLM通常以清洁输入值来评价,尽管在高赌注的临床环境中可能会发生渐进的证据损失。 现有的强性研究表明,性能在信心保持高的同时会下降,但并不确定之前可靠的模型对何时停止可靠行为. 我们采用了一个基线确定框架,通过图像逐步退化来追踪基线正确案例,以确定经验证据边界,并将海市定义为这一边界的持续承诺,无论正确与否。 在三个医疗数据集的3个VLM中,只有MedGemma为轨迹分析提供了足够大的基线正确集合. 在VQA-RAD上,问题文本变化的唯一数据集,只有语言的可答性与基线正确性(AUROC 0.677)和边界承诺(AUROC 0.653至0.670)有关. MedGemma的后边界行为是多种多样的,包括直接海市,正确的恢复,海市解体,一贯的弃权,以及振荡,跨数据集模式对的海市利率为16.0%至100.0%. 尽管有这种行为异质性,但残余流探测器在嵌入式交叉验证下与AUROC的边界0.895至0.994发生解码-对吸收行为. 这些结果表明,逐步丧失证据可产生持续的承诺,即输出的py和弃权行为不能始终如一地反映、激励边界意识评估、选择令控制以及改进在部分观察下运作的可靠医疗基础模型的弃权机制。

articles.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
articles.content: Moving from controllable videos to genuinely playable worlds requires persistent world state, executable game rules, and low-latency interaction. We outline a roadmap for the next generation of Matrix-Game that separates game execution from visual generation through an executable game harness, and introduce Matrix-Game 4.0 as the first system built on this design. A lightweight game engine maintains world state and executes interaction rules, a multimodal coding agent translates player ideas into game code and dynamic scene captions, and a renderer based on autoregressive video model transforms engine-rendered low-poly proxies into detailed visuals, conditioned on dynamic captions and memory references. This framework provides continuous guidance for visual generation and enables natural-language creation and modification of scenes and gameplay. Our renderer is trained on aligned low-poly and high-fidelity video pairs and distilled into a causal generator that generates in four-frame chunks with one or two denoising steps. Together with targeted inference optimizations, Matrix-Game 4.0 enables 480p, 60 FPS gameplay on a single NVIDIA RTX5090 with a key-press-to-display latency of 112ms. Single-step generation achieves 83FPS steady-state throughput with 18.2GiB of peak GPU memory usage. With fixed prompts, steady-state throughput also reaches 67FPS on an RTX5080 and 58FPS on an RTX5070Ti. We demonstrate customizable shooter and driving games with engine-enforced mechanics, and release code, model weights, and low-poly game assets to support research and creation of playable game worlds.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Matrix-Game 4.0:实时游戏游戏世界利用视频模型
articles.content_zh: 从可控视频向真正可玩世界转变需要持续的世界状态,可执行的游戏规则,以及低常态互动. 我们勾勒出下一代Matrix-Game的路线图,通过可执行的游戏杠杆将游戏执行与视觉生成区分开来,并引入Matrix-Game 4.0作为这个设计上的第一个系统. 轻量级游戏引擎维持世界状态并执行交互规则,多模式编码代理将玩家的想法翻译为游戏代码和动态场景字幕,基于自递式视频模型的渲染器将引擎的低波代理转换为详细的视觉,以动态字幕和内存引用为条件. 这个框架为视觉生成提供了持续的指导,并使得自然语言的创作和修改场景和游戏游戏成为可能. 我们的渲染器被训练成对齐的低孔和高纯度视频对,并蒸馏成一个因果生成器,在四帧块中产生一个或两个去诺步骤. 结合定向推论优化,Matrix-Game 4.0在单NVIDIA RTX5090上启用480p,60FPS游戏机,按键-按压-显示时速112ms. 单步生成以18.2GiB的峰值GPU内存使用量实现83FPS稳态吞吐量. 有了固定的提示,稳定的状态吞吐量在RTX5080上也达到67FPS,在RTX5070Ti上达到58FPS. 我们用引擎强化力学演示自定义的射击手和驾驶游戏,并演示发行码,模型重量,以及低孔游戏资产,以支持可玩游戏世界的研究和创造.

articles.title: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
articles.content: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重铸过去: 具有完整背景内存的稳定长视频生成
articles.content_zh: 长视距视频制作需要保留不断扩展的历史,但对其不断增长的标语序列的限定代价高昂. 现有方法限制或压缩历史背景,可能失去后代所需的信息。 这部作品提出ReCam,将本地历史潜伏的spatiental块组合成矢量,并直接将其投射到传播变形器的高维隐蔽空间中. 该模型通过本土自觉学习使用由此产生的内存符,减少符数,同时保留块级访问完整历史. 为了减轻在自转式推出过程中的时空漂移,我们进一步引入了双点除噪器,对近期上下文和目标框分别设置噪音表. 在被评价的方法中,ReCam在R2M-Bench上实现了最高的V Bench-Long总体得分80.1和竞争性的静态场景重现性能. 它还为屏幕外主体的重新出现确定了所有四个一致性指标,包括服装一致性为4.09,最佳基线为3.03。

articles.title: Beyond the Frame: Redundancy, Not Trajectory, Carries the Privacy Leak in Video Unlearning
articles.content: Class unlearning for video segmentation aims to ensure that a removed category cannot be reconstructed from a deployed model's outputs. Current leakage evaluation algorithms inspect one frame at a time, and we show that this understates leakage by a wide margin: an attacker that averages a model's output field over a two-second clip recovers the forgotten class from every method we evaluate on VSPW and most on Virtual KITTI~2, including models whose per-frame predictions are visually indistinguishable from a retrain oracle (a model trained from scratch without the forgotten class). We attribute the recoverable signal to cross-frame redundancy rather than object trajectory, establish this with a time-shuffled control that leaves leakage intact, and introduce PACE, an unlearning method that suppresses redundancy directly using an exactly permutation-invariant pooled adversarial discriminator and a two-sided temporal consistency objective. Across VSPW and Virtual KITTI~2, PACE lowers pooled attacker AP to $18.79$ (\texttt{person}) and $12.10$ (\texttt{car}) on VSPW and $9.11$ (\texttt{car}) on Virtual KITTI~2, achieving on the latter the strongest suppression among verdict-safe methods retaining usable utility, while retaining $19.8$ mIoU on VSPW \texttt{car} against at most $8.3$ for any baseline achieving comparable erasure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond the Framme:冗余,而非轨迹,在视频Unlearning中携带隐私泄漏
articles.content_zh: 进行视频分解的班级不学习旨在确保无法从一个已部署模型的产出中重建一个被删除的类别。 目前渗漏评价算法一次检查一个帧,我们显示这低估了宽度的渗漏:一个在两秒钟的片段上平均一个模型输出场的攻击者从我们在VSPW和大多数在Virtual KITTI~2上评价的每一种方法中恢复了被遗忘的类,包括其每帧的预测与重排甲骨文(一个从零开始训练的模型,没有被遗忘的类)在视觉上无法区分的模型. 我们把可回收信号归结为跨帧冗余而不是物体轨迹,用时间松动的控制来建立它,使泄漏完好无损,并引入了PACE,一种不用学习的方法,直接使用一个完全固定的集合式对抗性歧视者来抑制冗余,以及一个双面的时间一致性目标. 在整个VSPW和Virtual KITTI~2中,PACE将集成攻击者AP降低到18.79美元(\textt{人})和12.10美元(\textt{车}),在VSPW和Virtual KITTI~2上降低到9.11美元(\texttt{车}),在后者上,在保留可用用途的确保判决安全的方法中,最强烈的压制,同时在VSPW\textt{车上保留了19.8美元mIoU,而对于实现类似消除的基准,则最高为8.3美元。

articles.title: Media Intelligence Platform: Multimodal Detection of Synthetic and Manipulated Content
articles.content: The rapid progress of generative artificial intelligence has led to a significant increase in manipulated multimedia content, including synthetic faces, forged videos, AI-generated images, fake audio, and locally edited images. Existing detection approaches are typically designed for a single manipulation type, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios involving heterogeneous media sources. In this work, we present the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP), a unified web-based framework for multimodal media forensics integrating specialized modules for fake video detection, face morphing detection, AI-generated image detection, audio deepfake detection, localized image manipulation detection, and text analysis. Its modular architecture enables flexible integration of heterogeneous models and supports future extensions for emerging manipulation techniques. Experimental results on representative benchmark datasets demonstrate reliable detection performance across multiple media modalities while providing a practical and user-friendly interface for forensic investigations. The platform highlights the potential of unified multimodal systems for comprehensive deepfake detection in real-world environments, and is accompanied by a public demonstrator released with this workshop submission to support reproducibility and community evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 媒体情报平台:合成和操纵内容的多式联运检测
articles.content_zh: 基因人工智能的快速进步导致被操纵的多媒体内容显著增加,包括合成面孔,伪造视频,AI生成的图像,假音频,以及当地编辑的图像. 现有检测方法一般是为单一的操纵类型设计的,限制其适用于涉及不同媒体来源的实际情况。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了媒体智能平台(MIP),这是一个统一的基于网络的多媒体法证框架,整合了用于假视频检测,面部变形检测,AI生成的图像检测,音频深假检测,局部图像操纵检测,以及文本分析的专门模块. 其模块化架构能够灵活地整合各种模型,并支持未来对新兴操纵技术的扩展. 具有代表性的基准数据集的实验结果表明,在提供实用和方便用户的法证调查界面的同时,各种媒体模式的可靠检测业绩。 该平台强调了统一多式联运系统在现实环境中全面检测深层假象的潜力,并配有公开演示人发布本讲习班材料,以支持可复制性和社区评价。

articles.title: Efficient SAM3 Adaptation for Multi-Class Semantic Segmentation via Dense Competitive Representations
articles.content: The Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) has achieved significant progress in Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) by processing short noun phrases to generate segmentation masks with unique instance identifiers. While SAM3 excels at single-concept segmentation, it falls short in complex, real-world environments where multiple concepts must be segmented simultaneously. In particular, SAM3 typically fails to simultaneously process concepts with semantic overlap, leading to semantic misclassifications and redundant mask predictions. Moreover, as the number of concepts increases, the independent inference paradigm introduces prohibitive inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose the Dense Competitive Representations SAM (DCR-SAM) framework. By decoupling cross-modal interactions, the proposed method alleviates the inference latency. To resolve semantic misclassifications, DCR-SAM dynamically aligns textual concepts with visual representations and incorporates a dense competition head to enforce explicit inter-class competition. Furthermore, a learnable background token is applied to absorb non-target objects dynamically. These mechanisms effectively suppress overlapping predictions and generate high-fidelity masks. Extensive experimental evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework: (1) achieves a 2.3% $\sim$ 10.7% performance improvement over state-of-the-art methods, (2) delivers a 33$\times$ inference speedup compared to the native SAM3, and (3) exhibits strong robustness across diverse scenarios.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAM3 通过有竞争力的代表进行多层次语义分类的适应
articles.content_zh: 通过处理短名词短语,生成带有独特实例识别符的分块口罩,分块任意模式3(SAM3)在快速概念分块(PCS)方面取得了显著进展. 虽然SAM3在单一概念分割方面表现优异,但在复杂、现实的环境中却不足,必须同时分割多个概念。 特别是,SAM3通常不能同时处理与语义重叠的概念,导致语义错误的分类和多余的面具预测. 此外,随着概念数量的增加,独立的推论范式引入了令人无法忍受的推论延迟. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用“DCR-SAM”框架。 通过将跨模式的相互作用脱钩,拟议的方法减轻了推论的延迟性. 为了解决语义上的分类错误,DCR-SAM动态地将文本概念与视觉表达相协调,并纳入一个密集的竞争头,以强制实施明确的阶级间竞争. 此外,还采用可学习的背景标志来动态吸收非目标物体。 这些机制有效地抑制了重叠的预测,并产生了高可靠性的面具. 跨越多个基准的广泛实验性评价表明,拟议框架:(1) 实现2.3%的美元。 与最新方法相比,业绩有10.7%的改进,(2) 与本土的SAM3相比,提供33美元/时间的推论速度,(3) 显示不同情景的强劲性。

articles.title: From Proper Scoring Rules and Edge Biases to Mumford-Shah Models: Robust Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Segmentation
articles.content: Hyperspectral images provide a rich representation of the underlying spectrum for each pixel, allowing for a pixel-wise classification/segmentation into different classes. As the availability of labeled hyperspectral images is limited and the acquisition of labeled training data is time-consuming, unsupervised segmentation methods are important in hyperspectral image segmentation. Spectral variability, mixed pixels, noise as well as high correlation between neighboring spectral bands make this task challenging. We present a feature-agnostic, unsupervised hyperspectral segmentation framework based on the piecewise-constant Mumford-Shah functional. Our framework turns a strictly proper scoring rule and a family of parametric probability distributions into an indicator function for the Mumford-Shah functional, and we naturally generalize some previous Mumford-Shah based models for image segmentation this way. Our focus will be on heavy-tailed elliptical distributions, the negative log-likelihood score and the score based on the beta-divergence to deal with the heavy outliers in hyperspectral imaging. Using the interplay between the calculus of variations and statistics, we also propose a robustness step to estimate the statistical parameters of these heavy-tailed elliptical distributions. In addition, an edge bias, which contains prior boundary information, is incorporated into both the data fidelity term and the perimeter term of the Mumford-Shah functional. Numerical experiments show that, to the best of our knowledge, our method achieves the highest overall accuracy among fully unsupervised methods on three of the four standard benchmarks (Indian Pines, Kennedy Space Center, Pavia University and Salinas) evaluated on the full scenes. It also improves upon our previous Mumford-Shah based model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从适当的分红规则和边缘比赛到Mumford-Shah模型:强力无监督的超光谱 图像分割
articles.content_zh: 超光谱图像为每个像素提供了丰富的基础光谱的体现,允许像素对不同类别进行分类/分级. 由于贴有标签的超光谱图像的可得性有限,且获取贴有标签的训练数据耗时,因此在超光谱图像分解中,无监督的分解方法非常重要. 光谱变异,像素混合,噪音以及相邻光谱带之间的高相关性,使得这项任务具有挑战性. 我们提出一个特性不可知的,无监督的超光谱分解框架, 其基础是木福德-沙赫的功能。 我们的框架将一个严格的适当的评分规则和一个参数概率分布的家族变成了Mumford-Shah函数的一个指标函数,我们自然地将一些以前基于Mumford-Shah的模型概括成这样来进行图像分割. 我们的重点是重尾椭圆分布,负对数-相似分数和基于β-潜水的分数,以应对超光谱成像中的重外层. 利用变异的微积分和统计的相互作用,我们还提出一个强力步骤来估计这些重尾椭圆分布的统计参数. 此外,包含先前边界信息的边缘偏差也被纳入了Mumford-Shah功能的数据忠诚度术语和周边术语中. 数字实验显示,就我们所知,我们的方法在全场评价的四个标准基准(印度松,肯尼迪航天中心,帕维亚大学和萨利纳斯)中的三个完全不受监督的方法中实现了最高的整体准确性. 它也改进了我们以前基于Mumford-Shah的模式。

articles.title: Edit in Sync: Unified End-to-End Audio-Visual Editing for Human-Centric Videos
articles.content: Human-centric audio-visual editing requires precise alignment of lip movements, gestures, and expressions with speech. Existing methods process inputs through independent video and audio pipelines, preventing cross-modal interaction between visual editing and audio dubbing. Many of these pipelines further rely on mask-based inpainting. As a result, they suffer from poor lip-audio synchronization, cumulative pipeline errors, and an inherent mask-size dilemma. We present AVE, the first unified end-to-end framework that jointly performs reference-guided person swapping, insertion, and deletion across both audio and video modalities without requiring spatial masks. To overcome data scarcity, we design a synthesis pipeline and introduce AVE-Dataset, the first audio-visual editing dataset to provide 100K pairs with appearance and voice references. By combining Synthetic-to-Real reconstruction with preliminary audio warm-up, our framework transcends synthetic pipeline limits and mitigates audio-video token imbalance. AVE outperforms modality-separate audio-visual editing pipelines in editing realism, temporal consistency, and audio-visual alignment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同步编辑: 人- 儿科视频的统一端到端音频编辑
articles.content_zh: 以人为中心的视听编辑需要精确地将唇动、手势和表达与语音一致。 现有方法通过独立的视频和音频管道处理输入,防止视觉编辑和音频配音之间的跨模式互动. 其中许多管道进一步依赖于基于面具的涂装. 因此,它们受到唇声-声学同步性差,累积的输油管错误,以及内在的面具大小困境的影响. 我们提出AVE,这是第一个统一的端对端框架,在无需空间口罩的情况下,在音频和视频模式上共同进行参照人互换、插入和删除。 为了克服数据稀缺,我们设计了一个合成管道,并引入了AVE-Dataset,这是第一个提供100K对外观和语音参考的视听编辑数据集. 通过将合成到真正的重建与初步的音频热暖相结合,我们的框架超越了合成管道的限制,缓解了音频-视频符号的不平衡。 AVE在编辑现实主义,时间一致性,视听对齐方面超越了模式-分离的视听编辑管道.

articles.title: Decoupling Action from Egocentric Observation for World Simulation
articles.content: Egocentric action transfer aims to decouple the semantic action from egocentric observations and reproduce them in new visual contexts, enabling scalable world simulation, embodied policy learning, and robotic data generation. Existing approaches to transferring actions rely on condition-guided video generation, which converts the observation video into explicit geometric controls (e.g., hand poses or meshes) to drive synthesis. However, these methods introduce geometric estimation errors, making it difficult to preserve physically plausible interactions when transferred to new scenes. Alternatively, motion transfer methods directly extract motion patterns from the observation video, yet motion-level features alone cannot encode rich contact dynamics, frequently leading to severe hand structural collapse and implausible contact layout. To address both limitations, we present EgoACT, a test-time framework for egocentric action transfer that operates directly on the denoising process of video diffusion models without requiring additional geometric estimators. EgoACT uses Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring to stabilize reference-consistent hand-object structure in the early denoising stage, and Sparse Correspondence Calibration to refine reliable local correspondences in the mid-to-late denoising stages. Together, these two components preserve transferable action semantics while improving temporal coherence and interaction realism. We further establish EgoActionBench, a benchmark for evaluating action preservation, visual quality, and hand-object plausibility across diverse egocentric manipulation scenarios. Experiments show that EgoACT generates more coherent and physically plausible interaction videos than strong baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与Egocentral Observatory的脱钩行动用于世界模拟
articles.content_zh: Egocentre动作转移旨在将语义动作从自我中心观测中解析出来,并在新的视觉背景下复制,从而能够进行可伸缩的世界模拟,体现政策学习和机器人数据生成. 转移动作的现有方法依赖于条件制导的视频生成,将观测视频转换成明显的几何控制(如手姿或间隙)来驱动合成. 然而,这些方法引入了几何估计错误,使得在转移到新场景时难以保持物理上可信的相互作用. 或者,运动传动方法直接从观察视频中提取运动规律,然而运动级别特性本身无法编码丰富的接触动态,经常导致严重的手结构崩溃和不可信的接触布局. 为了解决这两个限制,我们提出了EgoACT,即一个以自我为中心的动作转移的测试时间框架,它直接运行在视频传播模型的去名过程上,而不需要额外的几何估计器. EgoACT使用极速导结构Anchoring来稳定早期去诺阶段的参照-一致的手目标结构,Sparse函授校准在中后期去诺阶段完善可靠的本地函证. 这两个组成部分一起保留了可转移的动作语义,同时改善了时间一致性和相互作用的现实主义. 我们还建立了“EgoAction Bench”,作为评估行动保全、视觉质量和各种自我中心操纵情景的手物可信度的基准。 实验显示,EgoACT产生的互动视频比强基线更连贯,在物理上更可信.

articles.title: In PRAISE of Attributes: Grounding Retrieval Geometry with Query-Conditioned Subspaces for Person Re-Identification
articles.content: Person re-identification (ReID) ranks an image gallery using either an image query or a textual query. In image-to-image (I2I) ReID, viewpoint, illumination, occlusion, and background changes can make distractors appear more similar than the true match. In text-to-image (T2I) ReID, incomplete or ambiguous descriptions may omit key visual evidence. We study this problem for vision-language model (VLM) based ReID, where attributes such as clothing color and carried objects provide useful fine-grained matching cues. However, directly using attribute-prompt similarities as retrieval scores is unreliable because templated prompts can be biased, correlated, and poorly calibrated. We therefore propose \textbf{PR}ompt-guided \textbf{A}ttribute-based \textbf{I}nference-time \textbf{S}imilarity \textbf{E}nhancement (\texttt{PRAISE}), a query-side test-time adaptation framework for VLM-based ReID. Instead of treating prompts as scores, \texttt{PRAISE} uses a transferable attribute-prompt bank to construct an \emph{Attribute-Conditioned Subspace} (ACS): a query-dependent low-rank subspace induced by the most compatible attribute prompts. ACS provides a controlled attribute-conditioned geometry for reshaping query--gallery affinities and guiding lightweight inference-time updates without identity or attribute labels. Experiments across multiple I2I- and T2I-ReID benchmarks show that \texttt{PRAISE} consistently improves VLM retrieval backbones and outperforms both generic and ReID-specific TTA baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在属性的PRAISE中:定位检索几何,并配有查询条件的子空间供人员重新识别
articles.content_zh: 人物重新身份识别(ReID)使用图像查询或文字查询对图像画廊进行排序. 在图像到图像(I2I)的ReID中,视角,照明,隐蔽,以及背景变化可以使分光器比真实的匹配更相似. 在文本对图像(T2I)ReID中,不完整或模棱两可的描述可能会省略关键视觉证据. 我们为基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的ReID研究这个问题,其中服装颜色和携带对象等属性提供了有用的精细配对提示. 然而,作为检索分数,直接使用属性即时的相似性是不可靠的,因为模板的提示可能带有偏颇性,相互关联性,校准性差. 因此,我们提议\textbf{ PR} ampt- guided\textbf{A} 属性- 基于\textbf{I} 参考时间\textbf{S} 相似性\textbf{E} 增强 (\textt{PRASE}), 一个基于 VLM 的查询侧测试时间调整框架 。 \ textt{PRAISE} 与其把提示当作分数, 还不如使用可转让属性即时库来构建\ emph{ 属性- 附带条件的 Subspace} (ACS): 由最兼容属性提示诱导的依赖查询的低档子空间 。 ACS提供可控属性条件几何,用于重塑查询-gallery的亲缘关系,并指导轻量级推论时间更新,没有身份或属性标签. 跨越多个I2I-和T2I-ReID基准的实验表明,\textt{PRAISE}不断改进VLM检索主干线,并超越通用和ReID特定TTA基线。

articles.title: NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification
articles.content: Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event's text under examples from Alzheimer's disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. On the official 48-participant test set of the Alzheimer's Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark, a fixed support vector classifier achieves $80.88\%\pm2.56\%$ mean accuracy over fifty seeds; averaged probabilities yield $81.25\%$ accuracy and $91.32\%$ area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. NarraSpace makes the construction of scene-linked classification inputs explicit and inspectable by connecting event-indexed language-model measurements to their source utterances, speech timing, and extraction records. Such source-linked measurements could support clinician review of picture descriptions by presenting quantitative summaries alongside the original speech evidence.

articles.title_zh: 纳拉空间:图片描述描述分类的多式场景环绕证据
articles.content_zh: 图片描述性痴呆症分类使用共享的视觉场景,但单是笔录级预测并不能识别其输入的场景证据. 纳拉 空间将文字和语音时间链接到命名的图片元素,并检索预定义的场景事件的语音. 描述-空间描述摘要介绍覆盖面和时间组织。 一个冷冻的语言模型在阿尔茨海默氏病和健康控制培训参与者的例子下对比了每个事件的文字,同时对比了记录片的附加和覆盖测量. 保留源记录将事件分数与源词,语音间隔,和词典匹配联系起来. 在通过自发语音基准确认阿尔茨海默氏痴呆症的官方48参与测试集上,一个固定的辅助矢量分类器在50个种子上达到80.88\%\pm2.56\%$的平均精度;平均概率为81.25\%$精度,在接收器操作特征曲线下达到91.32\%$. 纳拉 空间通过将事件索引语言模型测量与其源词、语音时间和提取记录连接起来,使场景相关分类投入的构建明确和可以检查。 这种与源相连的测量可以支持临床医生对图片描述的审查,方法是在陈述原始证据的同时提出定量摘要。

articles.title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
articles.content: Mathematical reasoning remains underexplored for low-resource languages, including Dialectal Arabic. To bridge this gap, we introduce the DAR-MGSM (Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math) Benchmark, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. DAR-MGSM consists of math word problems (MWPs) requiring multi-step reasoning and covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). The benchmark comprises two parallel versions: translated-only and translated & culturally localized. The latter version adapts entities and references to regional varieties. We evaluate eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual large language models on DAR-MGSM. The results show that the performance generally declines on the localized version, highlighting the challenges introduced by culturally grounded adaptations. However, the magnitude of this effect varies across models, with Arabic-centric models exhibiting different levels of sensitivity to localization. A mechanistic interpretability analysis shows that translated and localized variants of the same MWPs often induce distinct internal reasoning trajectories, even when aggregate accuracy remains similar. Overall, our results show that mathematical reasoning performance depends on both linguistic variety and cultural context.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计算数学问题的阿拉伯语教学基准
articles.content_zh: 数学推理对于包括Dialectrical阿拉伯语在内的低资源语言仍然没有得到充分利用. 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了DAR-MGSM(Dialectal Arabian 多语言学校数学)基准,这是第一个用Dialectal Arabian来评价数学推理的人工编制基准。 DAR-MGSM由数学词问题(MWPs)组成,需要多步推理,并覆盖五个主要的阿拉伯语方言与现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)并列. 该基准包括两个平行版本:只翻译和翻译以及文化本地化。 后一个版本对实体和参考区域品种进行了调整。 我们在DAR-MGSM上评价了11个以阿拉伯为中心的和多语言的大型语言模型。 结果显示,本地化版本的绩效普遍下降,突出了基于文化的适应所带来的挑战。 然而,这种影响的程度因模型而异,以阿拉伯语为中心的模型表现出对本地化的不同敏感度. 一种机械解释性分析显示,同一MWP的翻译和本地化变体往往诱导不同的内部推理轨迹,即使聚合精度仍然相似. 总体而言,我们的结果表明,数学推理表现取决于语言多样性和文化背景。

articles.title: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student's mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher's own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout-scorer gap. We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher-student-environment cells, by 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/.
