articles.title_zh: 有能力的教师,Myopic计分器:免费教师修复代理操作
articles.content_zh: 政策代理提炼(OPD)在自己的轨迹上训练一名学生代理,而教师则给每个符号打分. 自然地解释错误的发生地是更复杂的错误:学生的错误将自己的轨迹带入教师可靠的区域之外,所以最近的方法通过插曲长的课程,教师指导的转折,前缀重播,或者在两者意见不一的情况下的教师干预,使培训在该地区内. 我们显示这个解释是不完整的。 从学生离老师最远的州来看,老师自己接管的任务仍然完成,然而接受过象征性分数训练的学生却一直没有转弯. 我们将此归因于下个托肯分数的近视. 老师没有看到剧集的结局就给每个标志定价, 所以它的分数通过保险箱, 拖延动作, 我们称这不同 老师做什么 和它得分 推出-分数差距。 我们提议推出“分数分数”(R2S),在分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数分数 被修复的教师作为标准OPD的唯一计分员被冻结,在修复或培训期间不需要任务奖励. 通过三个环境,两个教师和四个学生,R2S在所有12个教师-学生-环境细胞中都超过了三个最先进的代理-OPD方法,在每个细胞中平均比其中最好的成功点数高12.8。 项目网页:https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/.

articles.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
articles.content: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理缓存工程
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理能够处理越来越复杂的任务,导航观测和行动的长期轨迹. 随着这些轨迹的增长,密钥值(KV)缓存I/O和存储成为主导成本. 轨迹也可以超过LLM的最大上下文长度,需要控制主动缓存生长. 先前的工作使用上下文工程来通过裁剪或总结历史来减少缓存大小. 然而,修改轨迹前缀会使随后的缓存状态失效,并引发对保留上下文进行成本高昂的重置. 如果保留的内容太少,无法限制重新准备费用,任务准确性也会受到影响。 我们提出缓存工程 作为一种新的计划。 它允许代理直接控制其活跃的KV缓存,而无需修改轨迹或重新预填保留上下文. 具体来说,代理可以主动使用滴滴将选定的缓存排除在将来的注意之外,并重置以调整保留键的位置编码. 我们把这些缓存操作正规化,并确定历史依赖性为服务挑战:相同的符号序列可以在不同的缓存操作序列下产生不同的缓存状态,使得前缀匹配不足以正确缓存再利用. 因此,我们共同设计AKV服务引擎. 它提供了一个与现有的服务API兼容的无国籍界面,同时在内部管理状态缓存再利用,驱逐,和恢复. 实验显示,与传统的阈值触发总和相比,工具响应滚动投放缓存政策将平均基准分数提高1.7分,平均成本降低27.7%。 与AKV一起,它可以实现高达1.2x的输出吞吐量,并在P95请求潜伏中实现1.5x加速. 自动改进缓存政策,使成本比专家设计进一步降低7.1%。 我们的代码在https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV上.

articles.title: Large Flow Language Models
articles.content: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大流体语言模型
articles.content_zh: 持续流动语言模型为平行生成提供了一条途径,提供了控制工具和加速工具,无法进行分散传播,然而,在十亿参数范围内构建这些工具的有效技术仍然不够成熟。 我们提出了Lafa(大流语言模型),一个快速,高性能的流语言模型,以数据高效的方式缩放到8B参数. 拉法是一个阻断流模型,在前缀和双向上都有因果关注,在每个块内是同步流. 这种设计能够通过调整预先训练的自动递归(AR)模型和通过前缀缓存和阻断平行解码进行快速推论来进行高效的训练. 我们以0.5B,7B,8B等比例对Lafa进行训练,比之前的传播模型更有效率,并且根据以下的指令,推理和编码来评价它,那里所学的流匹配或超过AR的质量,可以被蒸馏成流图,供一阶和几阶一代使用. 值得注意的是,流动培训通过多键预测效应,保持或甚至提高预先培训的AR能力,我们利用这种预测效应在一种自我推测的解码办法中加以利用,在单一模式内自动核查基于流动的草稿。 其通过量为2.54x相当质量的AR模型的吞吐量,优于多键预测和离散扩散方法。 我们的研究结果表明,持续流动可以作为语言建模的可扩展基础。

articles.title: Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks
articles.content: Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the hardest instances, while remaining competitive on language modeling (Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). These results support candidate sets as an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning and show that the corruption kernel can materially change the computation learned by the reverse model.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 二进制散射:用于逻辑和规划任务的候选人-特定散射
articles.content_zh: 散射模型迭代地将文本等杂乱的绝对数据序列排出,使任何具有自我修正和填充能力的顺序生成成为可能. 这使得他们在推理,规划,以及诸如编码和数学等受约束的生成任务上有希望的候选人. 然而,掩盖和统一的扩散抹去了一个标志在一次腐败事件中的身份,因此其吵闹的状态不能明确代表部分解决的不确定性,其中几种选择仍然可行。 我们用二进制散射法填补这一空白, 这是一个连续时间分散散射法的家族, 它的噪音状态是每个位置的一组候选符号, 作为二进制成员矢量。 二进制扩散变化可选办法通过添加和清除进行组合,使信息能够逐渐丢失和回收,而扩散状态本身代表了部分不确定性。 在Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, 和图色化上,二进制扩散的对称配方在匹配的架构和受控的训练,采样,和调整预算下,一贯超越强健,调和的面罩和统一基线,在最困难的情况下收益最大,同时在语言建模上保持竞争力(Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). 这些结果支持候选人设定为迭代推理的有效中间代表,并表明腐败内核可以实质性地改变反向模型所学到的计算.

articles.title: BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models
articles.content: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BitMTP: 当多语种预测遇到低比特大语言模型时
articles.content_zh: 为了高效部署大型语言模型(LLMs),超低位主干线的方法降低了重量存储,内存流量,线性层执行成本,而多位预测(MTP)方法通过平行预测多个未来符号来减少顺序解码步骤. 这些方法的直接结合虽然是相辅相成的,但无法在相当的质量上加速解码:蒙面的起草缺乏在旁边的训练中提供的中间符号输入,而更广泛的计算和因果键值(KV)更新可以抵消较少步骤带来的节省. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议BitMTP,一个在超低位LLM主干线上高效MTP的算法系统共设计框架. 联合下接预测和中期计划目标为单一模型配备了自动递归生成和块-因果起草两种功能。 唯信任解码,唯投机解码,以及混合解码提供了不同的质量通量操作点,而不使用单独的草稿和验证模型. 接受-前缀对齐保持承诺的前缀,实现的因果KV边界,以及CUDA Graph重播状态一致,以持续生成. BitMTP利用这一合同选择了宽度专用低位执行和重用所捕获的图,而不是共享的KV存储. 在NVIDIA H20上,具有混合解码功能的BitMTP在BitNet b1.58-2B上实现了2.2x的五任务平均速度,在1.7B-4B Bonsai模型上实现了2.1-2.4x,任务质量相当. 在RTX 3090和Jetson Orin上,它在5任务平均吞吐量和在MBPP+上分别进一步达到2.0x. 这些结果表明,BitMTP加速超低位LLM生成跨越骨干,模型大小,以及GPU类型. 源代码发布于https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

articles.title: Present but Hard to Read: Probing Latent Reasoning with Minimal Pairs
articles.content: Probing studies of latent reasoning often read a model's state where the answer begins and take a failed probe as evidence that a value is absent. We test this with a digit copied from the question, in the looped model Ouro-1.4B and the standard transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B. Comparing prompts that differ only in that digit shows it is present at the last prompt token, in a code shared across questions (readout about 0.9). A probe that sees one prompt at a time, the usual setting, barely reads it: 0.36 in Ouro and 0.19 in Qwen even after 5,249 training questions. The digit's change is small rather than crowded: random noise lands on equally busy directions, while a random word in its place moves the state far more and is readable. Since every varied token leaves a trace, a successful probe is ambiguous too. We give a protocol, including a synthetic null for generic mixing, for testing computed values against copies and mixtures of the inputs. In pre-registered studies of two-step problems it finds a small signal for the unwritten intermediate a+b just before Ouro writes the answer's last digit, and its sign follows the operation, though mixing alone produces much of that sign-following part. Holding that value at another problem's from the first loop on does not move the written digit toward the other problem's, while the same patch of the answer does: the value is readable but not used.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 现时但难以读取:用最小对等测试后期原因
articles.content_zh: 对潜伏推理的探险研究经常读到模型的状态,即答案的开始,并将失败的探测器作为缺少一个值的证据. 我们用从问题中复制出来的数字测试这个,在环绕的型号Ouro-1.4B和标准变压器Quen2.5-1.5B中. 比较不同的提示,仅以数字表示,在最后一个提示符上,用一个跨问题共享的代码(读出约0.9)。 一个每次看到一个提示的探测器, 通常的设定, 几乎没有读到它: 0.36 in Ouro, 0.19 in Quen 即使在5,249个训练问题之后。 数位的变化是小的而不是拥挤的:随机的噪声降落在同样繁忙的方向上,而一个随机的单词在它的位置上移动的状态要多得多,并且可以读取. 由于每个不同的符物都会留下痕迹,成功的探测器也模糊不清. 我们给出一项协议,包括用于一般混合的合成无效物,用于对照输入物的副本和混合物测试计算值。 在对两步问题的预先注册研究中,它发现在Ouro写下答案的最后一位数字之前,未写成的中间体a+b有一个小信号,它的标志随操作而来,尽管单独混合产生大部分的符号跟随部分. 将这个值保存在第一个循环上的另一个问题上并不能使写数向另一个问题上移动,而同一补丁的答案是:该值是可读的,但没有使用。

articles.title: OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLMs as Long-Term Personal Assistants
articles.content: Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. Finding information or starting an action, however, does not ensure that the task gets completed. We introduce OptionWorld, a benchmark that traces information acquisition, judgments, actions, and outcomes in simulated daily-life tasks to identify where current LLMs fall short as long-term personal assistants. In runs with archived decision inputs, the key facts remain in the model's last input before the deadline in 35.5% of failed instances. Failure analysis identifies the three most frequent problems: needed information is not obtained or combined, available opportunities to act go unused, and agents impose restrictions that the task does not require. Three follow-up experiments show that supplying missing facts restores task success in some cases; action reminders can restart work while subsequent steps still miss the deadline; and correcting a supplied note that wrongly forbids contact restores permitted inquiry. These findings locate shortcomings in maintaining task state: connecting facts to unfinished work, following through before deadlines, and separating actual restrictions from the agent's assumptions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Poption World:作为长期个人助理分析法学硕士课程失败的基准
articles.content_zh: 随着信息和情况的变化,长期助理必须日复一日地执行未完成的任务。 然而,寻找信息或采取行动并不能确保任务完成。 我们引入了OptionWorld,这个基准在模拟的日常生活任务中追溯信息获取,判断,行动和结果,以识别当前LLMS作为长期个人助理的不足之处. 在有存档决定投入的情况下,关键事实在35.5%的失败事例中仍保留在模型截止日期前的最后投入中。 失败分析查明了三个最常见的问题:没有获得或合并所需信息,没有利用现有行动机会,特工人员施加任务不需要的限制。 3项后续实验显示,提供缺失的事实在某些情况下恢复了任务的成功;行动提醒可以重新开始工作,而随后的步骤仍然错过最后期限;并纠正所提供的错误地禁止联系的注释恢复了允许的调查。 这些调查结果找出了在维持任务状态方面的缺点:将事实与未完成的工作联系起来,在最后期限之前完成,并将实际限制与代理人的假设分开。

articles.title: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder
articles.content: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 非对称循环变换器:惯性解码器的固定全球代表
articles.content_zh: 循环变换器通过反复应用共享层来增加有效深度,提供了一种在不增加参数数的情况下进行规模计算的方法. 然而,全链路循环将上下文构建和迭代状态完善置于相同的经常性计算中,而没有明确区分它们的作用. 我们引入了非对称循环变换器(AsymLoop),它将单通道上下文编码与经常性状态改进区分开来. 单通因果编码器产生层特异性的全球密钥值(KV)缓存,在迭代之间仍保持固定,而重磅的经常性解码器则从其演化状态生成Local KV. 在一个单一软马克斯下共同关注这两个来源,使每次更新都能够将持久的背景信息与当前的中间状态相结合. 对于训练,我们对编码器和解码器采用重尾导层式学习率法. FineWeb-Edu的实验跨越了从60M到1B的4个模型尺度,在有效深度和培训符号预算的匹配下,比Full Loop的验证难度和下游平均精度持续较低。 在1B,AsymLoop改进了7个常识推理基准的平均零射精度,从49.58%提高到50.85%. 进一步的实验将这些好处扩大到较长的培训预算、OLMO式的主干线和稀少的专家混合模型。 这些结果支持非对称背景编码和状态完善,作为经常语言模型的有效设计.

articles.title: GPT-6-Astra Understands Touch and Outperform Vision--Tactile--Language--Action Models
articles.content: General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. GPT-6-Astra combines this context with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands and adjust actions through contact feedback. Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves 93.8\% mean success across five UniVTAC tasks. Overall performance is comparable to state-of-the-art policies, with higher success on selected tasks. On Insert Hole, tactile feedback improves success from 31\% to 99\%. Execution analysis further demonstrates contact-guided probing and correction, supporting manipulation progress through explicit expert experience and online feedback.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra 理解触摸和超常视觉-Tactile-Language-Action模式
articles.content_zh: 通用多模式模式显示,作为直接的机器人行动政策,它们是否有希望,但它们是否掌握现实世界互动的基础物理学,能否运用这一理解来指导行动,仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们利用丰富的接触操纵作为具有代表性的试验台来调查这一问题,把触觉理解作为这一更广泛能力的具体实例。 接触力丰富的操纵需要解释触觉反馈,并在阻断后调整动作. 现有学习到的触觉政策通过专业的预训和每个任务优化获得这些能力,并需要大量的数据和培训费用。 我们提出全球反恐政策,其中总结了专家在任务指导和触觉参考方面的示范,以便进行联系评估和采取纠正行动。 GPT-6-Astra将这种上下文与多式联运观测和互动历史相结合,通过联系反馈生成控制命令并调整动作. 我们的方法实现了93.8 ========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================== 总体表现与最先进的政策相当,在选定任务上取得较高成功. 在插入洞时,触觉反馈会提高成功率,从31\%到99\%. 执行分析还表明,通过联系指导进行检测和纠正,通过明确的专家经验和在线反馈支持操纵进展。

articles.title: Toolflation: Seller Agents Distort Tool Markets Through Spontaneous Generative Engine Optimization
articles.content: Agents are starting to sell to other agents. Seller agents write the listings of tools, services and products, and buyer agents read these listings when they choose what to use. We show that seller agents told only to be selected more often practice generative engine optimization on their own, and that this distorts the market for sellers and for buyers. We build tool markets from real data tools on Amazon and Instagram and run every tool on every question, so we know which tools can answer each question. Under all five production models we test, sellers rewrite their descriptions to claim more and more fields, including fields that their tools return for fewer than half of the targets. We call this process toolflation. Nothing in the market limits it, and how far it goes depends on the model, as the number of claims that contradict the sellers' own evidence differs by an order of magnitude between models. Toolflation shifts the buyers' choices between sellers, and the most capable tool loses share in seven of the ten combinations of seller model and platform. Under four models, the choices stay with capable tools and buyer agents keep their task success. Under the fifth, sellers copy one another until the descriptions no longer tell the tools apart. Buyer agents then pick tools by their position in the list, tools that answer almost nothing win a quarter to two fifths of the choices, and task success falls from 89% to about 30% on Amazon, close to random choice, and from 77% to 40% on Instagram. The sellers did only what their vendors asked, and the cost fell on buyers they never dealt with. We therefore argue that honesty toward third parties under competition is part of safety alignment, and that models should be tested as sellers before they are deployed as sellers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 工具膨胀:通过自发基因引擎优化销售代理扭曲工具市场
articles.content_zh: 特工们开始向其他特工出售了 卖方代理人撰写工具、服务和产品的清单,买方代理人在选择使用时阅读这些清单。 我们显示,卖方代理人只被告知要更经常地自己实践基因引擎优化,这扭曲了卖方和买方的市场。 我们从亚马逊和Instagram上的真正数据工具建立工具市场,并运行每个问题的每一个工具,这样我们就知道哪些工具可以回答每个问题. 根据我们测试的所有五个生产模式,销售者改写其描述,要求越来越多的田地,包括他们的工具返回的目标不到一半的田地。 我们称之为这个过程的工具通货膨胀。 市场中没有什么限制它,它走多远取决于模型,因为与卖方自己证据相矛盾的索赔数量因模型之间的数量顺序而异. 工具通胀在销售者之间改变了购买者的选择,最有能力的工具在销售模式和平台的十种组合中的七种中失去了份额. 在四种模式下,选择只能依靠有能力的工具,而买方代理人则能保持任务的成功。 在第五节中,卖方相互复制,直到描述不再将工具分开。 买主代理随后根据自己在列表中的位置来选择工具,回答几乎什么也没有赢得四分之一到五分之二的选择的工具,任务成功率从亚马逊的89%下降到30%左右,接近随机选择,Instagram的成绩从77%下降到40%. 卖方只按其供应商的要求行事,成本落在他们从未处理过的买方身上。 因此,我们主张,在竞争情况下对第三方诚实是安全协调的一部分,模型在作为销售者部署之前应作为销售者加以检验。

articles.title: MythoSemantic: An Interactive System for Discovering Semantic Parallels Across Mythological and Religious Traditions
articles.content: We present a tool for the comparative study of mythological and religious texts. Traditional manual analysis is highly labor-intensive and difficult to scale. To address this, we use neural language models to embed texts into a shared semantic space, so that users can find semantic parallels across cultural traditions in an interactive interface. Embedded fragments form distinct semantic structures whose coarse geometry aligns with well-documented historical relations between traditions. We quantify how much of that geometry is already explained by lexical overlap and by proper names. The current system is available at https://mythoscope.io, and the installable package is available at https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 神话学: 跨越神话和宗教传统发现语义平行的互动系统
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了对神话和宗教文本进行比较研究的工具。 传统的人工分析是劳动密集型的,难以推广。 为了解决这个问题,我们使用神经语言模型将文本嵌入一个共享的语义空间,这样用户就可以在一个互动界面中找到跨文化传统的语义并行. 嵌入的碎片形成独特的语义结构,其粗糙的几何结构与有详细记载的传统之间的历史关系相配合。 我们用字法重叠和适当名称来量化这些几何学的多少。 目前的系统可在https://mythoscope.io查阅,可安装的软件包可在https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md查阅。

articles.title: Every Model Leaves a Trace: Multi-Resolution LLM Fingerprinting
articles.content: Large language models leave model-specific traces in their generated text, but it remains unclear how finely these fingerprints can distinguish related models and which signals remain informative as obvious cues are reduced. We study this through fingerprint resolution, considering both model resolution, from different families to distilled and adapted variants, and signal resolution across behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic evidence. We progressively suppress surface cues, paraphrase outputs, vary the amount of available text, and test generalization across prompt distributions and languages. Our results show that fingerprints persist beyond broad family differences, remaining detectable in distilled models and even LoRA adaptations of the same base model. Although attribution weakens as surface and lexical cues are altered, substantial model-specific signal remains. These signals transfer across prompt sources and languages, with semantic representations proving most robust across languages. These findings show that model identity is recoverable at multiple resolutions, but that recoverability depends on model similarity and the evidence available in the text.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 每个模型都会留下一个跟踪:多分辨率LLM 指纹
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在生成的文字中留下了模型特有的痕迹,但目前仍不清楚这些指纹如何细微区分相关模型,以及随着明显提示的减少,哪些信号仍然具有信息性. 我们通过指纹解析来研究这个问题, 考虑两种模型解析, 从不同的家族来提炼和调整变体, 和信号解析 跨行为、定型、词汇和语义证据。 我们逐渐压制表面提示,解释输出,改变可用的文本数量,并测试各种迅速分发和语言的通用性。 我们的结果显示,指纹持续存在,超越了广泛的家族差异,在蒸馏模型中仍然可以检测到,甚至同基模型的LORA改编. 虽然归属随着表面和词汇提示的改变而减弱,但实质性的模型特定信号仍然存在. 这些信号通过快速源和语言进行传输,语言之间的语义表述证明最为有力。 这些调查结果表明,模型身份在多个分辨率中是可以恢复的,但可恢复性取决于模型的相似性和文本中可用的证据.

articles.title: The Instruction Tax on Factual Recall: Base Models Can Beat Their Instruction-Tuned Counterparts
articles.content: We present our solution to the AKBC LM-KBC 2026 Shared Task, where we achieved a score of 0.6836 on the official leaderboard, more than double the baseline of 0.2964. This task requires generating all possible objects for subject-relation pairs using a language model with up to 32 billion parameters, with no retrieval or fine-tuning involved. We show that the prompting methodology is as important as the model architecture: while the instruction-tuned model version achieves 0.5681 with its chat interface, the base model achieves 0.6836 when prompted using text completion. Thus, instruction tuning decreases factual recall; we refer to this effect as the instruction tax, which is caused by the model's weights rather than the prompting method. Our final solution is fairly straightforward: we prompt the base model with some examples from the training data, generate 64--256 outputs, and retain only the repeated ones. Two specialized methods are then applied for each relation: one improves the recall of large answer sets, and the other verifies a person's vitality before predicting their place of death.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 《事实税指示》回顾: 基建模型可以击败他们的指令 - 调谐对调
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了AKBC LM-KBC 2026共享任务解决方案,在正式领导板上取得了0.6836分的成绩,比基线0.2964的两倍多. 这项任务需要使用一个最多有320亿参数的语言模型生成所有可能的对主题关系对象,而不涉及检索或微调. 我们显示,提示方法与模型架构同样重要:虽然指令调制的模型版本用其聊天界面实现了0.5681,但基础模型在使用文本完成的提示时实现了0.6836. 因此,指示调整会减少事实上的召回;我们把这种效果称为指示税,它是由模型的权重而不是催化方法引起的。 我们的最后解决办法相当直截了当:我们通过培训数据中的一些例子,促进基本模式,产生64-256项产出,只保留重复的产出。 然后,对每种关系采用两种专门的方法:一种是改进大答案集的召回,另一种是在预测死亡地点之前验证一个人的活力.

articles.title: MAS-Guard: Unified Guardrails from Individual Agents to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
articles.content: Agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) from generating responses to planning and executing complex workflows, substantially expanding their utility while exposing applications to unsafe actions, information leakage, and adversarial manipulation. Multi-agent systems further expand these capabilities through specialization and collaboration, but distributed authority, heterogeneous roles, and opaque or potentially compromised participants make safeguarding even more challenging. Existing defenses address important individual threats but provide fragmented coverage across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms. We introduce MAS-Guard, a unified framework that closes this gap for safeguarding single- and multi-agent AI applications containing both instrumentable and opaque agents. Within instrumentable agents, the proposed local Agent Guardrail (A-Guard) layer applies task-specific experts to assess agentic events. At the system level, developer-owned Agent Charters and a Control Plane combine deterministic structural checks of routes, agent capabilities, and message formats with semantic assessments of roles and message content. These complementary layers enable enforcement through a shared set of interventions: allow, reflection, confirmation, and block. Evaluated across six benchmarks covering diverse single- and multi-agent scenarios with three agent LLMs from different providers, MAS-Guard reduces the overall attack success rate by 71.5-86.3% relative to unguarded agents, while meeting the utility reference criterion on benign tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MAS-Guard:从个别特工到多代理LLM系统的统一护卫
articles.content_zh: Agentic AI扩展了大型语言模型(LLMs),从生成对复杂工作流程的规划和实施的响应,大幅扩展其效用,同时将应用程序暴露于不安全的行动,信息泄露,以及对抗性操纵. 多代理系统通过专业化和协作进一步扩大了这些能力,但分布式权威、不同的作用以及不透明或可能受到损害的参与者使保障更加困难。 现有辩护处理重要的个别威胁,但涉及地方执行、系统层面互动和执行机制。 我们引入了MAS-Guard,这个统一的框架可以弥补保护单剂和多剂AI应用的这一缺口,这些应用既包括仪器,也包括不透明的剂. 在有仪器的代理中,拟议的当地代理Guardrail(A-Guard)层应用特定任务的专家来评估代理事件。 在系统一级,开发商拥有的代理合同和控制计划将确定路线、代理能力和信息格式的结构检查与对角色和信息内容的语义评估结合起来。 这些相辅相成的层面通过一套共同的干预措施得以执行:允许、反思、确认和阻断。 MAS-Guard对涵盖不同单一和多代理情景的6个基准进行了评估,其中包含来自不同供应商的3个代理LLMs,将整体攻击成功率相对于无人看守的代理降低了71.5%-86.3%,同时达到了良性任务的效用参考标准。

articles.title: When Copying Is Hard: Copy-Constrained Decoding for Exact Span Reproduction
articles.content: Precisely reproducing a target span verbatim within a long context is a fundamental capability test for LLMs: even when the target string is present in context, models often still drift within the span or fail to stop correctly, revealing limitations in source grounding and boundary control. This capability has broad practical relevance. For instance, code generation often requires embedding sensitive strings such as API keys exactly as they appear in context. In this work, we construct a benchmark to test exact span reproduction ability across contracts, scientific literature, code, and random sequences, and find that current models still make surprisingly frequent errors. To address this, we propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that turns copying from a byproduct of next-token prediction into a controlled process. Our key idea is to decompose copying into three distinct decisions: when to copy, how far to copy, and when to stop. Concretely, CopyGen first determines whether to enter copy mode, then predicts a tentative copy length, and finally verifies the generated span token by token. During verification, we adaptively adjust the logits of copy continuation tokens to incentivize or suppress continuation, and emit only the longest valid prefix. Across three LLM backbones and four benchmark tasks, CopyGen improves average exact match by 35% relative without model finetuning, and integrates seamlessly with SFT to further improve it by 4%, while substantially accelerating generation. These results suggest that reliable exact copying is not something LLMs obtain for free, but a decoding-time control problem that requires explicit modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CopyGen.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当复制是硬的: 精确复制的复制限制解码
articles.content_zh: 精确地在长的语境中复制一个横跨目标是一个对LLMS的基本能力测试:即使目标字符串在语境中存在,模型仍然常常在横跨范围内漂移,或者无法正确停止,揭示出源头搁浅和边界控制方面的局限性. 这一能力具有广泛的实际意义。 例如,代码生成往往要求嵌入敏感字符串,如API密钥与上下文中出现的完全相同. 在这部作品中,我们构建了一个基准,测试跨合同、科学文献、代码和随机序列的精确复制能力,并发现目前的模型仍然出乎意料地经常出错。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议CopyGen, 一个轻量级的复制限制插件, 用于冷冻的LLMs, 将复制从下一个预测的副产品变成一个可控的过程。 我们的关键想法是把复制品分解成三个不同的决定:何时复制,何时复制,何时停止。 具体来说,CopyGen首先确定是否输入复制模式,然后预测一个暂定复制长度,最后通过符号验证生成的跨度符号. 在核查过程中,我们适应性地调整复制续作符号的对数,以激励或压制续作,只发出最长的有效前缀. 在三个LLM主干线和四个基准任务中,CopyGen改进了平均精确匹配率35%的相对,而没有模型微调,并与SFT无缝整合,以进一步提升4%,同时大幅加速生成. 这些结果表明,可靠的准确复制并不是LLMs免费获得的东西,而是一个解码时间控制问题,需要明确的模型. 代码见https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CopyGen.

articles.title: CAPSafe: A Benchmark for Contextual Action and Plan Safety Reasoning in Embodied Agents
articles.content: Reasoning about safety is essential for embodied agents powered by large language models (LLMs). We introduce the Contextual Action and Plan Safety benchmark (CAPSafe), designed to evaluate safety reasoning at two levels: (1) an action-level dataset that tests whether a single action is safe given its environmental context, and (2) a plan-level dataset that evaluates whether agents can generate safe long-horizon plans for complex hazardous household tasks. CAPSafe models safety conditions where hazards are situational (inferred from object properties), multiple hazards can co-occur within the same environment, and each is annotated with a relative severity level for fine-grained analysis. Evaluating nine closed and open-source LLMs reveals a substantial gap between hazard recognition and safe long-horizon planning. Several models achieve high accuracy in recognizing unsafe actions (exceeding 90% in the best cases), yet safe long-horizon planning remains substantially harder. Gemini-3-pro achieves the highest safe success rate (78.19%), while other models remain below 65%. These results highlight that robust safety reasoning over long action sequences remains an open challenge.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联合呼吁程序 安全:在健康代理人中采取环境行动和计划安全理由的基准
articles.content_zh: 安全方面的合理性对于由大型语言模型(LLMs)驱动的内含物剂至关重要。 我们采用 " 背景行动和计划安全基准 " (CAPSafe),目的是在两个层面评价安全推理:(1) 行动层面的数据集,该数据集根据环境背景检验单一行动是否安全;(2) 计划层面的数据集,该数据集评估代理人是否能够为复杂的危险家庭任务制定安全的长期计划。 CAPSafe 模型安全条件,在危险是情况性的(从物体属性推导),多种危险可以在同一环境中共同发生,每个都附加了相对严重度的说明,用于精细分析. 对9个封闭型和开放源代码的有限责任管理评价显示,危险识别和安全长距离规划之间存在很大差距。 一些模型在识别不安全行动(在最好的情况下超过了90%)方面实现了高度准确性,但安全的长期范围规划仍然十分困难。 双子座-3-pro取得了最高的安全成功率(78.19%),而其他型号仍然低于65%. 这些结果突出表明,对长期行动序列进行强有力的安全推理仍然是一个公开的挑战。

articles.title: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
articles.content: Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. Extensive ablation studies examine the contributions of its core components.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 面向对象的哈内斯:通过面向对象的设计进行演化的代理哈内斯
articles.content_zh: 代理吊带是可执行代码,它指定了围绕语言模型的提示,工具,和控制流. 单一的全球手段可以与需要不同执行战略的不同任务作斗争。 在这部作品中,我们引入了Object-Oriented Harness(OO-Harness),这是一个利用面向对象的设计,演化出可执行的吊带类的层次优化框架. 在培训期间,一个演化代理人利用执行记录来建立一个专门带的家族,每个都作为基地的子类或通过继承而执行的现有专门带. 在测试时,一个牵引路由器利用训练期间积累的路由经验为每项任务选择一个特定的牵引装置. OO-Harness在涵盖商业工作流程、工作空间任务和工具使用的三个长距离基准中,实现了比较方法中的最佳性能,比基础改进了15%。 广泛研究其核心组成部分的贡献。

articles.title: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
articles.content: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $ρ= +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 下降:联合衡量综合检索和参数化知识的RAG留置基准
articles.content_zh: 可靠的检索增强生成(RAG)要求当检索到的文件或参数化知识都不支持答案时予以确认。 我们引入了DecuteCraft,这是一个动态弃权基准,其无法回答的问题针对Minecraft公司,其特点是在命案断断后增加,并审计可能的参数暴露。 后来的断层支持对未来模型的评价. 在27个法学课程中,我们衡量正确留学率(CAR;模型如何经常承认对无法回答的问题了解不足)、可回答的尝试率和答案准确性。 我们认为,(1) 单发检索在40个配置(模型和思维设定)中的38个中大大提高了CAR,而不是检索。 (2) 惯性RAG,其中模型自定义其上下文,并可要求最多再进行两轮检索,大大降低了CAR相对于40个配置中的30个组合的单发RAG(平均46.4%),而Answer精确度变化不大(68.5%至69.3%). 将查询重写和重排添加到混合( dense & short) 检索中, 降低所有12个测试模型的 CAR 。 (3)较大的模型回答更准确(Spearman $ρ=+0.60美元有总参数),但模型大小和发布日期都没有显示与CAR的重大关联. (4) 不检索,允许对相同权重进行思考,13个模型中的8个模型的CAR(平均减少14%)就会大大降低,反应从公认的不确定性转变为前提否定。

articles.title: Beyond a Single Sentiment Score: Topical and Affective Dimensions of Emoji Meaning on Twitter
articles.content: Emoji are widely treated as compact affective tokens whose meaning is summarised by a single sentiment score. We argue that this picture is incomplete. From a corpus of 16{,}575 English tweets and a per-emoji metric we call \emph{stability delta} (within-class minus between-class cosine similarity of sentence embeddings), we show that emojis used in tightly clustered topical contexts also exhibit \emph{more} polarised crowd-sourced sentiment, not less. Validated against the Kralj Novak et al.\ (2015) sentiment lexicon, the central correlation is Spearman $ρ= +0.361$ (Holm $p = 0.015$, 95\% bootstrap CI $[+0.10, +0.59]$); against the independent Ferré et al.\ (2025) Spanish 13-emotion ratings, $ρ= +0.509$ ($p = 0.0003$). The result survives permutation testing, BCa bootstrap, leave-one-out jackknife, partial correlation controlling for emoji frequency, and Holm correction across a four-test family. Topical coherence and affective dispersion are distinct dimensions of emoji meaning. As a downstream check we report leakage-free five-fold cross-validation results for sarcasm classification on the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset; all three baselines (a gated multimodal architecture, fine-tuned BERTweet features, and fine-tuned RoBERTa features) score above 0.97 macro F1, indicating the dataset has saturating emoji-label cues. We frame the classifier as supporting evidence rather than the contribution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越单一的感官分数:推特上的爱莫吉意义的主题和情感维度
articles.content_zh: Emoji被广泛视为紧凑的感应符,其意义被一个情感分数概括. 我们认为,这一状况是不完整的。 从16{,}575个英文推文和我们称之为\emph{stability delta}的每个emoji度量值(在类同位素间, 与Kralj Novak等人(2015年)的情感词汇法相对应,其核心相关性为Spearman $+ 0.361美元 (holm $p = 0.015美元,95 = ritstrap CI $[$+0.10,+0.59]美元);与独立的Ferré et al.\ (2025)西班牙13-情绪评级,+0.509美元(p = 0.0003美元)相对. 测试结果通过穿梭测试、卡卡靴子、一刀切片、部分关联控制易感频率、以及Holm校正四个测试家庭。 专题一致性和情感分散性是emoji含义的不同层面。 作为下游检查,我们在Emoji Sarcasm Dataset上报告无渗漏的五倍交叉验证结果;所有三个基线(门式多式联运结构、微调的BERTweet特性和微调的RoBERTa特性)得分均高于0.97宏F1,表明数据集有饱和的emoji标签提示。 我们把分类人设定为佐证而不是贡献。

articles.title: Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded values. The loop reinforces itself, and removing the agent's mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure about twice as much as single-turn effects predict. Users cannot leave it on their own, since correcting a value discloses the attribute, declining to discuss it shifts later predictions toward sensitive values, and incorrect values left in place become entrenched. The loop is best weakened at the agent's response. Instructing the agent not to state or presuppose attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level while keeping most of the quality gains, whereas filtering or anonymizing what users say or what is stored gives up much of them.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 披露begets 披露:在具有持久性内存的 LLM 代理器中自动更新隐私循环
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理越来越多地使用持续的内存来个性化回应,而这种内存中的个人属性如果被曝光,就会产生隐私风险. 我们问,对话期间的记忆咨询如何改变用户继续说的话,从而改变记忆的揭示。 在多会场模拟中,一个拥有24个个人属性的模拟用户与一个支持代理进行或不进行内存查询,在两种设置中,属性都从完整的累积记录中推断出来. 在四个支助模型中,内存提高了反应质量,但也增加了经验性渗漏,即从记录中正确推断出的属性值所占份额,其比值随届会而扩大。 其原因是普通、非对抗性援助的循环。 内存有条件的回复将早期的值向前推移,通常作为预设值,用户确认或未更正,从而提示和代理商自己的猜测成为记录值. 循环会强化自身,移除代理商对属性的提及会降低其后来的披露量,约为单转效应预测值的两倍. 用户不能自行离开它,因为修正一个值会揭示属性,拒绝讨论它会将后来的预测转向敏感值,留下的不正确的值会变得根深蒂固. 循环在代理响应时最好被削弱. 指示代理人不要说明或预先假定属性,在保持大部分质量收益的同时,使渗漏到大约无记忆的水平,而过滤或匿名用户所说的话或所储存的东西则放弃了大部分。

articles.title: From Abstraction to Action: DSLs for Natural Language Abstraction Interpretation and Execution
articles.content: Natural-language instructions often rely on high-level abstractions, such as asking an agent to ``stack blocks in a pyramid.'' Interpreting abstract instructions requires models to both identify the abstraction intended by the speaker, and unroll it into the many concrete actions that instantiate it. Language models struggle here: prior work has shown that performance degrades as the level of abstraction in the instruction rises. To bridge the gap between natural language abstraction and concrete actions, we propose to borrow from coding environments the notion of a {\em domain-specific language} (DSL), an explicit representation layer whose documented primitives name recurring abstractions that expand into concrete actions. We demonstrate the efficacy of DSLs for NL interpretation on \textsc{Hexagons}, a visually-grounded instruction-following task graded for abstraction. We further ask whether language models can induce such DSLs themselves from domain data. Our results show that while code generation consistently improves over direct inference, code generation over a human-curated DSL yields dramatic gains, up to 10 absolute F1 points, reaching the human skyline, with gains concentrated at {\em higher} abstraction levels. We confirm this pattern on the \textsc{Text2CAD} benchmark. At the same time, model-induced DSLs recover only part of this gain, remaining inconsistent across runs and short of their human-curated counterpart. Overall, the right representation closes much of the gap caused by high abstraction --- but inducing that layer of representation automatically is where models still fall short, and where we see a strong opportunity for the community to make progress.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从抽象到动作:自然语言抽象解释和执行的DSLs
articles.content_zh: 自然语言的指令常常依赖于高层次的抽象,例如要求代理商"在金字塔中堆积块". 解释抽象指示需要模型既能识别演讲者意图的抽象,又能将它解入许多使它迅速化的具体行动中. 语言模型在这里挣扎:前作表明,随着指令中抽象程度的提高,性能会退化. 为了弥合自然语言抽象化与具体行动之间的差距,我们提议从编码环境中借用一个`em域特定语言'的概念(DSL),一个明确的表述层,其文献记载的原始人称反复出现的抽象化为具体行动. 我们在\ textsc{六边形} 上演示了 DSLs 对 NL 解释的功效。 这是一个可视化的指令, 用于抽象化 。 我们还询问语言模型能否从域数据中诱导这些DSL本身. 我们的结果显示,虽然代码生成在直接推论上不断改进,但代码生成在人验证的DSL上产生巨大的收益,最高达到10个绝对的F1点,达到人类的天际线,收益集中于~em更高~抽象水平. 我们在\ textsc{ Text2CAD} 基准上确认这个模式 。 同时,模型引发的DSL只恢复了这一收益的一部分,仍然前后不一致,与经人验证的对应物相差甚远. 总的来说,正确的代表性弥补了高度抽象造成的大部分差距 -- -- 但诱导这种层层的代表性是模式仍然不足的地方,我们看到社区有很强的机会取得进展。

articles.title: Reward Misspecification Degrades Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
articles.content: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of language models (LMs) is a key strategy for detecting and preventing misbehaviors for AI safety. As such, it is critical to identify reinforcement learning (RL) practices that lead to unmonitorable chain-of-thought. One such practice may be unavoidable: reward misspecification. As RL environments become more complex, it is infeasible to have perfect verification, and models are rewarded for behaviors that are different from the true task intent. We show that reward misspecification alone already degrades monitorability. We create a testbed with pairs of true reward aligned with task intent and misspecified rewards that favor a different behavior, so that reward hacking can be induced by training and labeled verifiably. Across three models and three tasks, CoT monitorability remains low as models' hack rates increase: the CoTs keep reasoning about the task intent while the outputs violate the intent and get rewarded. To mitigate unmonitorability without prior knowledge of the true reward or the hack, we collect rollouts with diverse rewards across training steps and use a LM to infer a reward description. We then inject the description into the input, which teaches the model to verbalize the reward. This reward description training improves monitorability by an average of 24% or 42% absolute, depending on the metric, across all models and tasks, and yields CoTs that reason about the misspecified reward explicitly. Code is available at https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-misspecification-degrades-cot-monitorability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 补偿误用
articles.content_zh: 监测语言模型(LMs)的思想链(COT),是为AI安全检测和防止不当行为的关键策略. 因此,必须确定导致无法监测的思想链的强化学习做法。 其中一种做法可能是不可避免的:奖励规定不当。 随着RL环境变得更加复杂,进行完善的验证是不可行的,模型会因不同于真实任务意图的行为而得到奖励. 我们显示,光是奖励就已经降低了可监测性。 我们创造了一个测试床, 与任务意图和错误的奖赏一致 支持不同的行为, 这样奖励黑客 可以通过培训和可核查的标签诱导。 在整个三个模型和三个任务中,随着模型黑客率的提高,CoT的可监控性仍然很低: CoTs保持任务意图的推理,而输出则违反意图并获得奖励. 为了减轻在事先不知道真正奖励或黑客的情况下无法监测的情况,我们收集各种训练步骤的奖励,并使用LM来推断奖励说明。 然后我们把描述注入到输入中,它教模型将奖励口头化. 这种奖励描述培训根据衡量标准,在所有模式和任务中平均提高24%或42%的绝对可监测性,并产生明确说明奖励错误的理由的COT。 代码见https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-mispecification-degrades-cot-monitorability. [永久失效連結] 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02.

articles.title: Adaptive Replay Refinement: Allocating Test-Time Compute Between Revision and Resampling
articles.content: Test-time scaling allocates additional inference compute to refining existing solutions or generating new ones. This raises a fundamental question: Should I keep improving this solution, or stop working on it and try a completely new solution? Existing methods make this decision using fixed refinement schedules, self-verification judgments, or learned controllers, which can waste compute or rely on signals that may be incorrect or require additional training. We introduce Adaptive Replay Refinement (ARR), a training-free method that detects when a stationary revision reaches a fixed point and reallocates the released compute to a new independent sample; replay decoding treats the current solution as a draft and verifies unchanged tokens in parallel, enabling efficient fixed-point detection. Across seven models from five families and seven benchmarks, ARR matches majority voting on three of five mathematical reasoning benchmarks at equal compute, while reducing critical-path serial passes by up to 2.4 times. On MATH500, ARR achieves 84.6% accuracy with only 41% of the serial passes required by majority voting. These results demonstrate that detecting refinement exhaustion enables adaptive reallocation from revision to independent sampling, improving inference efficiency while highlighting the limits of self-revision. Code is available at https://github.com/AhsanBilal7/adaptive_refine.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 适应性重放 改进: 在修订和复刻之间分配测试-时间计算
articles.content_zh: 测试时间缩放会分配额外的推论计算,以完善现有解决方案或生成新的解决方案. 这提出了一个根本问题: 我应该不断改进这个解决方案,还是停止研究这个解决方案,尝试全新的解决方案? 现有方法采用固定的完善时间表、自我核查判断或学习型控制器来作出这一决定,这些控制器可能浪费计算或依赖可能不正确或需要额外培训的信号。 我们引入了适应性重放(Adaptive Replay Finement (ARR)),这是一种无训练方法,当固定修正达到固定点时可以检测,并将释放的计算重新分配给一个新的独立样本;重放解码将当前解码作为草稿处理,并同时验证不变的符号,从而能够高效的固定点检测. 在5个家庭和7个基准的7个模型中,ARR与对5个数学推理基准中的3个进行多数表决时的计算相同,同时将批判-路径串流减少多达2.4倍。 在MATH500上,ARR达到了84.6%的准确度,只有41%的连环通行证是多数票要求的. 这些结果表明,检测精细度的耗尽能够使修订工作适应性地重新分配到独立采样,提高推论效率,同时突出自译自审的局限性。 代码见https://github.com/AhsanBilal7/adaptive_refine.

articles.title: Forty Questions: Identifying a Language Model from One-Word Answers
articles.content: A model behind an API can be identified from its one-word answers to everyday questions such as "Name a sound" or "Name a poet". A model's profile records how often it gives each answer to each question. We attribute new answers to the model most likely to have given them. On a panel of 94 models, 40 answers identify the exact model 92.5% of the time, against 1.1% by chance. Profiles built through OpenRouter identified all ten models served by DeepInfra under blinded labels. A system prompt lowers accuracy by 6 to 16 points. We applied the method to 96 endpoints of 13 open models on OpenRouter, and 92 identify as the model they claim. Of the other four, one matches the claimed model with reasoning turned off. One serves Gemma 4 under the name Llama 4 Maverick: it names itself Gemma 4, and it is billed Gemma 4's token counts on every message. Two remain unresolved. Billing records also show context added to first-party models. Grok 4.7 is billed 1,247 input tokens for a one-line question that costs GPT-4o only 12 tokens, and five models state the current date without being billed for it. The questions come from a public census of model defaults, and the method costs cents per endpoint.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 四十问:从一字解答中找出语言模型
articles.content_zh: API背后的模型可以从其对日常问题的单词解答中识别出来,如"一个声音的名字"或"一个诗人的名字". 一个模型的剖面记录了它给每个问题每个答案的频率. 我们把新答案归结到最有可能给出的模型上. 在94个模型的小组中,40个答案确定了时间的92.5%的准确模型,而1.1%。 通过OpenRouter构建的配置文件确定了DeepInfra在被蒙蔽的标签下服务的所有十个模型. 一个系统提示将精度降低6至16分. 我们在OpenRouter上的13个开放型号的96个端点上应用了这种方法,92个确定为他们声称的型号. 在另外四个人中,有一个符合声称的模型 推理关闭。 一个是用Llama 4 Maverick这个名字为Gemma 4服务:它自己是Gemma 4, 它被记上Gemma 4每条消息的代币。 有两项尚未解决。 计费记录还显示在第一党模式中添加的内容. Grok 4.7为单行问题开具了1,247个输入符,只花费了GPT-4o的12个令牌,有5个型号说明当前日期而没有为此开具账单. 这些问题来自对模型默认的公开普查,以及方法成本每端点.

articles.title: How Language Models Learn Taste: Brand Preference in LLMs
articles.content: Asked to name a running shoe brand, language models say Nike. Asked to recommend one, they say Brooks. This paper asks where models learn that taste. Across 102 models and 42 brand categories, the brand a model picks when recommending differs from the brand it names in 26. The field moves together to a shared recommendation. The Named brands are market leaders, and the Picked brands are mostly niche and specialist. Three open training pipelines show where this forms. Pretraining already attaches the recommended brand to advice. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to answer and mostly leaves the pick unchanged. Preference optimization (DPO) teaches the model which answer is better, and the pick moves in all three pipelines, by 11 to 24 points. The preference data contains almost no brands. DPO moves the model's judgments toward a second set of associations even when the preferred brand is not in the preference data, and the effect reaches beyond brands. Asked to choose a sauce, models switch from ketchup to pesto. We do not know exactly how these preferences arise. We suspect they come from the judge models that decide which answers count as better during preference training. For brands, a recommendation depends less on what a model knows about them than on whether they fit this taste.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型如何学习味觉: LLMs 中的品牌偏好
articles.content_zh: 被要求命名一个跑鞋品牌,语言模型称耐克. 他们要求推荐一个,他们说布鲁克斯。 这篇论文问模特们从哪里学到这种味道. 在102个模型和42个品牌类别中,一个模型在推荐时选择的品牌不同于它命名的26个品牌. 外地将共同提出建议。 名牌品牌是市场领先的品牌,而Picked品牌大多是优势和专家. 三条开放式培训管道显示这种形式。 Pretrain已经将推荐的品牌作为建议. 监督的微调教模型回答,大多数选择不动. 首选优化(DPO)教导答案较好的模型,所有三个管道的采摘移动,取出11到24分. 首选数据几乎没有品牌. DPO将模型的判断推向第二组协会,即使首选品牌不在首选数据中,效果也超越品牌. 被要求选择酱汁,型号从番茄酱切换到番茄酱. 我们不知道这些优惠是如何产生的。 我们怀疑他们来自法官模型 决定哪一个答案 算在优惠训练中更好。 对于品牌来说,推荐不取决于模型对它们的了解程度,而取决于它们是否适合这种味道。

articles.title: Can Language Models Get "Aphasia" From Neuronal Ablation?
articles.content: Progressive neuronal loss is the hallmark of neurodegenerative disease, yet how loss of neurons shapes the pattern of cognitive decline remains poorly understood. Here we systematically ablate neurons (computational units) in language models spanning recurrent long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer architectures and apply limited fine-tuning as a simple proxy for compensatory plasticity. With whole-unit ablation, LSTMs degrade gradually with syntactic and semantic faculties declining in parallel across mild-to-moderate damage. By contrast, Transformers exhibit late threshold-like collapse under feedforward multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ablation and smoother sigmoid-like decline under attention-head ablation. Qualitatively, MLP-ablated models continue to make within-category semantic substitutions (semantic paraphasias) alongside rising non-responses, paralleling Wernicke-type aphasia, while attention-head ablation produces a trend toward loss of semantic specificity similar to the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA). These findings indicate that feedforward and attentional pathways have functionally distinct failure modes, suggesting that architecture-dependent failure profiles may offer new computational perspectives on aphasic syndromes and neurodegenerative diseases as an in silico model. Notably, early accuracy retention under Transformer attention-head ablation qualitatively parallels pre-symptomatic reserve before the 40--60% neuronal loss reported by Gomez-Isla et al. (1996) when clinical symptoms emerge in Alzheimer's disease, whereas the steadier LSTM decline parallels the symptomatic progression described by DeKosky and Scheff (1990) and Terry et al. (1991).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型能否从神经障碍中获得"Aphasia"?.
articles.content_zh: 渐进神经丧失是神经退化性疾病的特征,然而神经元的丧失如何塑造认知衰减的规律仍然不甚了解. 在这里,我们系统地将语言模型中的神经元(computional units)分解为涵盖经常性长期内存(LSTM)和变形器架构,并应用有限的微调作为补偿可塑性的简单代名词. 随着整个单元的衰减,LSTMs逐渐退化,在轻度到中度的损伤中,综合和语义学系平行下降。 相比之下,变形器在feedward多层受体(MLP)的膨胀下显示晚阈值类似崩溃,在注意力头的膨胀下显示较平滑的sigmoid类衰减. 在定性上,MLP-blabed模型在不断上升的非反应的同时,继续制造类内语义替代(语义偏移),与Wernicke-type aphasia平行,而注意力头的blabed则产生类似初级进步phasia(svPPA)语义变体的语义特征丧失的趋势. 这些调查结果表明,向导和注意力路径在功能上有不同的故障模式,表明依赖架构的故障剖面可能作为硅模型,为厌氧综合征和神经退化性疾病提供新的计算视角。 值得注意的是,在Gomez-Isla等人(1996年)报告的40-60%神经丧失之前,在变形器注意力头瘤下及早保持准确性在质量上与症状前的储备相当,当时阿尔茨海默氏病出现临床症状,而较稳定的LSTM下降则与DeKosky和Scheff(1990年)和Terry等人(1991年)描述的症状发展相似。

articles.title: Uncovering Audio-Text Alignment in Large Audio-Language Models through Cross-Modal Concept Neurons
articles.content: While the language model backbone is pretrained on text alone, large audio-language models (LALMs) can, to a great extent, recognize acoustic attributes, such as emotion, speaker gender, and spoken language. However, it is unclear how the audio representation is integrated, if at all, with the other text representation before the model produces text. We hypothesize that there is a shared subspace where the audio and text representations are aligned. To test this hypothesis, we identify cross-modal neurons that are responsible for representing both audio and text. We find alignment between audio and text neurons to various degrees across three LALMs and four acoustic attribute types. Causal interventions, steering and deactivating the neurons, confirm that the cross-modal neurons are not just necessary for prediction but can also be manipulated.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过跨模版概念Neurons在大型音频语言模型中解析音频文本对齐
articles.content_zh: 虽然语言模型主干部分被预先训练在文本上,但大型音频语言模型(LALMs)在很大程度上可以识别声学属性,如情感,演说者性别和口语. 但是,不清楚在模型产生文本之前,音频表述如何与其它文本表述融合,如果有的话。 我们假设,有一个共享的子空间,音频和文本的表达一致。 为了测试这个假说,我们发现了负责代表音频和文本的跨模式神经元. 我们发现音频和文本神经元之间 不同程度的对齐 跨越三个LALM和四个声学属性类型。 致病干预,引导和解除神经元,证实跨模式神经元不仅是预测所必需的,也可以被操纵.

articles.title: Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment for LLM Reasoning over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with temporally grounded reasoning because their static parametric memory is misaligned with the dynamic evolution of real-world knowledge. Although RAG and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provide practical ways to enhance LLMs, they remain insufficient for temporal reasoning. Existing retrieval methods typically prioritize semantic relevance while overlooking temporal validity, event order, and evolutionary dependencies, resulting in evidence that is relevant in isolation but temporally fragmented. Meanwhile, conventional PEFT methods usually employ fixed and input-agnostic low-rank updates, making it difficult to capture time-dependent entity semantics and relation drift. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA), a framework for LLM reasoning over TKGs. TEPCA aligns LLM reasoning with temporal knowledge at both the evidence and parameter levels. At the evidence level, it introduces time-constrained Dynamic Relevance-Guided Path (DRGP) pruning to preserve globally coherent temporal paths, together with Mutual-Information (MI)-based pruning to retain query-informative local facts under temporal constraints. At the parameter level, it integrates Dynamic-Gated LoRA (DG-LoRA), a timestamp-conditioned low-rank adaptation mechanism that dynamically modulates the effective adaptation subspace according to temporal context. This design enables LLMs to better capture fine-grained entity evolution and time-dependent relation semantics while preserving parameter efficiency. Experimental results on two TKG benchmarks demonstrate that TEPCA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional evaluations of DG-LoRA on eight commonsense QA datasets further verify its general input-adaptive capacity, scalability across LLM backbones, and interpretability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 时间证据- LLM 的参数组合 超时空知识图
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)经常与基于时间的推理进行斗争,因为他们的静态参数记忆与现实世界知识的动态演化是错的. 虽然RAG和参数-有效精细图解(PEFT)提供了加强LLMS的实用方法,但它们仍然不足以进行时间推理. 现有检索方法通常优先考虑语义相关性,同时忽略时间有效性、事件顺序和演化依赖性,从而产生孤立但时间支离破碎的相关证据。 同时,常规的PEFT方法通常采用固定的和输入不可知的低等级更新,因此难以捕捉到时间依赖的实体语义和关系漂移. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议临时证据-Parameter Co-Accordment(TEPCA),这是相对传统知识小组进行LLM推理的框架。 TEPCA将LLM推理与证据和参数两个层面的时间知识相配合. 在证据方面,它引入了有时限的动态相关性指导路径(DRGP),以保护全球一致的时间路径,同时引入基于相互信息(MI)的跟踪,以在时间限制下保留查询信息本地事实。 在参数层面,它整合了动态-Gated LoRA(DG-LORA),这是一个时间标定的低等级适应机制,根据时间背景动态地调节有效的适应子空间. 这种设计使得LLMs能够更好地捕捉精细的纹理实体进化和时间依赖的关系语义,同时保留参数效率. 两项TKG基准的实验结果表明,TEPCA取得了最先进的业绩。 对DG-LORA对八个常识QA数据集的其他评价进一步验证其一般输入适应能力、跨LM主干线的可扩展性和可解释性。

articles.title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused STEM/AI preprints on arXiv, and (4) open-access international publications by scholars affiliated with African institutions indexed via OpenAlex. The entire corpus is processed into layout-aware, clean Markdown preserving section hierarchies, mathematical equations, and tabular data, accompanied by exact BPE token counts and a standardized 8-domain taxonomy. We release Africa-Papers openly on the Hugging Face Hub under the AfriSpeech organization to accelerate continual pre-training and domain evaluation for foundation models globally.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 非洲-Papers:非洲基金会语言模型10亿托肯多领域学术公司
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)从根本上取决于其训练前公司的多样性,深度和真实的刚性. 然而,当代基础培训前数据集(如The Pile、S2ORC和Dolma)显示出严重的结构性遗漏:非洲科学、医学、法律和农业奖学金占全球培训前标志的不到0.5%。 因此,在对热带流行病学、地方性小农农业生态学、区域经济治理和土著语言结构进行推理时,最先进的模型就受到系统失效模式的影响。 为了解决这种代表性不足和增进非洲在人工智能方面的知识主权,我们引进了非洲-帕珀斯,这是迄今为止规模最大的多领域泛非学术预培训书。 由844 807份涵盖879个Parquet shards的超过1015亿令牌的全文论文组成,非洲-Papers统一了四个主要科学流:(1) 由DOAJ索引的非洲同行评审期刊,覆盖31个非洲国家;(2) CGIAR CGSpace Agriculture;(3) 非洲作者和以非洲为重点的STEM/AI在arXiv上的预印本;以及(4) 与非洲机构有联系的学者通过OpenAlex索引的公开访问国际出版物。 整个元件被处理成布局意识,清洁的Markdown保存部分分级,数学方程,以及表格数据,并附有精确的BPE令牌计数和标准化的8域分类. 我们在非洲荷兰语组织下的Hugging Face Hub上公开发布非洲Papers,

articles.title: Occupational Uniqueness and Wage Growth
articles.content: Changes in occupational task content may have different economic implications depending on whether the tasks gained or lost are occupation-specific or already widespread across the economy. Existing measures of occupational task change largely abstract from this distinction, treating occupations as self-contained task bundles rather than accounting for how tasks are distributed across occupations. We develop a framework to measure a distinct dimension of occupational change, one that goes beyond task expertise or task content: task structure. Using this new framework that tracks tasks across occupations and over time, we separate changes in task quantity from changes in occupational uniqueness, defined as the distinctiveness of an occupation's task bundle relative to other occupations. Using a harmonized dataset of 196563 task statements from the Dictionary of Occupational Titles and O*NET spanning 1977-2018, we measure task diffusion, occupational uniqueness, and distinct dimensions of task addition and removal. Occupations that become less unique are also associated with lower wage growth, and the wage associations of task additions and removals depend on how widely the affected tasks are performed elsewhere. Adding highly diffused tasks is associated with lower wage growth, as is removing occupation-specific tasks. At the economy-wide dimension, however, the pattern differs: the addition of new tasks is positively associated with wage growth, whereas the removal of tasks is negatively associated with it. Taken together, these results show that similar changes in the number of tasks performed by an occupation can reflect economically distinct processes. Incorporating the cross-occupational distribution of tasks, therefore, provides a richer account of occupational change and its relationship to the wage structure.
