articles.title_zh: 职业独特性和工资增长
articles.content_zh: 职业任务内容的变化可能会产生不同的经济影响,这取决于所获得或损失的任务是针对具体职业的,还是已经遍及整个经济。 现有的职业任务衡量标准在很大程度上从这种区分中抽象地改变了,将职业视为自成一体的任务组合,而不是说明不同职业的任务分配。 我们制定一个框架,衡量职业变革的一个独特方面,超越任务专门知识或任务内容:任务结构。 利用这个跟踪跨职业和随时间推移的任务的新框架,我们把任务数量的变化与职业独特性的变化区分开来,后者的定义是职业任务组合相对于其他职业的独特性. 我们使用《职业职称词典》和《O*NET》1965-63年任务说明的统一数据集,衡量任务传播、职业独特性以及任务增加和去除的不同方面。 变得不那么独特的职业也与工资增长较低有关,增加和取消任务的工资关系取决于其他地方在多大程度上执行了受影响的任务。 增加高度分散的任务与工资增长较低有关,消除特定职业的任务也是如此。 然而,在全经济方面,情况有所不同:增加新任务与工资增长有积极关系,而取消任务则与工资增长有消极关系。 综合起来,这些结果显示,一个职业所完成的任务数目的类似变化可以反映经济上不同的进程。 因此,纳入跨职业任务分配,更充分地说明职业变化及其与工资结构的关系。

articles.title: Reading Too Much Into It? Interpretive Preferences and Commitment in LLM Mentalisation under Ambiguity
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for interpersonal advice, potentially shaping how users interpret ambiguous social encounters. Existing Theory of Mind evaluations typically rely on predefined answers, while uncertainty research overlooks LLMs' preferred explanations and confidence under psychological distress. To address these gaps, we introduce MentalLoom, a novel evaluation of LLM mentalisation comprising 604 ambiguous social episodes, matched depression and social anxiety disclosures, and four-turn dialogues with unchanged event evidence. Across eight LLMs, disclosures initially elicited more negative explanations overall but more positive narrator-directed interpretations. Scripted repeated questioning showed greater emotional support, stronger positive narrator-directed endorsement, and higher certainty without new event evidence. These findings show that user context can reshape interpretive preferences and commitment while the underlying ambiguity remains unresolved.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 读太多了吗? 模糊的LLM精神化中的解释性偏好和承诺
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于人际咨询,有可能塑造用户如何解释模棱两可的社会交会. 现有的Mind评价理论通常依赖预先定义的答案,而不确定性研究忽略了LLMs在心理困扰下偏爱的解释和信心. 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了MentalLoom, 对LLM精神化的一个新评价, 包括604个模棱两可的社会事件, 与抑郁症和社会焦虑的披露相匹配, 在8个法学硕士课程中,披露最初得到了更多的总体负面解释,但更积极的是旁白所引导的解释。 脚本反复的质疑显示,情感上的支持更大,旁白引导的认可更强烈,没有新的事件证据的确定性更高. 这些调查结果表明,用户背景可以改变解释偏好和承诺,而潜在的模糊性仍未解决。

articles.title: BAIT: Can LLMs Find What Biases a Reader? A Benchmark for Cognitive Bias Triggers in News
articles.content: Persuasive writing exploits cognitive biases, recruiting a reader's mental shortcuts to shape belief, often without the reader noticing. We call the linguistic features exploiting such mental shortcuts cognitive bias triggers. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people encounter news, summarizing it, ranking it, and answering questions over it, a natural question is whether they can recognize the features of a text that bias a human reader. We introduce BAIT (Bias Annotation In Text), a resource for detecting cognitive bias triggers in news. BAIT pairs a schema of nine triggers, each specified in an annotator codebook, with 50 English news articles annotated by trained annotators at the article and span levels and adjudicated into a gold standard. On this data we define two tasks, detecting which triggers a text contains and locating the spans that carry them. We then benchmark six frontier LLMs zero-shot and with three or ten in-context examples. The models approach human agreement on which triggers an article contains, but rarely recover its full set of triggers, and they reach less than half of human agreement in locating the passages that carry them. Moreover, they over-predict triggers that come with easy surface cues, and most of the passages they mark for these triggers are not triggers, yet carry the trigger's surface cue far more often than random text. These findings suggest that the evaluated LLMs respond to surface cues rather than to the mechanisms that make a passage manipulative. We release the schema, the codebook, standoff annotations, and the evaluation pipeline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMs能否找到读者的比萨斯? 新闻中的认知偏见触发基准
articles.content_zh: 劝导性写作利用认知偏差,招募读者的心理捷径来塑造信仰,往往没有读者注意. 我们称之为语言特征 利用这种精神捷径 认知偏见触发。 由于大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地调解人们如何遇到新闻,总结新闻,排位,并在新闻上回答问题,一个自然的问题就是他们是否能够识别一个给人类读者带来偏见的文本的特征. 我们引入了BAIT(Bias Annotation in Text),这是一种用于检测新闻中认知偏差触发因素的资源. BAIT配对9个触发器的计数器,每个计数器在注释器代码簿中指定,50篇英文新闻文章由经过训练的注释器在文章中附加注释,跨度并裁定为金本位. 在这个数据上,我们定义了两项任务,即检测会触发包含文本的文本,并查找携带这些文本的跨度。 然后,我们以三个或十个内文例子作为基准,衡量六个前沿LLMs的零镜头。 模型接近人类协议 触发一个条款, 但很少恢复它的全套触发器, 并且它们达到不到人类协议的一半 此外,它们带有容易表面提示的过度预测的触发器,它们为这些触发器标记的大部分通道都不是触发器,然而比随机文本更经常携带触发器的表面提示器. 这些调查结果表明,经评估的有限责任措施是针对表面提示的,而不是使通道具有操纵作用的机制。 我们发布计划 密码本 悬案说明 以及评估程序

articles.title: Contextual Candour: Role-Aware Graduated Disclosure for LLMs over Mixed-Sensitivity Contexts
articles.content: LLMs increasingly operate over mixed-sensitivity contexts, where they must reason over information ranging from public to confidential while disclosing only what the user is authorised to receive. Existing approaches enforce access control as a binary decision: either fully answering or refusing, without regulating how much or what kind of information is revealed if access is granted, leading to over-refusal or unintended leakage. We introduce graduated disclosure, an access-control formulation in which the level of detail and sensitivity in a model's response is calibrated to the user's authorisation rather than treated as a grant-or-deny decision. We model graduated disclosure as a disclosure-aware generation problem and propose a reward-based optimisation framework that shapes responses toward level-appropriate abstractions while penalising unauthorised factual leakage, including paraphrases and approximations. We evaluate our approach on enterprise and clinical benchmarks and compare it with prompt-based, gating, and supervised baselines. Experiments show that our method substantially reduces information leakage while preserving correctness and utility. These results suggest that disclosure control must be integrated into the generation process itself to enable secure yet useful LLM deployments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 背景背景 坦率: 角色意识 毕业后在混合敏感背景中披露法学硕士学位
articles.content_zh: 有限责任公司越来越多地在混合敏感性的情况下运作,它们必须针对从公开到保密的信息提出理由,同时只披露用户受权接受的信息。 现行办法将访问控制作为二进制决定加以执行:要么完全回答,要么拒绝,而无需规定如果允许访问会透露多少或何种信息,从而导致过度拒绝或意外泄漏。 我们采用渐进式的披露,即一种访问控制表述,在这种表述中,模型反应中的细节和敏感性水平被校准为用户的授权,而不是作为赠款或拒绝的决定处理。 我们把逐步披露作为产生披露意识的一个问题,并提出了一个基于奖励的优化框架,该框架在惩罚未经授权的事实泄漏的同时,对适当抽象的反应,包括解释和近似。 我们评价我们有关企业和临床基准的方法,并将它与迅速、标注和监督的基线相比较。 实验表明,我们的方法在保持正确性和效用的同时,大大减少了信息泄漏。 这些结果表明,披露控制必须纳入生成过程本身,以便能够进行安全但有用的LLM部署。

articles.title: Same Judgment, Different Yes: Measuring Multilingual Judgment Profiles in Language Models
articles.content: Multilingual evaluations often score a model's opening yes or no, a token that also carries model and language answering conventions. We ask when different ways of eliciting and reading an answer recover the same judgment, and when they measure an answer habit. We collect 1.1 million replies from eight models in six languages on up to 105 moral vignettes, varying the question's form, the answer constraint, and the reading of the reply, token or sentence, in both wordings (the FAR-6 battery). Story-level judgment profiles converge across the tested readouts and question forms, except for the yes/no token after a negative interrogative read under a preset mapping: on the same replies, token and sentence profiles agree at a median r = 0.67 across cells, while sentence profiles agree with free-sentence profiles at 0.94, a known linguistic variability. With each language's story consensus removed, a model's profile is nearest to its own in another language for 39 of 48 model-language cells under proposition labels and 15 under free sentences, against 5 expected by chance. Particle, position, and named-term preferences follow their own patterns. A model can keep its judgment and change its yes: scoring that token requires establishing which proposition it affirms.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同一判决,不同是:衡量语言模型中的多种语言判决简介
articles.content_zh: 多语种评价往往得分一个模型的开局是或不是,这个标志也带有模型和语言答题的常规. 我们问,何时以不同的方式提出和阅读一个答案,何时恢复同样的判断,何时衡量答案习惯。 我们从八种六种语言的模型中收集了110万份关于最多105个道德问题的答复,这些答复改变了问题的形式、答案的制约以及两种措辞(FAR-6电池)中的答复、符号或句子的阅读。 故事级的判断剖面在经过测试的读出和提问表之间趋同,除了在预先设定的图中读到负面的询问后表示是/没有符号:在同一答复中,符号和句子剖面在中值 r = 0.67 的跨单元格中达成一致,而句子剖面在0.94 的免费判决剖面上表示同意,这是已知的语言变异. 随着每种语言的故事共识被移除,一个模型的剖面图在另一种语言中最接近于自己,在命题标签下的48个模型语言单元中的39个和自由句下的15个,而5个是偶然预期的. 粒子,位置,和命名期的偏好都遵循自己的规律. 一个模型可以保持其判断力,改变其是:强调这个符号需要确定它所申明的命题.

articles.title: On-Policy Transition Distillation
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates expert capabilities into a single student by matching teacher and student final-layer distributions on student-generated rollouts. We investigate whether depthwise prediction transitions, the changes in predictions between layers, can provide additional task-relevant supervision. Our diagnostic study finds that stronger teacher--student agreement in intermediate transitions is associated with higher answer correctness within questions, with correct responses exhibiting lower mean transition KL across all measured intermediate layer pairs. These observations motivate On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning teacher and student layer-to-layer log-probability increments on student-generated rollouts. Evaluations across three backbones and eight benchmarks spanning mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that OPTD achieves the best or tied-best overall performance in both dual- and three-domain distillation. In the three-domain setting, OPTD recovers $\approx 90\%$ of the overall teacher--student capability gap, compared with $\approx 75\%$ for OPD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 政策过渡
articles.content_zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)通过在学生产生的推出上匹配教师和学生最终层的分布,将专家能力整合为一个学生. 我们调查了深度预测的过渡,层之间的预测变化,是否能够提供额外的任务相关监督. 我们的诊断研究发现,中间过渡中师生之间更紧密的共识与问题中回答的正确性更高有关,正确的答复在所有测量的中间层对中表现出较低的平均过渡KL. 这些观察激励了 " 政策上过渡 " 的分流,通过调整师生之间对学生产生的分流的对数概率递增,增加了最终层次分布的匹配。 跨越数学、编码和教学三个主干和八个基准的评价显示,PALPD在双领域和三领域蒸馏中都取得了最佳或捆绑的最佳总体业绩。 在三领域设置中,方案开发部收回了教师-学生能力总差距的大约90美元,而方案开发部则收回了大约75美元。

articles.title: Poisoning-Based Backdoors Are Not Cryptographic
articles.content: To defend against backdoor attacks on neural networks, the defender must identify the verifier function that determines whether an input is a trigger, rather than rejecting individual triggers in isolation, since an attacker can generate new triggers satisfying the same verifier faster than they can be blocked. If a backdoor verifier could be installed with the asymmetry of a cryptographic authentication scheme, in which only the attacker can produce trigger inputs while the defender cannot reverse-engineer the verifier from observations, learning-based defense would be impossible in principle. We show that no such asymmetry can arise from poisoning-based installation, in which the only verifier-dependent input to training is a poisoned dataset. The argument is a reduction. A training procedure that installs a verifier from poisoned data, so that the backdoor fires on unseen triggers while benign behavior is preserved, is itself a learner for that verifier. Any verifier that is computationally hard to learn is therefore impossible to install through poisoning, and any verifier that poisoning can install is reconstructible by a white-box defender holding comparably many labeled trigger observations. A complementary argument shows that a secret key supplied to the model at inference is observable to the same defender. The result takes representative trigger observations as given and concerns when the backdoor fires rather than what it does. Experiments on instruction-tuned large language models confirm the dichotomy, with no configuration yielding a backdoor that is both effective for the attacker and irrecoverable for the defender.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于中毒的后门不是加密的
articles.content_zh: 为了抵御对神经网络的后门攻击,维权者必须识别确定一个输入是否是触发器的验证器功能,而不是孤立地拒绝单个触发器,因为攻击者可以生成满足同一验证器的新触发器比被阻断的速度快. 如果一个后门验证器可以安装一个密码认证方案的不对称,其中只有攻击者可以产生触发输入,而捍卫者不能将验证器反向工程从观测中安装,那么基于学习的防御原则上是不可能的. 我们显示,基于中毒的安装不会产生这种不对称,在这种安装中,对培训的唯一依赖核查者的投入是有毒的数据集。 辩才为减. 一种从有毒数据中安装一个验证器的训练程序,这样在保持良性行为的同时,暗中引发后门火灾,它本身就是该验证器的学习者. 因此,任何在计算上难以学习的验证器都不可能通过中毒方式安装,任何可以安装中毒的验证器都可以由白盒维权者重建,持有相当多标签的触发观察. 一个补充论点表明,同一辩护人可以观察到为模型提供的推断秘密钥匙。 其结果是在后门起火时而不是在后门起火时提出具有代表性的触发意见并引起关切。 对指令调制的大语言模型的实验证实了二分法,没有配置产生既对攻击者有效的后门,又对捍卫者不可恢复的后门.

articles.title: Using Letter Positional Probabilities to Assess French Word Complexity
articles.content: We use Letter Positional Probabilities (LPPs) to examine the orthographic differences between simple and complex French words. We draw from a sample of 38,000 French words scored by reaction time on a lexical decision task. We take the 5000 highest reaction time words and the 5000 lowest as a proxy for high and low word complexity groups respectively. We create 18 variables based on the structure of the words, such as length and number of syllables. We also reduce each word to a string of binary values by one-hot encoding each letter according to the 42 characters of the standard French alphabet up to a length of 25 letters. Thus, each word is represented by 42 x 25 binary characters. We then create LPPs by looking at the average binary scores for simple as opposed to complex words for all letter/positions. We find that there is a high number of LPPs that are associated with word complexity. For example, we find that most accented letters are associated with simpler words. We examine the effects of structural and LPP variables in classifiers and find that word length alone enables a classification accuracy of 77.27%, while adding the binary variables from the first 6 letter positions provided an accuracy of 83.95%. We discuss possible explanations as to how complexity could be encoded in orthography.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用字母位置概率来评估法语单词的复杂性
articles.content_zh: 我们使用字母定位概率(LPPs)来检查简单和复杂的法语单词的正文差异. 我们从38 000个法语单词的样本中抽取,这些单词是按反应时间对一项词汇决定任务的。 我们分别将5000个最高反应时间词和5000个最低反应时间词作为高词组和低词组的代名词. 我们根据单词的结构创造了18个变量,例如音节的长度和数量. 我们还通过按照标准法语字母表的42个字符对每个字母进行单热编码,将每个单词减少到一串二进制值,最长可达25个字母. 因此,每个词由42×25二进制字符代表. 然后我们通过查看所有字母/位置的平均二进制分数来创建LPP. 我们发现有大量的LPP与词的复杂性有关. 例如,我们发现,大多数重音字母都与更简单的单词有关. 我们研究了分类器中结构变量和LPP变量的影响,发现单词长度就可以使分类精度达到77.27%,而从前6个字母位置添加二进制变量则提供了83.95%的精度. 我们讨论了如何在整形图中编码复杂性的可能解释。

articles.title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
articles.content: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We measure how often this happens. We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026. Of 1,598 papers that propose a general RL training method, 37 reached at least one framework. Across five quarterly cohorts of papers, the number included within 180 days stayed between 5 and 7 while the cohorts grew from 72 to 386 papers. Compared with papers from the same quarters, included papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more, at 41 against 10 percent, and more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, at 29 against 9 percent. Both gaps hold without papers from the companies that maintain the frameworks, while code release was equally common in both groups. The frameworks' issues and pull requests show that few methods are turned away in public. More than nine in ten of the general methods no framework included have no thread there that cites or names them, and many proposals that do appear stay open without a reply. Two further records, the frameworks' issues and the technical reports of 13 large open-weight models, show that users rarely report training failures in public and that the reports state 8 of the 13 widely included methods. We release the data as a tracker that links training failures to framework implementations and lists each framework's contribution rules and earlier proposals.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从RL文件到框架规范:七个开放源码培训框架内的包容和审查
articles.content_zh: 从业人员通过培训框架为语言模型使用强化学习方法,因此,一个框架包括的一种方法是用户的一种配置变化。 我们测量了这种情况的发生频率。 我们通过他们的承诺历史,追踪七个RL培训后开放源码框架,并将其与2025年1月至2026年6月6 939份经过筛选的ArXiv文件联系起来。 在1 598份提出一般远程培训培训方法的论文中,37份至少达到了一个框架。 在五个季度的论文组中,180天之内的论文组数量保持在5至7天之间,而论文组数量从72份增至386份。 与来自同一地区的论文相比,论文更经常地包括经过培训的30B参数或以上的政策,41%对10%,更经常地改变现有损失的系数、夹子、面具或重量,29%对9%。 这两个漏洞都没有维护框架的公司的文件,而代码发布在两个集团中同样常见。 框架的问题和拉动请求表明,很少方法被公开拒绝。 在十种一般方法中,有九种以上没有包含任何框架的线条可以引用或命名这些方法,而且许多确实没有答复的建议似乎不公开。 还有两项记录,即框架问题和13个大型开放重量模型的技术报告显示,用户很少公开报告培训失败,而且报告还说明了13个模型中的8个方法。 我们公布数据,作为追踪器,将培训失败与框架执行联系起来,并列出每个框架的贡献规则和先前的提议。

articles.title: Beyond the Evidence Boundary: Behavioral Mirage Under Progressive Degradation in Medical VLMs
articles.content: VLMs for medical image interpretation are typically evaluated on clean inputs, despite the progressive evidence loss that can occur in high stakes clinical settings. Existing robustness studies show that performance can degrade while confidence remains high, but do not establish when a previously reliable model-case pair ceases to behave reliably. We introduce a baseline-anchored framework that traces baseline-correct cases through progressive image degradation to identify an empirical evidence boundary, and define mirage as continued commitment at this boundary, regardless of correctness. Across three VLMs on three medical datasets, only MedGemma provides a sufficiently large baseline-correct pool for trajectory analysis. On VQA-RAD, the only dataset in which the question text varies, language-only answerability is associated with baseline correctness (AUROC 0.677) and with commitment at the boundary (AUROC 0.653 to 0.670). MedGemma's post-boundary behavior is heterogeneous, including direct mirage, correct recovery, mirage dissolution, consistent abstention, and oscillation, with mirage rates of 16.0 to 100.0% across dataset-modality pairs. Despite this behavioral heterogeneity, residual-stream probes decode commit-versus-abstain behavior at the boundary with AUROC of 0.895 to 0.994 under nested cross-validation. These results show that progressive evidence loss can produce persistent commitment that output entropy and abstention behavior do not consistently reflect, motivating boundary-aware evaluation, option-order controls, and improved abstention mechanisms for reliable medical foundation models operating under partial observation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越证据界限:医疗超低强度水平逐步退化下的行为幻象
articles.content_zh: 用于医疗图像判读的VLM通常以清洁输入值来评价,尽管在高赌注的临床环境中可能会发生渐进的证据损失。 现有的强性研究表明,性能在信心保持高的同时会下降,但并不确定之前可靠的模型对何时停止可靠行为. 我们采用了一个基线确定框架,通过图像逐步退化来追踪基线正确案例,以确定经验证据边界,并将海市定义为这一边界的持续承诺,无论正确与否。 在三个医疗数据集的3个VLM中,只有MedGemma为轨迹分析提供了足够大的基线正确集合. 在VQA-RAD上,问题文本变化的唯一数据集,只有语言的可答性与基线正确性(AUROC 0.677)和边界承诺(AUROC 0.653至0.670)有关. MedGemma的后边界行为是多种多样的,包括直接海市,正确的恢复,海市解体,一贯的弃权,以及振荡,跨数据集模式对的海市利率为16.0%至100.0%. 尽管有这种行为异质性,但残余流探测器在嵌入式交叉验证下与AUROC的边界0.895至0.994发生解码-对吸收行为. 这些结果表明,逐步丧失证据可产生持续的承诺,即输出的py和弃权行为不能始终如一地反映、激励边界意识评估、选择令控制以及改进在部分观察下运作的可靠医疗基础模型的弃权机制。

articles.title: Building Telecom Language Models with RSOD: Domain Data, Specialist Post-Training, Memory-Conscious Distillation, and Networking Evaluation
articles.content: Telecom language models must combine broad networking knowledge with specialist behavior across routing, broadband services, access technologies, and operational diagnostics while remaining practical to deploy as a single model. We present an end-to-end framework that builds source-grounded synthetic training data from structured networking taxonomies and expert graphs, materializes 212,559 routed training records across fourteen networking routes, trains six frozen specialist LoRA teachers over one shared continued-pretrained backbone, and consolidates their behavior into one deployable student adapter using Routed Specialist On-Policy Distillation (RSOD). In RSOD, the committed student generates each trajectory, the route-assigned specialist teacher-forces the exact native token sequence, compact teacher hidden states are reconstructed through the shared frozen output head, and only the student LoRA is updated. A controlled reconstruction validation shows mean absolute logit error of 7.26 x 10^-6 with 100% top-1 agreement between native and reconstructed teacher logits. On four RTX 6000 Ada GPUs, the completed 2,000-step run produced 16,000 trajectories with zero observed student-version or token- ID mismatches. Under the primary route-conditioned evaluation over 2,850 held-out questions, the raw Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model scores 12.8661/25 micro (13.0172/25 macro), the combined routed six-teacher system scores 21.7641/25 micro, and the consolidated RSOD student, released as Llama-CalixCLM v1, reaches 21.7112/25 micro (21.8006/25 macro) on the same five dimension LLM-judge rubric. Under a separate neutral deployment-like prompt, the same student reaches 20.0028/25 micro (20.0778/25 macro). The consolidated student remains within 0.0529 micro-score points of the combined routed-teacher system while retaining a numerically validated and auditable train-serve execution path.

articles.title_zh: 使用RSOD构建电信语言模型:域数据、专家培训后、记忆力扭曲和联网评价
articles.content_zh: 电信语言模型必须把广泛的联网知识与跨线路、宽带服务、接入技术和业务诊断的专业行为结合起来,同时保持实用,作为单一模型加以部署。 我们提出一个端到端框架,从结构化的网络分类和专家图表中构建基于源的合成培训数据,在14条网络路线上实现212,559条路由式培训记录,在一个共享的、经过预先培训的骨干上培训6名冻结的专家LORA教师,并利用Routed On-Political Dispiration(RSOD)将其行为整合为可部署的学生适配器。 在RSOD中,执着的学生产生每个轨迹,路线指定的专家师资部队通过共享的冷冻输出头重建准确的本地符号序列,紧凑的教师隐藏状态,只有学生LORA更新. 受控重建验证显示的绝对对数误差为7.26 x 10^-6,本地与重建的教师日志之间100%的顶级-1协议. 在4台RTX 6000 Ada GPU上,完成的2000步运行产生了16000个轨迹,观测到的学生版或符号标识不匹配. 根据2,850个搁置问题的主要路由评价,原始的Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型得分12.8661/25微分(13.0172/25宏),合并的路由六师制得分21.7641/25微分,作为Llama-CalixCLM v1发布的合并RSOD学生在同一个五维LLM-judge rumic上达到21.7112/25微分(21.8006/25宏). 在单独的中性部署般的快板下,同一个学生达到20.0028/25微(20.078/25宏). 合并后的学生仍保持在路由-教师系统0.0529微分点范围内,同时保留经数字验证和可审计的列车服务执行路径.

articles.title: Adaptive Stopping of Streamed Reasoning for Language Model Agents
articles.content: Reasoning-enabled language model agents can incur substantial computation before acting, although the reasoning needed varies across decisions. Existing stopping signals, such as confidence and intermediate-answer stability, can vary in effectiveness across reasoning models; signals obtained from hidden states or token probabilities also require internal access that may be unavailable or impractical. We introduce StreamStop, which learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement. A frozen prefix reader encodes available reasoning text for a lightweight stop head, allowing stopping without access to the reasoning model's internal signals. We construct and publicly release a dataset of agent reasoning trajectories with prefix-level action annotations. These annotations compare each prefix action with the full-reasoning reference action, enabling offline comparison of stopping rules and exact expected-return optimization of a discounted action-agreement objective. Conditioning the head on the discount factor allows the agreement-token trade-off to be adjusted at inference without retraining. In closed-loop evaluations on WebShop and ScienceWorld, StreamStop achieves higher observed success than most validation-selected fixed-budget settings while using fewer reasoning tokens than Full thinking. On WebShop with Qwen3.8-27B, it uses 42% fewer reasoning tokens per episode with similar observed task success.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型代理的流化理由的适应性停止
articles.content_zh: 以理性为基础的语言模型代理人在采取行动前可能要进行大量的计算,尽管不同的决定需要不同的推理。 现有的停止信号,如信心和中间答案稳定性,可以因推理模型的不同而发生效力差异;从隐藏状态或象征概率获得的信号也需要内部访问,而内部访问可能无法或不切实际. 我们引入StreatStop,它从前缀级行动协议中学习到针对模式的停止政策离线. 被冻结的前缀阅读器为轻量级停机头编码可用的推理文本,允许不访问推理模型的内部信号而停止. 我们构建并公开发布具有前缀级动作说明的代理推理轨迹数据集. 这些说明将每个前缀动作与完全合理的参考动作进行比较,从而可以对停止规则进行离线比较,并对一个折扣的行动-协议目标进行准确的预期回报优化。 将头部设于折扣因子上,就可以在不进行再培训的情况下,在推论中调整协议式权衡. 在WebShop和ScienceWorld的闭路评价中,StreamStop取得了比大多数验证选择的固定预算设置更高的观测成功,同时使用了比Full思维更少的推理符. 在WebShop与Qwen3.8-27B上,每集使用42%的推理符,类似观测到的任务成功.

articles.title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
articles.content: Recent advances in large (vision) language models have enabled computer-use agents that automate digital workflows via fine-grained keyboard and mouse operations. However, such agents remain fragile in long-horizon settings, where errors accumulate and executed actions leave unintended side effects, making the ability to recover from failures critical. Yet, existing remedies remain inadequate: environment resets are infeasible in proprietary settings, action replay is prohibitively expensive over long horizons, and API-based rollback is limited to web environments, leaving model-based recovery largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ReTrace, a scalable evaluation framework for systematically studying recovery behavior in computer-use agents. We formalize Transition-Consistent Recovery: identical downstream actions from the recovered and target states must yield identical outcomes. We operationalize this criterion through goal-oriented action replay following controlled error injection. Using ReTrace, we present the first systematic study of autonomous, model-based recovery, revealing that (i) ideal recovery can unlock model's latent task completion capabilities, (ii) current computer-use agents fail to exploit their latent recovery capabilities, and (iii) accurate model-based recovery yields measurable end-to-end gains. Together, these findings establish recovery as a fundamental capability for building reliable computer-use agents. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/BangProx/ReTRACE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在恢复中丢失:通过目标导向行动重放来解析计算机使用代理的恢复行为
articles.content_zh: 最近大型(视觉)语言模型的进步使得计算机使用代理人能够通过精细的键盘和鼠标操作实现数字工作流程自动化. 然而,在长距离环境中,这些代理人仍然脆弱,在长距离环境中,错误累积和执行的行动留下意外的副作用,使得从失败中恢复的能力至关重要。 然而,现有的补救措施仍然不足:在专有环境中,环境重置不可行,在漫长的视野中,动作重放费用高昂,基于API的回滚仅限于网络环境,使得基于模型的恢复基本上没有得到探讨。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出ReTrace,这是系统研究计算机使用剂的恢复行为的可扩展评价框架。 我们正式确定过渡-持续恢复:与恢复和目标州相同的下游行动必须产生相同的结果。 我们通过在有控制的错误注入后进行面向目标的动作重放来实施这个标准. 使用ReTracing,我们介绍了对自主的,基于模型的回收的第一次系统研究,揭示出(一)理想的回收可以解锁模型的潜在任务完成能力,(二)目前的计算机使用剂未能利用其潜在的回收能力,(三)精确的基于模型的回收可以产生可衡量的端到端收益. 这些调查结果共同将恢复确定为建立可靠的计算机使用代理人的基本能力。 我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/BangProx/ReTRACE上查阅。

articles.title: From DQI to C-DQI: Automatic Codebook Generation and Evaluation for Measuring Computational Discourse Quality Index
articles.content: Effective democratic deliberation is vital for civic engagement and the health of legislative institutions. However, assessing parliamentary discourse quality is traditionally done using expert-scored, theory-based codebooks (CBs), which are rigid, labor-intensive, and prone to biases. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative for both schema induction and discourse annotation, ensuring schema quality and mitigating models' inherent bias remains a clear challenge. In this work, we propose a complete protocol for LLM-based codebook generation and evaluation. Starting from the widely accepted discourse quality Index (DQI), we compare top-down (theory-based), bottom-up (data-driven), and hybrid approaches for generating context-adapted schemas. To evaluate these schemas, we define an extrinsic proxy measure, validated by manual annotations, alongside an intrinsic inter-model agreement (IMA) metric, which leverages differing model biases to signal overall reliability. Our experiments on 100 Israeli parliament transcripts reveal that inductive, data-driven schemas achieve higher IMA than top-down methods while maintaining validity, demonstrating their potential for reliable, large-scale analysis of political discourse.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从DQI到C-DQI:用于测量计算语言质量指数的自动代码表生成和评价
articles.content_zh: 有效的民主审议对公民参与和立法机构的健康至关重要。 然而,评估议会讨论的质量传统上是使用专家评分、基于理论的法典进行的,这些法典是僵硬的、劳动密集型的,容易出现偏见。 虽然大语言模型(LLMs)为策略诱导和语句注释提供了可扩展的替代方法,但确保策略质量和缓解模型固有的偏差仍然是一项明确的挑战。 在这项工作中,我们提出了基于LLM的代码集生成和评价的完整协议. 从广泛接受的论语质量指数(DQI)开始,我们比较自上而下(基于理论),自下而上(基于数据),以及产生上下文调整的策略的混合方法. 为了评估这些计划,我们界定了一种外在代用措施,通过人工说明加以验证,同时确定一个内在的模型间协议(IMA)衡量标准,利用不同的模型偏差来显示总体可靠性。 我们对100份以色列议会记录的实验表明,由数据驱动的诱导性计划比自上而下的方法取得了更高的IMA,同时保持了有效性,显示了它们对政治言论进行可靠和大规模分析的潜力。

articles.title: Why Do LLMs Accept Generics? Explaining Acceptability using Psycholinguistic and Model-Derived Factors
articles.content:
Psycholinguistic studies explore why humans accept some generic statements but reject others by showing that these judgments depend on more than how common a property is. People consider several other factors such as how well it sets the kind apart from others or whether it is characteristic of the kind.
  Inspired by the linguistic and cognitive literature, we explore to what extent factors from these studies explain how large language models (LLMs) judge generics. Our results with twelve models on a psycholinguistic dataset and on naturally occurring generics show that models weigh how common a property is against how well it distinguishes the kind, and combine the two much as people do, though less clearly. Like people, they favor characteristic properties, but unlike the accounts of human judgment, they ignore striking ones. What matters most to LLMs is whether a statement is factually true, and much of the influence of human factors reaches their ratings through that judgment. In six 7-9B models, shifting the hidden states along each factor's direction moves the judgment as the factor predicts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 为什么 LLMs 接受通用 ? 使用心理语言学和模型驱动因素解释可接受性
articles.content_zh:
心理语言学研究探讨了人类为什么接受一些一般说法,却拒绝其他说法,其方法是表明这些判断所依赖的不仅仅是财产的共性. 人们会考虑其他几个因素,例如它如何将这种类型与其他人区分开来,或者它是否具有这种特征。
在语言和认知文献的启发下,我们探索了这些研究中的各种因素在多大程度上解释了大语言模型(LLMs)如何判断通用语言. 我们用十二个模型对一个心理语言数据集 和自然产生的通用数据 的结果显示,模型权衡一个财产的共性 与它如何区分这种类型, 并和人们一样将两者结合起来, 虽然不太清楚。 和人一样,他们偏爱特征属性,但与人类判断的叙述不同,他们忽略了惊人的属性. LLMs最要紧的是,声明是否属实,人类因素的许多影响通过这一判断达到其评级. 在6个7-9B模型中,沿每个因子方向移动隐藏状态会使判断作为因子预测.
